records.description:
Job ID: 528020
 
 
Ash Grove family of companies is one of North America's leading cement manufacturers, with a legacy of innovation and excellence dating back to 1882. The company operates 12 world-class cement plants and a vast network of 41 terminals across the United States and Canada. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, Ash Grove combines technical expertise, robust safety standards, and empowered talent to deliver high performance and better serve our customers. At Ash Grove, we stand together to reinvent the way our world is built.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*At Ash Grove Cement, people are our first priority. We offer a complete benefits package to include:\*\*
 
 

* \*\*Health Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Dental Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Vision Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Retirement Plan\*\*
* \*\*Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays\*\*
* \*\*Tuition Reimbursement\*\*
* \*\*Employee Assistance Program\*\*
* \*\*Disability Pay\*\*
* \*\*Life Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Growth Opportunities and more!\*\*

**Summary**
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
**What You'll Be Contributing**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.
* Additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

**To Succeed In This Position, You Will Need**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year Bachelor's Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Minimum 10 years of experience in a cement or lime manufacturing facility with specific exposure to plant management responsibilities. Type of experience - cement or lime - depends on the specific type of plant with the position under consideration.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy
* What's next for you?\*\*

We provide stability and advancement opportunities across North America. Use our tuition reimbursement program to help you meet your career goals.
 
 
\_The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. The physical demands, working environment, and other conditions of employment listed in this document are representative of but are not intended to provide an exhaustive list of the requirements for positions in this classification. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.\_
 
 
\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

records.title: Plant Manager - BCV
records.description:
**Plant Manager**
**Why Byrne**
At Byrne, we foster a culture built on teamwork, excellence, and professionalism. Our greatest strength lies in the exceptional talent and dedication of our team members across every part of the organization. We value their contributions and ensure they’re recognized, rewarded, and compensated in ways that reflect their impact and expertise.
 
 
**Pay And Benefits**

* Salary Range – $125,000 - $152,500 per year
* Competitive bonus programs
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits available day 1 of employment
* Supplemental benefits available on day 30 of employment
* Eligible for 401 (k) with a company match available on day 90 of employment
* Educational Support via tuition reimbursement and scholarship program

**Work Shift and Location**
3156 Byrne Hollow Crossing Cortland, NY 13045
 
 
Monday – Friday normal business hours. This may require evening, night and weekend availability based on business needs.
 
 
**Job Overview**
The Plant Manager plays a key role in executing assigned Production tasks. This includes leading various teams in production efforts in addition to performing the duties as needed to efficiently facilitate plant operations. The Plant Manager is also responsible for ensuring that the plant products manufactured conform to company-defined product quality standards, as well as Federal, State, and local standards of product identity, safety, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the plant; coordinate and direct plant operations in the achievement of production, cost, quality, and safety objectives.
* Ensure an appropriate volume of production and raw inventories for each product produced to maximize machine efficiencies and minimize down time and stock outs.
* Manage plant budget and expenses to fall within, or better than plan. Manage all plant variances to meet or exceed plan including, but not limited to, headcount, overtime, and spending.
* Ensure that the quality of products produced at the facility is consistent with intended design and desired image.
* Coordinate with Plant Production Scheduler, Warehouse Management and Supply Management to ensure needed dry goods are on-hand as required.
* Establish and administer mechanisms for being alerted when suppliers are going to be late for delivery or cut items on a delivery. Take action to minimize impact on production schedules and alert appropriate sales and logistics personnel.
* Provide planning assistance with physical inventories and provide staffing to perform these activities; ensure accuracy of all inventories at all times.
* Ensure reporting mechanism regarding KPI are in-place and functioning; ensure monthly reporting of critical KPI to company leadership and plant staff.
* Monitor intake procedures of raw dairy products to assure quality standards are met and production shortages are avoided.
* Contributes to the development of budgets and cost controls. Ensure direct reports analyze, budget, and control spending for their respective line accounts.
* Facilitate the development of strategies and corrective actions to resolve quality issues as necessary.
* Implements and maintains manufacturing policies, procedures, and production control programs.
* Must ensure full compliance with all quality assurance standards.
* Provide for the development, prioritization, and execution of capital improvement projects within the facility.
* Provide leadership for effective employee relations through positive communication, coaching, training, problem resolution/corrective actions, and floor time, work cooperatively with Human Resources.
* Coordinate production activities with purchasing, sales, warehousing, distribution, maintenance, and quality control activities to obtain optimum production and utilization of staff and equipment.
* Provide for the personal and professional growth of team through coaching, feedback, and opportunity.
* Foster participation of the workforce to enhance awareness and cooperation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and all government regulations; Ensure compliance and enforcement of all work rules and regulations to plant operations and all applicable employees.
* Ensure proper GMP and sanitation procedures are followed plant-wide in collaboration with the quality unit.
* Communicate with Human Resource Department on needs of the facility.
* Rigorously assess your leadership and technical team in terms of values, adherence to SOPs/GMPs, and actual results.
* Foster an “open door” policy for all employees to maintain an open line of communication between direct reports and management staff.
* Promote and provide excellent customer service for all customers.
* Promote a safe and harmonious work environment and adherence to company policy and procedures.
* Responsible for ensuring direct reports assigned duties and responsibilities are covered during planned and unplanned absence from work, including acting as a backup as necessary.

**Min. Qualifications**

* BA/BS in Business Administration or related field, with an MBA preferred.
* Minimum 5-7 years in the role of Managing a Production facility.
* Related experience in the dairy food industry.
* Certifications to include but not limited to CPT, HACCP, OSHA 10-hour, First Aid, CPR and AED.

**Byrne**
Headquartered in LaFayette, Byrne is a Central New York-based dairy company with a legacy spanning over 90 years. Its operations include an extended shelf-life (ESL) and ultra-high temperature (UHT) pasteurization plant in DeWitt, as well as an ESL manufacturing facility in Cortlandville. Byrne also maintains warehouse facilities in Syracuse and East Syracuse, along with a dedicated ice cream center in Syracuse. As a recognized industry leader, Byrne continues to drive innovation at the forefront of dairy processing and product development.

records.description:
ResourceTek is the Human Capital division of Barge Design Solutions, a multi-discipline Engineering and Architecture firm. We specialize in providing technical recruitment and staffing services to industry and government in all areas of Engineering, Information Technology, and a broad range of other technical disciplines.

In partnership with our client, a leading U.S. manufacturer of copper and aluminum building wire and cable, ResourceTek is seeking an experienced, solutions-driven
**Plant Manager**
to join the team at their facility located near
**Jackson, MS**
.

The right candidate will be responsible and accountable for making decisions that affect employee health & safety, employee relations, employee growth & development, facility profitability, quality of products, customer satisfaction, and local/regional community relationships. Develops manufacturing budgets and plans to meet production goals within budget.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Lead all aspects of the manufacturing operations and development activities of the plant to achieve short and long-term goals to meet customer and company expectations.

· Drive world-class processes in the areas of EH&S, developing a solid safety culture within the plant in order to achieve an accident-free work environment, providing prompt and effective action to eliminate unsafe acts or conditions as they become apparent.

· Propose and execute plant operational budgets, capital budgets, sales forecasts and resource requirements.

· Lead the manufacturing functions in the plant on all shifts to ensure on-time production and shipment of conforming products and materials. Including: planning the production flow, troubleshooting manufacturing issues, handling staffing issues, and monitoring production orders and schedules.

· Develop and implement sustainable manufacturing processes needed to manufacture high-quality products on time.

· Identify opportunities for improvement across the plant in relation to process, equipment, facilities and staffing and drive implementation in a spirit of continuous improvement.

· Maintain and control plant inventories to inventory plan to meet anticipated customer demands without excess investment.

· Responsible for the integrity of all the plant-related data and information.

· Continually monitor results achieved in relation to planned goals and undertake necessary corrective action to achieve the desired results.

· Drive the implementation and execution of robust quality systems to ensure product quality meets and exceeds customer expectations.

· Manage plant project list to set priorities and ensure they are completed in a timely manner.

· Develop and engage with all employees in order to develop a favorable employee relations environment and work with staff members on their personal growth and development goals to ensure employees feel encouraged and motivated to contribute at their full potential.

· Provide leadership for problem resolution to facilitate faster improvements and improved working relations.

**REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS**

· Bachelor’s degree in business or engineering preferred

· 10+ years’ experience in manufacturing, including experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

· 5+ years’ manufacturing experience in a process-based environment; wire and cable experience preferred.

· 5+ years manufacturing plant/general management experience

· Extensive and proven experience in Lean Manufacturing, strong track record of leading in a continuous improvement environment.

· Six Sigma / Lean Manufacturing Experience / Training

SKILLS & ABILITIES

· Strong leadership skills and presence

· Demonstrated history of hiring, retaining, and promoting team members

· Ability to build a safety-focused culture that is a great place to work

· Understand the financials of the plant and drive the necessary improvements to achieve and exceed financial and production targets

· Action and solution-oriented leader with strong sense of urgency

· Strong focus on understanding and meeting Customer needs

· Ability to manage multiple priorities

· Ability to build people’s capabilities – Coach and develop teams

· Results oriented with excellent organizational, problem solving, and interpersonal skills

· Seeks out information to understand root causes and drive effective decision-making

· Proven knowledge in budgeting, expense management, and capital equipment analysis

· Knowledge of plant manufacturing systems

· Demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others

· Clear understanding of effective manufacturing practices in the areas of safety, quality, cost, productivity, and delivery

· Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing with customers and employees at all levels

· Computer proficiency (especially MS Office: Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

If you're looking for a stable career with an established manufacturer that values safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement, we encourage you to apply today!

Company offers a competitive salary with
**25% annual bonus**
and a comprehensive benefits package that includes tuition reimbursement, 401k/Roth with company match, and more. Equal Opportunity Employer.

records.description:
**Welcome to Cascades!**
Bring your expertise to a people-first, dynamic environment where your ideas come to life and excellence shapes everything we do.
 
 
Join CHRIS MARTIN EVERETT's team as a
**Plant Manager**
in
**Rockingham**
and help build a more sustainable future.
 
 
**What’s In It For You**
Taking care of our people is in our nature - so you’ll enjoy:
 
 

* Annual salary starting at $160,000
* Profit sharing and an employee share purchase plan
* A full range of benefits: group insurance, telemedicine, and an employer-supported retirement plan
* An annual allowance to spend on goods and services of your choice
* A yearly wellness program and employee assistance program
* A collaborative, respectful, and people-centered workplace

**Your Role**
As
**Plant Manager**
, you’ll take on real challenges that bring out your full potential.
 
 
**Your Scope Includes**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, quality, production, and financial objectives.
* Drive a strong safety culture through visible leadership and accountability.
* Improve reliability through preventive/predictive maintenance, planning, scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Optimize paper machine performance, equipment uptime, productivity, and product quality.
* Manage plant financial performance, including cost per ton, labor, maintenance, fiber, chemical, and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven problem-solving methods.
* Develop and strengthen leadership, technical, and hourly teams.
* Build and execute recovery plans for underperforming operations with measurable business impact

**What You Bring**
You're a natural fit for
**Plant Manager**
if you have:
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing leadership experience in tissue, paper, pulp, or related process industries.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and driving performance improvements.
* Demonstrated success managing operational turnarounds and improving underperforming facilities.
* Strong knowledge of papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, continuous improvement, and plant financial management.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, and drive organizational change.
* Tissue manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
* Progressive leadership experience from Operations/Production Management into Plant or Mill Leadership.
* Track record of improving safety, OEE, uptime, quality, productivity, and cost performance.

If you bring the same care to who you are as to what you do, we’d love to meet you!
 
 
Apply now and join our team as
**Plant Manager**
in
**Rockingham.**
*Cascades values diversity and inclusion and considers all applications equitably. This posting is for an active vacancy within our organization.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**SUMMARY:**
Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.
 
 
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**
:
 
 

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**Language Skills**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**Mathematical Skills**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**Reasoning Ability**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**Technical Skills**
The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:
 
 

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**Physical Demands**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**Leadership Attributes**
The individual must posses the following:
 
 

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**Performance Measurements**
The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:
 
 

* Operating standards - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations**
- through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.
 
 
**Carolina Container Company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.**

records.description:
**Job Description**
Plant Manager Job Description
 
 
New Factory Launch and Steel Products Production
 
 
**Position**
Plant Manager
 
 
**Location**
Texas
 
 
**Focus**
New factory launch
 
 
**Production**
Steel products and roll forming
 
 
**Operating model**
Lean Manufacturing
 
 
**Language**
Bilingual, EnglishChinese speaking preferred
 
 
Position Summary
 
 
At FrameworX, we are accelerating the world’s transition to renewable energy through breakthrough engineering. The Plant Manager will lead the launch and ongoing operation of a new steel products factory in Texas, with an emphasis on roll forming. This leader will build the plant team, establish safe and reliable production, and ramp capacity to meet customer requirements. Lean Manufacturing principles will drive daily decisions, employee engagement, and continuous improvement across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
New Factory Launch
 
 

* Own the integrated factory launch plan, including milestones, staffing, capital spending, operational readiness, and risk mitigation.
* Coordinate facility readiness, equipment installation, commissioning, and production trials with engineering, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Establish plant layouts, material flow, production controls, work instructions, and training before production begins.
* Lead readiness reviews and capacity validation; resolve launch issues and transition the factory from startup to stable production.

Steel Production and Roll Forming
 
 

* Direct daily steel products production, with responsibility for roll forming throughput, quality, schedule attainment, and conversion cost.
* Work with engineering and quality to control coil specifications, tooling alignment, line setup, dimensional tolerances, cut length, and surface condition.
* Improve material yield, reduce scrap and changeover time, and eliminate recurring defects and equipment losses.
* Align production schedules, steel coil inventory, maintenance, and shipping with customer demand; establish preventive maintenance and critical spare parts plans.

Lean Manufacturing and Daily Management
 
 

* Make Lean Manufacturing the daily operating system through tiered accountability meetings, visual performance boards, gemba walks, and leader standard work.
* Review safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people metrics each day; assign countermeasures, owners, and due dates and verify sustained results.
* Apply 5S, standard work, value stream mapping, flow and pull systems, mistake proofing, and quick changeover methods where appropriate.
* Coach employees in structured root cause problem solving and kaizen; build a culture in which teams identify waste and improve their own processes.

Safety People and Business Leadership
 
 

* Set clear safety expectations and ensure effective training, machine guarding, hazardous energy control, and safe coil handling practices.
* Lead production, maintenance, quality, materials, and supporting teams; recruit and develop supervisors and establish clear performance expectations.
* Own plant budgets, labor planning, operating expenses, and capital priorities; use operating data to improve productivity and cost performance.
* Partner with HR, finance, engineering, supply chain, and suppliers to remove constraints and maintain effective communication throughout launch and ongoing operations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience with accountability for plant or major production operations, people, budgets, and performance.
* Experience launching a new factory or leading a major manufacturing startup, including commissioning, workforce readiness, and production ramp-up.
* Strong steel products manufacturing experience, including practical knowledge of roll forming equipment, tooling, process controls, and troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to apply Lean Manufacturing principles through daily management and deliver sustained improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, interpret production and financial data, and communicate clearly with employees and business leaders.
* Minimum 10 years in Plant Leadership role with P&L responsibility
* Posses or ability to get Chinese VISA
* International travel required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Chinese speaking ability is preferred to support communication with Chinese-speaking equipment suppliers and technical partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; Lean or Six Sigma training.

Work Location
 
 
This position is based onsite at the factory in Texas and requires active leadership on the production floor during launch and ongoing operations.
 
 
At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
 
 
Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
 
 
**We are Nextpower**

records.description:
Are you an experienced manufacturing leader ready to make a meaningful impact?
****Revolution****
is seeking a motivated and results-driven Plant Manager to lead operations at our Stuttgart, AR facility. This is an exciting opportunity to guide a high-performing team, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and play a key role in the ongoing success and growth of our operation.
 
 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence every aspect of plant performance, including production, maintenance, quality, safety, and employee development. Your leadership will help foster a culture of operational excellence, teamwork, accountability, and innovation while ensuring we continue to deliver exceptional products and service to our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and are passionate about building strong teams and achieving outstanding results, we encourage you to apply.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead all plant operations, including extrusion, converting, maintenance, quality, and shipping.
* Build and reinforce a safety-first culture with strong accountability and follow-through.
* Drive production performance, efficiency, and waste reduction across all departments.
* Develop and hold accountable a team of salaried department managers and frontline leaders.
* Improve attendance, staffing stability, and workforce engagement.
* Partner with HR, finance, and operations leadership on staffing, cost control, and performance management.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on throughput, scrap reduction, and uptime.
* Oversee and prioritize maintenance strategy and preventive maintenance execution.
* Manage plant-level financial performance, including labor, material usage, and operating costs.
* Support and execute capital projects that improve safety, capacity, and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, Business, or related field (preferred).
* 7–10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience, including multi-shift operations.
* Experience in film extrusion, plastics, or converting environments strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to lead both hourly and salaried teams in a high-volume operation.
* Strong background in Lean, continuous improvement, and performance management.
* Solid financial acumen with experience managing plant-level budgets and cost drivers.
* Demonstrated ability to build teams, drive accountability, and improve culture.

**About Revolution**
**It’s time to redefine possible.**
At Revolution, we exist to empower businesses and consumers to contribute to a better future through sustainable loop plastic solutions. Our unique, circular approach results in sustainable products and services that effectively meet the needs of businesses today, while helping prepare them for tomorrow. And we’re just getting started. Learn more at
**revolutioncompany.com.**

Want to learn more about this role and Jobot? Click our Jobot logo and follow
 
our LinkedIn page!
 
 
 
Job details:
 
**Lead modular manufacturing in Seattle! Solid salary plus bonus, 401(k) match, profit sharing and a mission to build a thriving planet.**
This Jobot Job is hosted by: Julian Okoro
 
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
 
and sending us your resume.
 
Salary: $120,000 - $210,000 per year
 
 
 
**A bit about us:**
We’re working to take the waste and climate harm out of the built environment. Buildings produce nearly 40% of global energy related carbon emissions, and we’re taking that on through renewables and energy services, engineering and design, and construction and facility services. Our Offsite Manufacturing division in Seattle, WA builds modular products, and we’re looking for a hands on Plant Manager to run it.
 
 
 
**Why join us?**

* Medical, dental and vision with low or zero deductible options and low out of pocket maximums
* Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, adoption and IVF assistance, pet insurance and commuter benefits
* Onsite gyms, paid community service time and growth opportunities through our in house university
* Run the whole facility and set the operational direction for a growing modular manufacturing operation that cuts carbon

**Job Details**

* Lead daily plant operations, including production scheduling, workforce management, quality and maintenance, to hit safety, quality, delivery and cost targets
* Build a zero incident safety culture through compliance programs, regular floor walks, incident investigations and follow through on corrective actions
* Own value stream schedules, quality, safety and costs, and partner on budgets, labor planning and variance analysis to protect margins
* Use lean and kaizen to cut waste, shorten cycle times and improve first pass quality on every production line
* Build, coach and hold accountable a high performing team, and work closely with Engineering, Quality, Finance and Supply Chain

Requirements
 

* Bachelor’s in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
* 8 plus years of manufacturing or plant operations leadership, including 3 plus years running a production facility
* Strong background in lean, QMS (ISO 9001 / IATF 16949), 5S, Kaizen, Six Sigma and VSM
* Proven record managing safety programs and lowering TRIR with numbers to show for it
* Strong financial skills (cost variance, capital planning, P&L a plus), comfortable with ERP/MES systems, and experience in regulated manufacturing

Interested in hearing more? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button.
 
 
Jobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide an inclusive work environment that celebrates diversity and all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Jobot also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is Jobot’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.
 
 
Sometimes Jobot is required to perform background checks with your authorization. Jobot will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with any applicable federal, state, or local law regarding criminal backgrounds, including but not limited to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
 
 
Information collected and processed as part of your Jobot candidate profile, and any job applications, resumes, or other information you choose to submit is subject to Jobot's Privacy Policy, as well as the Jobot California Worker Privacy Notice and Jobot Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tools which are available at jobot.com/legal.
 
 
By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Jobot, and/or its agents and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel and HELP for help. You can access our privacy policy here: jobot.com/privacy-policy

records.description:
Want to learn more about this role and Jobot? Click our Jobot logo and follow
 
our LinkedIn page!
 
 
 
Job details:
 
**Lead modular manufacturing in Spokane, WA! Solid salary plus bonus, 401(k) match, profit sharing and a mission to build a thriving planet.**
This Jobot Job is hosted by: Julian Okoro
 
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
 
and sending us your resume.
 
Salary: $120,000 - $190,000 per year
 
 
 
**A bit about us:**
We’re working to take the waste and climate harm out of the built environment. Buildings produce nearly 40% of global energy related carbon emissions, and we’re taking that on through renewables and energy services, engineering and design, and construction and facility services. Our Offsite Manufacturing division in Spokane, WA builds modular products, and we’re looking for a hands on Plant Manager to run it.
 
 
 
**Why join us?**

* Medical, dental and vision with low or zero deductible options and low out of pocket maximums
* Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, adoption and IVF assistance, pet insurance and commuter benefits
* Onsite gyms, paid community service time and growth opportunities through our in house university
* Run the whole facility and set the operational direction for a growing modular manufacturing operation that cuts carbon

**Job Details**

* Lead daily plant operations, including production scheduling, workforce management, quality and maintenance, to hit safety, quality, delivery and cost targets
* Build a zero incident safety culture through compliance programs, regular floor walks, incident investigations and follow through on corrective actions
* Own value stream schedules, quality, safety and costs, and partner on budgets, labor planning and variance analysis to protect margins
* Use lean and kaizen to cut waste, shorten cycle times and improve first pass quality on every production line
* Build, coach and hold accountable a high performing team, and work closely with Engineering, Quality, Finance and Supply Chain

Requirements
 

* Bachelor’s in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
* 8 plus years of manufacturing or plant operations leadership, including 3 plus years running a production facility
* Strong background in lean, QMS (ISO 9001 / IATF 16949), 5S, Kaizen, Six Sigma and VSM
* Proven record managing safety programs and lowering TRIR with numbers to show for it
* Strong financial skills (cost variance, capital planning, P&L a plus), comfortable with ERP/MES systems, and experience in regulated manufacturing

Interested in hearing more? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button.
 
 
Jobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide an inclusive work environment that celebrates diversity and all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Jobot also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is Jobot’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.
 
 
Sometimes Jobot is required to perform background checks with your authorization. Jobot will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with any applicable federal, state, or local law regarding criminal backgrounds, including but not limited to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
 
 
Information collected and processed as part of your Jobot candidate profile, and any job applications, resumes, or other information you choose to submit is subject to Jobot's Privacy Policy, as well as the Jobot California Worker Privacy Notice and Jobot Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tools which are available at jobot.com/legal.
 
 
By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Jobot, and/or its agents and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. records.title: Director Advanced Manufacturing
records.description:
About the company

We're an EV commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Orange County, California. We design and build our medium-duty electric vehicles in-house, and next year's production is already fully sold out.

* 1,000+ vehicles built so far
* A 2,000-vehicle order from one of the largest US parcel carriers, due by end of 2027
* $650M+ raised, including a $200M+ Series recently
* Growing beyond trucks into energy storage, autonomy and defense

The role

We've sold out of trucks, and we don't want it to happen again. We're hiring a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to grow our production capacity and own how we get there.

You'll lead the team that designs, buys and launches our new lines and equipment. Your decisions will show up directly in how many trucks leave the factory each month.

What you'll do

* Lead and grow the advanced manufacturing engineering team
* Own the manufacturing strategy and capital plan for scaling production
* Take new lines and equipment from concept through design, build, install, testing and start of production
* Plan capacity so production keeps ahead of customer demand
* Run equipment and facility projects to budget and schedule, and present them to the executive team
* Work closely with vehicle engineering, supply chain and operations so new designs can be built at volume
* Bring in integrators and equipment suppliers, and manage them through delivery

What you'll bring

**Must have**

* 8+ years in manufacturing engineering, with 4+ years leading teams
* A track record of growing production capacity: new lines, factory expansions or ramping to full rate
* Hands-on experience taking equipment from specification through install, testing and launch
* Experience building and managing capital budgets
* A degree in engineering (mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, chemical or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in EV, automotive, commercial vehicles or batteries. High-volume aerospace, heavy equipment or other complex hardware also welcome.
* Start-up or scale-up experience, ideally through early production and ramp-up
* Experience building a new factory from the ground up

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
**Director of Manufacturing – Defense & Space | Confidential**

Los Angeles, Southern California – onsite

Up to $325K base (negotiable) + equity + benefits

I’m running a confidential search for a Director of Manufacturing at one of the fastest growing companies in the industry building hardware for defense and space programs.

They’ve proven the tech. Now they need someone to scale production and build the team that does it. You’ll own manufacturing end to end, from first build through to rate production, reporting directly to the COO.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead and grow the manufacturing team, including manufacturing engineering and production
* Take hardware from development builds to repeatable rate production
* Set up the factory, tooling, processes and systems to scale
* Work closely with design engineering so new products are built to be built
* Own schedule, cost and quality on the production floor
* Help shape where the factory goes next

**What you’ll bring**

* 8+ years in manufacturing, including time leading teams
* Experience scaling hardware production in aerospace, defense or space
* A track record of building teams and processes at an early-stage company
* Comfort in a fast-moving environment where you’re hands-on and strategic in the same week
* An active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one

**Why this one**

* A seat at the table at a company with real momentum
* Ownership of the whole build, not one piece of it
* The chance to build the team your way

The client’s confidential, but there’s plenty more I can share on a call. If this sounds like you, or someone you know, send me a message.

records.title: Director, Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
We are looking for someone to join our growing team to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, CNC manufacturing turn-key machine tool solutions. This role combines technical leadership, project management, customer engagement, and team development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for taking large, turnkey manufacturing projects from initial customer requirements through engineering development, testing, implementation, and final acceptance. You will lead projects involving a wide range of CNC technologies. You will coordinate internal engineering resources, customers, machine-tool and tooling vendors, partners, and other suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and to the required technical and quality standards. The Director of Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations will be responsible for establishing project priorities, managing expectations, identifying risks, resolving technical and organizational issues, and ensuring successful project outcomes. While this is a leadership and project-management position, a strong understanding of CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing processes, machine tools, and controls is required. The successful candidate should be comfortable engaging deeply with technical teams and making informed decisions on complex manufacturing challenges when required.

**About Empire Dynamics Machinery, LLC**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 10-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers that collectively wants to see change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director will be accountable for ensuring these responsibilities are fulfilled, whether through direct involvement, delegation to existing team members, or the development of additional team capabilities as the business grows. The role requires both hands-on leadership and the ability to build scalable processes, teams, and organizational capabilities.

**Project Management**

* Lead complex, multi-disciplinary CNC manufacturing projects from project initiation through customer acceptance.
* Establish project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, milestones, and priorities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, resource requirements, budgets, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate engineering resources across multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and constraints, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish project priorities and ensure engineering activities remain aligned with customer and business objectives.
* Lead regular project status meetings and communicate project health to customers and internal leadership.
* Manage project changes, scope adjustments, technical issues, and customer requests.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet defined technical and customer requirements.
* Develop project documentation, status reports, action plans, and lesson-learned documentation.
* Establish and improve project management processes, standards, and best practices across the organization.

**CNC Process Engineering Leadership**

* Provide technical direction for the development of comprehensive CNC manufacturing processes.
* Oversee development of CAM programming, tooling strategies, fixturing, workholding, process parameters, and setup documentation.
* Review and approve process plans and CAM development strategies.
* Guide engineers in analyzing critical machining operations for feasibility, efficiency, and optimization.
* Oversee development of stage models, setup sheets, work instructions, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Coordinate tooling suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Support development of process outlines to distribute engineering work effectively across the team.
* Provide technical leadership during machine setup, program verification, and customer program runoff.
* Maintain awareness of current CNC machining technologies and manufacturing practices.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop CNC manufacturing engineers and technical staff.
* Assign project responsibilities based on team capabilities, project requirements, and priorities.
* Establish clear expectations for technical quality, project execution, documentation, and communication.
* Provide technical and professional mentorship to developing engineers.
* Identify training and development opportunities for team members.
* Encourage knowledge sharing and standardization across projects.
* Help establish career-development paths and technical competency expectations for the engineering team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Oversee the development of relationships with tooling manufacturers, machine-tool builders, software providers, and other technical partners.
* Manage vendor activities associated with project tooling, fixturing, machine capabilities, and software requirements.
* Establish technical requirements and deliverables for external suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance against project schedules and requirements.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical or project-related vendor issues.

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE**

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical knowledge to effectively lead highly specialized CNC engineering projects. Experience with the following is highly desirable:

* NX CAM and CNC programming
* CAM programming and toolpath development
* CNC machine tools, including milling, turning, mill-turn, HMC, VTC, grinding, and specialty machines
* CNC machine controls, macros, probing, and advanced machine functions
* CAD modeling
* Cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and machining strategies
* Fixture design and workholding
* Manufacturing process development
* CNC machine commissioning and runoff
* NX CAM templates and productivity environments
* Teamcenter, MRL, and machining data libraries
* Software development or scripting
* Manufacturing engineering and machine-shop operations

The Director is not expected to personally perform every technical task. Rather, the position requires the ability to understand complex technical issues, establish direction, evaluate solutions, allocate resources, and ensure the engineering team delivers the appropriate solution.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, mathematics, manufacturing, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience in CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Strong project planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
* Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

**Preferred**

Experience with:

* Managing complex, customer-facing manufacturing projects.
* Using NX CAM and Siemens manufacturing software.
* Post-processors and CNC controls.
* Leading engineering or technical teams.
* Software development or technical product development.
* Working directly with machine-tool builders, tooling manufacturers, or manufacturing suppliers.
* Developing manufacturing processes for multiple CNC machine types.
* Project management methodologies, scheduling, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Customer acceptance testing and technical implementation projects.

Knowledge of:

* Variety of CNC controllers and willing to learn new controller types
* CNC programming techniques and process
* Feeds, speeds, and cutting tool applications
* Geometry and trigonometry
* Fixture specifications, design, and work holding.

A strong sense of curiosity and problem-solving skills

Demonstrated proficiency interpreting drawing and specification requirements

**Leadership Characteristics**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Ownership: Takes responsibility for project outcomes from initiation through completion.
* Leadership: Provides clear direction while empowering technical experts to perform their best work.
* Customer focus: Understands customer objectives and translates them into practical engineering solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Enjoys learning new technologies, machines, software, and manufacturing processes.
* Communication: Clearly communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and expectations.
* Organization: Can manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams.
* Problem solving: Approaches difficult technical and organizational challenges systematically.
* Continuous improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve both customer solutions and internal processes.
* Accountability: Establishes measurable expectations and follows through on commitments.

**Location**

Albany, New York or Remote.

**Travel Requirements**

20% travel to customer sites, partners, or other business-related travel.

**About Empire Dynamics**

records.title: Director of Operations and Engineering
records.description:
**About SSI**
SS Industries is a Collegeville, PA-based manufacturer of premium Spiral and Floating Stairs. Stairs are designed and manufactured in-house using steel, aluminum, and wood, and shipped directly to customers across the U.S. and Canada. SSI is part of the MBP Group, a family of home-building products companies.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day engineering and manufacturing responsibilities at SSI. This person owns product design/execution, safety, quality, efficiency, on-time delivery, and cost. They build a strong team, keep production running smoothly through busy seasons, and drive continuous improvement.
 
 
In addition, the Director of Operations works with the SSI Leadership Team to develop and implement key company strategic efforts. They work cross-functionally with the other directors to ensure strong business performance.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead a strong safety culture where associates look out for each other and return to their homes safely.
* Own OSHA compliance, safety training, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Work with the Production Manager to ensure maximized capacity, labor, fabrication, welding, and powder coating to achieve communicated lead times, especially during peak seasons.
* Drive the Quality Team to reduce defects, rework, and customer complaints through root cause problem solving.
* Work with Customer Service and Engineering to resolve product issues quickly.
* Identify and lead projects that reduce waste and cost.
* Partner with the Purchasing Team to maintain appropriate inventory levels on raw materials like steel, aluminum, and wood to support production levels.
* Build and manage the Operations Annual Operating Plan and budget.
* Control labor, overtime, materials, and maintenance costs.
* Identify, recommend, and justify capital investments.
* Work closely with the President, Finance and the Commercial teams on forecasts, priorities, and customer commitments.
* Partner with Engineering and Marketing on the development and execution of new products and custom orders.
* Work closely with external vendors and partners to ensure consistent progress.
* Share best practices with operations leaders across the MBP Group.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in operations, with experience leading several departments, such as engineering, quality, production, or supply chain.
* 8+ years of manufacturing experience, with at least 5 years leading plant teams.
* Experience in metal fabrication, welding, or building products manufacturing.
* Strong track record improving safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability to lead and develop supervisors and hourly teams, alike.
* Comfortable developing, reporting, presenting, and leading with data, KPIs, and budgets.
* Strong communication skills at every level of the organization (both internal and external).
* Can scale operations as the company grows.
* Onsite presence in Collegeville, PA

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with engineer-to-order fabrication (architectural metals, stairs and railings, millwork, structural steel or similar) and/or direct-to-consumer manufacturing.
* Has run a P&L or departmental budget and capital projects and has managed through supervisors and managers.
* Experience in a private equity-backed or multi-site company.
* Lean manufacturing experience (5S, value-stream mapping, kaizen). Lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Hands-on approach and comfortability on the shop floor.
* ERP or MRP system experience.
* OSHA 30 certification.

records.title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
records.description:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
 
 
The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Customers, and Platform Engineering to achieve successful product launches.
* Align manufacturing capabilities with customer requirements and growth plans.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
* Lead cost reduction, productivity, yield improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.
* Build a culture of accountability, standardization, and continuous improvement.

**Ownership & Interfaces**
**This Role Owns**

* Manufacturing Engineering
* Process Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Test Engineering
* Test Automation
* Manufacturing readiness
* Factory readiness
* SOPs and engineering standards
* FPY, RTPY, DPPM, productivity, throughput, and operational KPIs
* Manufacturing validation and production ramp execution
* Customer TPM organization

**Partner Organizations**
**Platform Engineering**

* Product architecture and design
* Product specifications and BOM ownership
* DFM/DFA approval
* Product validation and qualification
* Design changes and reliability engineering
* Level 3 debugging, root cause analysis, and technical solution development

**Customers**

* Product requirements
* Acceptance criteria
* Product roadmap priorities
* Qualification and approval requirements

**Key Metrics**

* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
* DPPM
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Productivity and labor efficiency
* Manufacturing cycle time
* Automation ROI
* NPI launch success
* Customer satisfaction
* Global standards adoption

**Qualifications**

* BS in Engineering required; MS/MBA preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
* Proven success in high-volume electronics, server, rack integration, or data center manufacturing environments.
* Strong customer-facing leadership skills.
* Demonstrated track record improving FPY, RTPY, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
* Lean Six Sigma and global manufacturing experience preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**
A strategic and hands-on engineering leader capable of building a world-class global manufacturing engineering organization that delivers scalable NPI execution, advanced automation, operational excellence, and industry-leading quality for hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure products.
 
 
**About ZT Systems**
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining.
 
 
A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.
 
 
Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.
 
 
**What We Offer**
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.
 
 
**Compensation & Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based annual bonus eligibility
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health & Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs-
 
 

* Company-paid life and disability insurance

**Time Away & Work-Life Balance**

* Paid time off (PTO) and company-paid holidays
* Parental leave and family care support programs

**Growth & Purpose**

* Structured training programs and on-the-job learning opportunities
* Matching gifts and volunteer programs to support causes you care about

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location. Learn more about our benefits here.
 
 
ZT Group Int’l. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. ZT Systems provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
 
 
Please be aware that certain positions may require the applicant to either 1) be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
 
 

* 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
* 1158, or 2) be eligible to obtain an export control license or license exception from the Bureau of Industry and Science & U.S. Department of Commerce. All offers of employment will be conditional subject to the foregoing.
