records.title: Director, Industrial Engineering & Automation
records.description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Director, Head of Industrial Engineering & Automation to lead the evolution of our Authentication Center network infrastructure, across technical design, engineering, and optimization of the physical operating systems across Inbound and Outbound Operations. In this strategic operational leadership role, you will own the industrial engineering discipline across the network, including process engineering, labor standards, material flow, facility/process design, automation and robotics engineering, material handling equipment, and reliability.
 
 
Working in partnership with Operations Strategy, Enablement, Product & Technology, and functional Operations leaders, this role translates strategic priorities and target business outcomes into technically sound process, infrastructure, and automation solutions that can be effectively implemented, scaled, and sustained across the network. From advancing large-scale material handling solutions and conveyance for Outbound (fulfillment) to introducing autonomous robotic movement and optimizing specialized intake workflows for Inbound (listing services), you will drive the next generation of our product handling and movement capabilities. You will directly manage a team of Industrial and Process Engineers and a team of MHE maintenance personnel, serving as a key bridge between technical vendors, operational teams, and internal technology leadership.
 
 
**What You Get To Do Every Day**

* Engineering Capacity & Infrastructure Planning: Provide the engineering inputs required for long-range capacity and network planning, including process capability, equipment capacity, space/layout requirements, material-flow constraints, automation opportunities, and capital requirements. Partner with Operations Strategy to translate supply, demand, and capacity scenarios into technical infrastructure solutions.
* Facility & Material Flow Engineering: Design and optimize the physical flow of product, people, equipment, and work across TRR facilities. Develop scalable layouts, workstation designs, storage strategies, conveyance approaches, and other infrastructure solutions that improve throughput, space utilization, ergonomics, safety, and operating efficiency.
* Network Industrial Engineering Strategy: Own TRR’s IE standards and technical methods across sites, including engineered labor standards, time and methods studies, process capability, workflow design, ergonomics, material flow, workstation/layout design, and technical productivity standards; delivering continuous improvement network-wide.
* Outbound Automation & Robotics: Direct the implementation, optimization, and scaling of Outbound fulfillment systems, including automated storage, conveyance networks, and packing processes.
* Inbound & Specialized Process Innovation: Engineer and deploy the physical-process and automation solutions supporting Inbound modernization efforts, driving the integration of autonomous robotic vehicles (AMRs/AGVs), optimized material flows, and photography equipment optimization.
* Team Leadership & Capacity Building: Mentor, build, and lead a high-performing organization of Industrial Engineers, Process Engineers, and MHE Maintenance personnel, balancing strategic project execution with day-to-day equipment uptime and reliability.
* Vendor & Technical Integration: Partner with 3rd-party automation vendors, equipment OEMs, and software providers. Support RFP processes, system integration testing, contract negotiations, and project commissioning.
* MHE Reliability & Lifecycle Management: Establish maintenance, reliability, uptime, preventive maintenance, spare-parts, and lifecycle standards for MHE and automation assets. Own technical performance and reliability targets and partner with site Operations to ensure equipment supports required throughput and service levels.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Trust: Build deep trust and strategic alignment across Operations, Facilities, Technology/Product, and Finance to ensure automation and process improvement projects seamlessly integrate into daily operations.
* Engineering Economics & Technical Evaluation: Develop the technical assumptions, productivity standards, capacity impacts, capital requirements, implementation costs, reliability assumptions, and engineering economics required to evaluate automation and infrastructure investments. Partner with Operations Strategy and Finance to develop and validate the full business case and track realized operating performance.

**What You Bring To The Role**
Minimum Requirements:
 
 

* Education & Experience: BS/MS in Industrial, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering with 10+ years leading IE, robotics, and automation in fulfillment and production networks.
* Robotics & Process Design: Deep technical expertise in ASRS, high-speed conveyance, AMRs/AGVs, and hands-on design of optimized manual and automated workflows.
* Vendor Management: Strong track record negotiating contracts and managing technical 3rd-party MHE, robotics, and software vendors.
* Influence: Exceptional executive presence and communication skills with a proven ability to build trust, align goals, and collaborate across front-line operations, tech teams, and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, client-focused organization with unique physical inventory

Preferred Requirements:
 
 

* Experience with single sku and/ or luxury inventory a plus
* Ability to travel up 30%

**Compensation, Benefits, + Perks**

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* 401K with Company Match
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Paid Parental Leave
* 9 Paid Company Holidays
* Flexible Time Off (With Manager Approval)
* Find out more about our Benefits here.

The expected salary range for this role is $-$. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.
 
 
The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.
 
 
The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.
 
 
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
The
**Director, Manufacturing Engineering**
provides functional and strategic leadership for the manufacturing engineering organization, accountable for process capability, producibility, and product quality across production programs. This role leads a team of managers and engineers responsible for developing, deploying, and continuously improving manufacturing, test, and related industrial engineering processes to meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people objectives in
**Baltimore, MD**
.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Functional & People Leadership

+ Lead and develop a high‑performing manufacturing engineering organization, including managers, engineers, and supporting staff.
+ Define and maintain functional standards, methods, tools, and best practices for manufacturing engineering across the site or business.
+ Recruit, develop, and retain talent; drive succession planning, leadership development, and engagement/inclusion activities.
+ Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development for managers and engineers.

* Manufacturing Engineering Ownership

+ Own manufacturing engineering processes from new product introduction through sustainment, ensuring robust process controls, standard work, and documented work instructions.
+ Direct the creation and maintenance of MBOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling, and strategies that enable safe, efficient, and high‑quality production.
+ Drive producibility into designs by partnering with Design Engineering early in the lifecycle; ensure effective transition to production and rate readiness.
+ Establish and manage key performance indicators (yields, scrap, rework, cycle time, labor efficiency) and drive continuous improvement using data‑driven methods.

* Operations, Quality, and Continuous Improvement

+ Partner closely with Operations, Quality & Mission Excellence, and Supply Chain to ensure stable processes and timely resolution of production issues.
+ Oversee manufacturing engineering participation in MRB and nonconformance disposition; ensure effective root‑cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
+ Champion initiatives to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
+ Lead manufacturing engineering support to factory readiness, capacity planning, and rate ramp‑ups.

* Program, Financial, and Strategic Management

+ Align functional objectives, resources, and priorities with program and business needs; balance near‑term execution with long‑term capability development.
+ Partner with Program Management and Business Management to support bids, proposals, and program execution, including manufacturing scope, risk, and cost/schedule inputs.
+ Own manufacturing engineering budgets (labor, capital, and expense) and apply sound financial management.
+ Develop and execute technology roadmaps and capital investment plans for manufacturing processes, equipment, and facilities.

* Compliance, Governance, and Stakeholder Management

+ Ensure manufacturing engineering processes comply with regulatory requirements, customer standards, and internal procedures.
+ Represent manufacturing engineering in internal and external reviews, audits, and customer engagements.
+ Build strong relationships with sector/site leadership, program teams, and functional peers to drive alignment and resolve cross‑functional constraints.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 10 or more years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 8 or more years of relevant experience.
* 3 or more years of functional management experience leading organizations of at least 100 employees.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing/production, operations, program management, testing, or a related area, including direct leadership of engineers and/or first‑line managers.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing or production engineering supporting complex hardware (e.g., aerospace, defense, electronics, or similar).
* Proven track record of improving manufacturing and test processes, yields, cycle times, and product quality using data and metrics.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing process controls, quality systems, and relevant industry/regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated financial acumen including budgets, rates, and cost management
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present technical and operational content to leadership and customers.
* U.S. citizenship and an ability to obtain U.S. Government Secret security clearance or greater; OR DoE equivalent or greater

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Experience in a Director or senior manager role leading a manufacturing engineering or test engineering organization in an aerospace/defense or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience working across multiple disciplines (design, manufacturing, and test engineering) with a strong focus on product development, producibility, and transition to production.
* Hands‑on experience with continuous improvement frameworks
* Experience managing capital equipment roadmaps and facilities upgrades to support long‑term manufacturing capacity and capability.
* Proven ability to build and develop high‑performing teams, including succession planning, leadership development, and engagement initiatives.
* Experience supporting proposals and customer reviews, including articulation of manufacturing engineering approaches, risks, and mitigations.
* Experience working in a matrixed organization, balancing program demands with functional standards and development needs.

Primary Level Salary Range: $194,600.00 - $292,000.00
 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

records.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Global Innovation, oversees performance management, operational excellence, and strategic execution for manufacturing entities across Asia, including Vietnam, China, and South Korea. Serves as a key liaison between headquarters and regional production sites, driving data‑driven decision‑making, productivity improvements, and process standardization.
 
 
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Management & Financial Oversight
* Monitor and evaluate the operational and financial performance of manufacturing subsidiaries in Asia
* Develop and manage KPIs
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with regional leadership
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans
* Strategic Planning & Execution
* Formulate mid- to long-term manufacturing and supply chain strategies aligned with global business objectives
* Support capacity planning, cost optimization, and footprint strategy (e.g., China+1, nearshoring)
* Conduct market and operational feasibility analysis for new investments or expansions
* Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across production sites (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen)
* Standardize processes and implement best practices across regions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Procurement, Logistics, Quality, R&D) to improve end-to-end efficiency
* HQ–Regional Coordination
* Act as the primary liaison between HQ and Asia manufacturing teams
* Ensure alignment on corporate policies, reporting standards, and operational priorities
* Facilitate communication, issue resolution, and project execution across time zones
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting systems for real-time performance tracking
* Analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights and executive-level reports
* Support digital transformation initiatives (ERP, MES, data integration)

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred)
* 7–10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or operations strategy roles
* Proven experience managing or overseeing operations in Asia (Vietnam, China, Korea preferred)
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI/Tableau, or similar tools
* Deep understanding of manufacturing KPIs and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Multilingual capability (Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese is a plus)
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to travel internationally (20–40%)

**Benefits**

* Premium Medical Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Savings Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) based on seniority
* Paid Holidays

**Additional Workplace Offerings (subject To Change Or Eligibility.)**

* Annual Bonus Plan
* Onsite Employee Fitness Center with Indoor Racquetball Court and Yoga Room
* Summer Fridays
* Complimentary Gourmet Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
* Relocation Support for New Hires
* Work Anniversary Recognitions
* Congratulatory & Condolence Gifts
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* License/Certification Reimbursements
* Corporate Employee Discounts
* Visa Sponsorships (100% paid by the company) i.e., New H-1B, H-1B Transfer, O-1, and Green Card
* Commuter Support (Shuttle Bus Program and EZPass Support)
* Vehicle Perks

**Qualification(s)**
**Education(s):**
Bachelor of Science (B.S) (Required)
 
 
**Work Experience**
Experience Range V: +13 years of relevant experience or industry exposure in a related field
 
 
**Skill(s)**
Lean Process Improvements, Manufacturing, Operational Strategies, Six Sigma Framework, Supply Chain
 
 
**Language(s)**
English, Korean
 
 
**Certification(s)**
Not Applicable
 
 
The anticipated compensation range is
 
 
91,000.00 - 172,000.00 USD Annual
 
 
Actual compensation will be determined based on various factors including qualifications, education, experience, and location. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

(collectively, the “Company”) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

records.title: Senior Manager Production
records.description:
**Career Area**
Manufacturing
 
 
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 
Caterpillar is seeking a
**Senior Manager Production**
to provide senior leadership for production operations at our Griffin Engine Packaging Plant. This role serves as a key production leader responsible for overseeing genset and power module manufacturing operations in a fast-paced, high-velocity production environment.
 
 
As the leader of a team consisting of seven direct-report supervisors and multiple indirect reports, you will drive operational performance across safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives while creating an environment focused on employee development and operational excellence.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to lead large-scale power systems production operations, overseeing products ranging from approximately 400 kVA to 4 MW. The successful candidate will champion a safety-first culture, support lean manufacturing initiatives, and provide leadership for day-to-day operational execution and continuous improvement efforts.
 
 
How You Will Make an Impact
 
 

* Safety-Driven Culture - Lead with a safety-first mindset and drive a culture where safety is the top operational priority.
* Operational Excellence - Deliver strong manufacturing performance through effective management of safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* People Leadership and Development - Develop, coach, and support leaders while building organizational capability across the production team.
* Lean Manufacturing Leadership - Champion lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance.
* Large-Scale Power Systems Production - Provide leadership for genset and power module production operations supporting a complex manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities Include**

* Leading production operations within a high-velocity manufacturing environment.
* Driving safety performance and fostering a safety-first culture throughout the organization.
* Managing competing priorities related to safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
* Leading employee development activities and performance management processes.
* Resolving day-to-day operational escalations and manufacturing challenges.
* Supporting lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Overseeing genset and power module production operations.; emphasis on NPI operational support (i.e headcount, capacity planning, etc...)

Degree Requirement
 
 
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
 
 
**What Skills You Will Have**
**Production Training:**
Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools and techniques for delivering formal and informal training on the safe and efficient operation of production machinery; ability to conduct effective formal and situation-specific training.
 
 
**Problem Solving:**
Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations
 
 
**Influencing:**
Extensive knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.
 
 
**Flexibility and Adaptability:**
Extensive knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change.
 
 
**Performance Management:**
Extensive knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.
 
 
**Analytical Thinking:**
Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
 
 
**Planning and Organizing:**
Extensive knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
 
 
**Effective Communications:**
Extensive understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
 
 
**Leadership & People Management:**
Extensive understanding of the techniques and skills needed to lead in the production environment; with the demonstrated ability to develop talent using performance management techniques
 
 
Top Candidates Will Also Have
 
 

* Experiences as a leader of leaders; specifically in cross-functional teams with support staff
* Manufacturing experience in the product producing environment; preference for heavy equipment, automotive, aerospace, rail, or other closely related industries.
* Examples of contributing to or leading manufacturing process transformation
* LEAN/Six Sigma Certification.

Additional Information
 
 

* Location: Griffin, Georgia
* Work Arrangement: Onsite
* Relocation: Available
* Travel: Less than 10%
* Sponsorship: Not available

**Summary Pay Range**
$147,760.00 - $221,640.00
 
 
Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.
 
 
**Benefits**
Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.
 
 

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits\*
* Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\*
* 401(k) savings plans\*
* Health Savings Account (HSA)\*
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\*
* Health Lifestyle Programs\*
* Employee Assistance Program\*
* Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\*
* Career Development\*
* Incentive bonus\*
* Disability benefits
* Life Insurance
* Parental leave
* Adoption benefits
* Tuition Reimbursement
* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
 
 
Relocation is available for this position.
 
 
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
 
 
**Posting Dates**
November 11, 2026 - November 18, 2026
 
 
Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.
 
 
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
 
 
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

records.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**Job Description**
Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.
 
 
The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.
 
 
**What You'll Do**
Development Program Materials Planning
 
 

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness
 
 

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership
 
 

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI**
At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.

records.title: Senior Manager of Operations
records.description:
**Senior Manager of Operations - Austin, TX**

**DESCRIPTION:**

We’re seeking a hands-on Sr. Operations Manager with experience scaling silicon-based products in a semiconductor company. This player-coach role owns the operational path from foundry and wafer production through test, backend processing, and manufacturing. You’ll qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, establish and strengthen quality-control measures, and drive consistent quality, yield, cost, and delivery as production grows.

Experience with RFID inlay production is especially relevant.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own foundry relationships from negotiation through production execution, and scale wafer level production.
* Manage wafer-test facility relationships; evaluate and qualify test partners, and select test equipment to optimize cost, quality, and throughput.
* Lead test development, wafer backend operations, yield improvement, reliability, and failure analysis.
* Qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, including overseeing end-to-end inlay production and its ramp to volume.
* Establish and improve quality-control measures, operating procedures, and RMA processes.
* Monitor supplier quality, conduct supply-chain audits, and resolve manufacturing, quality, and delivery issues.
* Establish and improve ERP/MRP processes, WIP tracking, inventory planning, and production controls.
* Develop cost models, negotiate contracts, and drive improvements in cost, quality, and delivery.
* Manage one direct report and coordinate work across four internal engineers and executive stakeholders, including the CEO.

**What you’ll bring:**

* BSEE or equivalent practical experience.
* 7–10 years of operations, manufacturing, or related experience in a semiconductor company.
* Experience with RFID inlay manufacturing is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with silicon-based products and semiconductor manufacturing operations.
* Experience scaling products from wafer fabrication and test through backend processing and volume production.
* Experience working with foundries, wafer-test facilities, and manufacturing vendors.
* Familiarity with yield optimization, reliability, quality assurance, supplier audits, failure analysis, ERP/MRP systems, WIP tracking, and inventory planning.
* Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, with a practical, roll-up-your sleeves approach.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
records.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.
 
 
For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.
 
 
At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.
 
 
We are looking for a S
**r. Manager, Quality**
to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to
**Director of Quality**
and based in
**Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week**
.
 
 
**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.
* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.
* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.
* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.
* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.
* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.
* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.
* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.
* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.
* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.
* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.
* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.
* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.
* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.
* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)
* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.
* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.
* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.
* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.
* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.
* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.
* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.
* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.
* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .
* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.
* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up
* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.
* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)
* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)
* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.
* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.
* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.
* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.
* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.
* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.
* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).
* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.
* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.
* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.
* Possess a passion for excellence.
* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.
* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.
* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. records.title: Senior Manager, Quality System & Compliance
records.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.
 
 
Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.
 
 
As the
**Senior Manager of Quality System and Quality (Regulatory) Compliance**
, you are a pivotal leader responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our Quality Management System (QMS), oversight, and associated tools. You will lead our efforts to ensure robust compliance with national and international medical device regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP. This role is a unique blend of strategic foresight and tactical leadership, requiring a deep expertise in QMS setup and management, particularly for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), with ability to make thoughtful changes and enhance the overall QMS.
 
 
You will lead a high-performing team of quality professionals , championing a "Quality-first" culture and driving data-driven decisions. Your proven track record of navigating complex regulatory landscapes, including
**FDA, PMDA, IEC, EU MDR, and ISO regulations and standards**
, is essential to our success.
 
 
Job Responsibilities:
 
 
Quality Management System (QMS) Oversight
 
 

* Manage holistic aspects of the QMS to ensure compliance with global regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP countries’ requirements.
* Oversee the following key QMS subsystems: CAPA subsystem, Document Control, Training, Management Review, Internal Audits, and External Audit management, QMS Tool Validation, and Supplier Management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the QMS.

Quality Compliance & Audits
 
 

* Serve as the front room or backroom lead and the primary subject matter expert (SME) for the QMS during audits, including inspections by the FDA, Notified Bodies, and other regulatory authorities.
* Prepare the organization for an appropriate level of quality compliance to U.S. and international requirements to support Heartflow’s global expansion.

Strategic Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Lead, mentor, and scale a team of QMS professionals, fostering career growth and technical excellence.
* Champion a "Quality-first" mindset throughout the organization, through collaboration and using impactful KPIs to drive accountability and data-driven decisions.
* Collaborate with leaders and partners in R&D, Production, Regulatory, Clinical, and Product Management to integrate quality processes seamlessly, balancing compliance with business objectives.
* Manage departmental resources, including headcount and long-term strategic planning.

Skills Needed:
 
 

* Effective, clear, and concise communication skills bringing clarity to complex topics across the leadership spectrum.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and drive a collaborative quality culture through influence.
* Deep understanding of Quality System and Quality Compliance.
* Experience interacting with auditors, including Notified Body auditors and FDA Investigators.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality within the medical device industry, with at least 5+ years in a leadership/management role.
* Expert-level knowledge of relevant regulations and standards, including FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of successfully leading or playing a key SME role in regulatory inspections (FDA, Notified Body).
* Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and build consensus among cross-functional senior leaders.

Preferred:
 
 

* Direct experience with AI/ML-driven SaMD and cloud-based medical device platforms.
* Familiarity with medical device cybersecurity standards (e.g., AAMI TIR57) and data privacy regulations.
* Experience with global regulatory submissions (e.g., CE Marking, PMDA).
* Experience implementing and scaling quality processes in a fast-paced and growing environment.

This position has an estimated base salary of $195,000 - $250,000, bonus, and equity. ; LI-Hybrid
 
 
Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at Heartflow, including recruitment, hiring, training, relocation, promotion, and termination.
 
 
Positions posted for Heartflow are not intended for or open to third party recruiters / agencies. Submission of any unsolicited resumes for these positions will be considered to be free referrals.
 
 
Heartflow has become aware of a fraud where unknown entities are posing as Heartflow recruiters in an attempt to obtain personal information from individuals as part of our application or job offer process. Before providing any personal information to outside parties, please verify the following: A) all legitimate Heartflow recruiter email addresses end with “@heartflow.com” and B) the position described is found on our careers site at www.heartflow.com/about/careers/.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP)
records.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.
 
 
At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team
**,**
fostering a strong sense of belonging.
 
 
Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
 
 
Site: www.ptcbio.com
 
 
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP) is responsible for managing GxP Quality Assurance (QA) functions with an emphasis on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance for development products. This involves engaging and collaborating with cross-functional internal and external teams to evaluate processes, procedures, and activities for adherence to relevant industry standards, regulatory guidelines, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
The incumbent will support and/or conduct internal and external GCP audits of investigator sites, vendors, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, and submission documents, etc.
 
 
She/He will assist in inspection readiness activities.
 
 
She/He may manage direct reports.
 
 
The incumbent works cross-functionally with internal departments and external resources on GxP QA related issues.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance – GxP (GCP)supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Partners with Clinical Development/Operations and actively participates in clinical study teams to ensure GCP compliance. Assists in identifying and communicating clinical trial-related risks and opportunities for process improvement. Reviews study-related documents and plans.
* Performs internal and external audits as assigned to ensure compliance with GXP regulations and guidelines.
* Communicates audit results to internal stakeholders and writes audit report.
* Assesses audit responses and ensures closure of corrective action preventative actions (CAPAs).
* Leads backroom activities during regulatory authority inspections and assists with GxP inspection readiness activities.
* Supports Quality Management System (QMS) including, but not be limited to, the following activities:
* QA review/approval of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.
* Drafts, reviews, and approves SOPs.
* May manage, coach, and mentor direct reports.
* Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance or related role in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related environment.
 
 

* Detailed knowledge and understanding of GCP regulations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and/or conducting QA audits.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal staff as well as with external, third-party vendors.
* Demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring direct reports.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency inspections.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
* Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

**Special Knowledge Or Skills And/or Licenses Or Certificates Preferred.**

* Experience writing and reviewing SOPs.
* Clinical lab experience.
* Registered GxP Quality Assurance Certifications.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) inspections.
* Knowledge and experience in Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and/or Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) regulations.

*Travel requirements: Up to 30% (Domestic and International)*
*Expected Base Salary Range: $141,900 -$175,000. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.*
*In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans*
**EEO Statement**
**PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.**

records.description:
**POSITION DETAILS**
Job Title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance, Regulatory & Compliance
 
 
Location: Yonkers, NY (Hybrid or Remote w/ Travel)
 
 
Reports To: Sr. Director, Supply Chain
 
 
Compensation: $120,000 to $130,000
 
 
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical
**Senior Manager, Quality Assurance, Regulatory & Compliance**
to lead our global quality and compliance functions. As a rapidly growing hair care brand, we require a hands-on leader to ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and legal compliance across all global markets.
 
 
In this role, you will own the end-to-end quality control lifecycle, from raw material qualification to finished goods distribution, while serving as our internal subject matter expert for global cosmetic regulations. You will play a critical role in managing our compliance with the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) in the US, as well as maintaining active registrations and compliance in the EU, UK, and other international markets.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Regulatory Compliance**

* MoCRA & FDA Leadership: Serve as the designated "Responsible Person" (or primary liaison) to ensure full compliance with MoCRA requirements, including facility registrations, product listings, safety substantiation, and fragrance allergen disclosures.
* International Market Registrations: Lead and maintain product registrations across global portals, including the EU Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP), UK Submit Cosmetic Product Notification (SCPN), and Health Canada.
* Claims Substantiation & Labeling: Serve as the definitive regulatory authority for product marketing and packaging. Collaborate with Marketing, Legal, and Product Development to ensure all packaging artwork, ingredient lists (INCI), and warnings comply strictly with FDA and international standards. Maintain ownership of the testing matrix and claims substantiation repository, establishing a mandatory QA/Regulatory approval gate for all technical data prior to market release.
* Adverse Event Management: Oversee the adverse event reporting system; manage serious adverse event reporting timelines, maintain recordkeeping, and ensure root-cause investigations are conducted.
* Regulatory Intelligence: Monitor shifting regulatory landscapes (e.g., Prop 65, volatile organic compounds (VOC) restrictions for aerosols, state-level bans) and proactively update internal formulations and policies to mitigate risk.

**End-to-End Quality Control & Assurance**

* CMO & Supplier Management: Audit, qualify, and manage third-party contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), raw material suppliers, and packaging vendors. Ensure alignment with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and ISO 22716 standards.
* Product Testing & Release: Oversee stability, compatibility, and microbiological testing protocols for new and existing hair care formulations. Review and approve Certificates of Analysis (COAs), batch records, and retain samples
* Packaging Compatibility & Structural Testing: Lead Package Compatibility Testing (PCT), E&L studies, and structural assessments (e.g., torque, seal, barrier). Ensure all packaging meets ISTA transit standards and maintains integrity with complex hair care formulations like aerosols and surfactants.
* Issue Resolution: Lead root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and Out of Specification (OOS) investigations. Make critical disposition decisions regarding product approvals, quarantines, or rejections.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, scale, and maintain internal QMS documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), finished product specifications, and quality agreements with external partners.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* New Product Development (NPD): Act as the regulatory and quality gatekeeper during the R&D and commercialization phases. Advise on ingredient restrictions and formulation safety.
* Team Development: Manage and mentor quality coordinators or specialists. Provide training to cross-functional teams (Operations, Customer Service) on regulatory requirements and quality standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biology, Regulatory Affairs, or a related scientific discipline. Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience: 7–10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs within the CPG industry, specifically in cosmetics, personal care, or hair care.
* Regulatory Expertise: Deep, demonstrated understanding of US FDA cosmetic regulations (MoCRA), EU CosReg, UK regulations, and global compliance frameworks.
* Quality Systems: Strong background in cGMP, ISO standards (e.g., ISO 22716), ISTA transit testing, and handling FDA inspections or third-party audits.
* Hair Care Knowledge: Familiarity with hair care specific formulation challenges, including emulsions, surfactants, aerosols (VOC compliance), and clinical testing for hair claims.
* Skills: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and balance risk-management with commercial business goals.

**Preferred Experience**

* eQMS Implementation: Proven experience selecting, implementing, or migrating electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) such as MasterControl, Veeva, or TrackWise, as well as integrating quality modules within ERPs like NetSuite or SAP.
* Advanced Formulation Expertise: Direct experience managing compliance and quality control for Over-the-Counter (OTC) monographs (e.g., dandruff shampoos, minoxidil hair growth treatments), continuous mist aerosols, or professional-grade salon chemical treatments.
* Retailer & Clean Beauty Standards: Deep understanding of specialized retailer compliance frameworks, such as "Clean at Sephora," Target Clean, or Credo Beauty guidelines, and experience managing the formulation and documentation required to meet them.
* Professional Certifications: Active Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or American Society for Quality (ASQ) certifications, such as Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Manager of Quality (CMQ/OE).
* Sustainability & ESG: Experience guiding quality and regulatory practices for sustainability initiatives, such as achieving B-Corp certification, managing PCR material tracking, or navigating extended producer responsibility (EPR) packaging laws.

**SCOPE OF DECISION-MAKING**
**Autonomous Decisions (Direct Authority)**

* Product Disposition: Final authority to release, quarantine, or reject finished goods and raw materials based on test results, COAs, and quality standards.
* Compliance Sign-Off: Sole approval authority on ingredient lists (INCI), regulatory packaging warnings, and safety substantiation prior to printing or market launch.
* Supplier Qualification: Authority to approve, conditionally approve, or disqualify contract manufacturers (CMOs), packaging vendors, and raw material suppliers based on audit results and cGMP compliance.
* CAPA & Investigations: Direct control over resolving Out of Specification (OOS) investigations, determining root causes, and enforcing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) with internal teams and external vendors.
* SOP Enforcement: Authority to implement, update, and enforce Quality Management System (QMS) policies and standard operating procedures across the organization.

**Collaborative & Escalated Decisions (Advisory Role)**

* Product Recalls & Withdrawals: Lead the initial risk assessment and data gathering for potential safety issues, but escalate final recall execution and communication strategies to Executive Leadership and Legal.
* New Market Entry: Advise the Executive team on the regulatory feasibility, costs, and timeline of entering new international markets (e.g., reformulations needed, registration hurdles).
* Marketing Claims: Partner with Legal and Marketing to negotiate and finalize high-risk product claims (e.g., "clinically proven," "hair growth"), balancing commercial goals with regulatory constraints.
* Major Capital Expenditures: Recommend investments in enterprise quality software (eQMS) or third-party laboratory partnerships for executive budget approval.

**Build Our Future Together**
Regeneron is currently seeking a Senior Manager, Medical Device Quality Assurance (QA) to join our Medical Device QA team. This expanded leadership role will provide QA oversight across two critical functions: Combination Products Sustaining Engineering and Compliance. The position will lead a team of engineers and quality specialists.
 
 
**When & Where**

* Location: East Greenbush, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm

**Discover Your Role**

* Manage, mentor, and develop quality engineering and compliance teams
* Standardize, streamline, and improve processes across sustaining and compliance
* Implement digital, data-driven tools for accurate, consistent, and timely reporting
* Lead teams through complex, ambiguous challenges in a pharmaceutical/medical device environment
* Sustaining Engineering Support:

+ Support sustaining engineering programs through risk assessment, design change management, and maintenance of the Design History File and Risk Management File
+ Advice and actively participate in Design Reviews associated with combination products
+ Provide QA and technical support to quality engineers and project teams during ongoing maintenance of the combination product
+ Interact with partners and contract organizations to ensure accurate completion of project milestones, including post-commercialization activities

* Combination Product Support:

+ Act as Management Representative for the combination products QMS; own policies and procedures
+ Support regulatory inspections and partner audits for combination products
+ Keep the QMS current and inspection-ready via monitoring, gap assessments, and updates

**This Role Requires**

* BS in Engineering and 8+ years of experience; including combination product or medical device experience; or equivalent combination of education & experience
* Previous supervisory/ people leadership experience
* Knowledge of the combination device development and lifecycle process

#REGNQA

**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
**Division/Site Specific Information**
Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.
 
 
**Discover Impactful Work:**
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
 
 
A Day in the Life:
 
 

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**
**Education/Experience**

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.
 
 
**Compensation And Benefits**
The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.
 
 
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:
 
 

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

records.title: Sr Manager Quality Systems
records.description:
The Senior Manager, Quality Systems is responsible for leading and enhancing the organization's quality systems to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and standards. This role oversees key quality systems including deviation management, CAPA, change control, training, document control, and audit readiness. The position plays a strategic role in driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of quality across the Global Development Organization (GDO) and across GDO supporting functional departments.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Lead and manage the development, implementation, and maintenance of core quality systems (QMS).
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment of quality systems with GDO operational needs; serves as QA Lead and system owner for Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, Training and Document Management processes.
* Author and approve SOPs, policies, and training materials related to quality systems.
* Ensure alignment of procedural documents across GDO and compliance with applicable GxP regulations and internal standards/requirements where applicable.
* This role participates in internal and external audits as assigned and supports regulatory inspections.
* Lead risk assessments and quality impact evaluations for system changes. Drive continuous improvement initiatives; Lean Six Sigma or similar methodology are a plus.
* Develop and monitor quality metrics and KPIs; report trends at Management Review and ad hoc when critical/major quality events arise to leadership.
* Collaborates with a team of professionals and external parties to ensure compliance and audits are completed; Travel requirement is 15%

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or related field; certification in biologics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and/or Quality Management is a plus.
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Quality Assurance within a regulated industry.
* Experience with electronic QMS platforms; proven skills and proficiency of quality systems and working in a globally hybrid team atmosphere.
* Strong knowledge of FDA, EMA, ICH guidelines and GxP principles. Familiarity with data governance and digital quality systems.
* Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capability; excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive change; effective communications with technical and non-technical colleagues; experience establishing and maintaining effective relationships with leaders and peers.
* Demonstrated capability as organizational change agent; experience in leading and participating in global teams with shared responsibility for outcomes and decision-making.

The presently-anticipated base compensation pay range for this position is $137,000 to $167,500. Actual base compensation may vary based on a number of factors, including but not limited to geographical location and experience. In addition, this position is part of the Annual Performance Bonus Plan. Employees are eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs which include medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; and the employee assistance program. Employees also receive various paid time off benefits, including vacation time and sick time.
 
 
The compensation and benefits described above are subject to the terms and conditions of any governing plans, policies, practices, agreements, or other materials or documents as in effect from time to time, including but not limited to terms and conditions regarding eligibility. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company, or individual department/team performance, and market factors.
