External Applicant link Internal Applicant link

\*If you are hired by WMCHealth, your final base salary will be determined based on job-related factors, including employment status (full-time, part-time or per diem), relevant skills, qualifications and experience. Consistent with our commitment to pay equity, we also consider internal equity among similarly situated employees when determining final compensation.

 

### **Job Details:**

JOB SUMMARY Working directly under the VP, Quality Management, provides oversight to designing and administering a comprehensive hospital wide Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement with focus on the Patient Experience that meets organization strategic objectives and improves patient outcomes and quality of care. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for directing QA/QI Management activities by identifying areas of potential for improvement in quality, safety or other identified risks in accordance with the department and hospital mission. Directs the collection, measurement and presentation of data required for monitoring performance improvement and quality initiatives regardingpatient satisfaction and experience.Oversees and designs quality dashboards as appropriate Provides leadership to the Medical Staff in identification of quality and performance improvement opportunities based on department peer review activity and organization-wide quality initiatives data. Communicates and acts as a liaison with outside agencies such as CMS, IPRO,National Research Corporation or other appropriate agency as to ensure compliance with external reporting requirements and improvement initiatives. Works closely with Vice President QualityMgt. and all departments by serving as a resource, facilitator and consultant for hospital wide quality improvement activities including QI Teams, RCAs and other organization projects. Provides leadership to departments and teams in quality improvement activities with the integration of continuous improvement methodologies such as PDSA, Rapid Response processes, Lean Thinking, ISO9001 and performance improvement tools. Responsible forcontributing to the “Quality” section on the hospital intranet site to provide staff updates on organization quality and patient safety initiatives, the Patient Experience activity. Responsible for the review, revisions and leadership of the Hospital Wide Quality Management program so as to include all performance activities and patient experience initiatives. Participates and provides expertise and support to multiple committees and programs within and external to the organization for broadening the opportunities of PI activities as driven by goals for quality, safety and customer relation QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS EXPERIENCE 5 years experience in health care environment–preferable in acute care. At least three years in quality and/or risk management and quality improvement activities is preferred. Current experience in assessment and analysis skills. EDUCATION Registered Nurse with BSN and MSN or other healthcare degree equivalent — desirable. LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS Advanced computer and analytical skills. Current knowledge of NYS Health Code, DNV Standards, and CMS Quality Initiatives. Continuing education in quality improvement and management of risks. Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal and presentation skills required. Current NYS RN Licensure. OTHER None specified SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS N/A PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS PHYSICAL ACTIVITY Physical ability to investigate any area of the hospital and off site facilities. Close eye work with use of computer. OTHER PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Generally none, but may be exposed to hazard during an emergency Ability to use computer keyboard. Skill in writing reports

**Summary**

The Director of Operations leads and optimizes Maury Microwave’s day-to-day manufacturing and operational activities at its Parsippany, New Jersey facility. This position provides leadership across key operational functions, including Material Planning and Control, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Assembly & Test, and Shipping.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction for Maury Microwave’s Parsippany Operations organization, including Material Planning/Control, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Assembly & Test, and Shipping.
* Ensure effective execution of production plans and customer commitments while maintaining appropriate standards for quality, cost, safety, and delivery.
* Drive improvements in On-Time Delivery (OTD) through disciplined production planning, scheduling, material availability, capacity management, and cross-functional coordination.
* Proactively identify production constraints, material shortages, capacity issues, quality concerns, and other risks that may affect customer delivery.
* Establish, monitor, and drive meaningful operational KPIs, including On-Time Delivery, productivity, efficiency, quality, inventory, labor utilization, capacity, and other appropriate operational measures.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for reviewing performance, identifying gaps, assigning corrective actions, and ensuring accountability for results.
* Provide regular operational performance reports and updates to the VP Technical Operations and other members of the Senior Leadership Team
* Utilize Lean manufacturing principles and structured problem-solving methodologies to improve quality, productivity, efficiency, cost, and timeliness.
* Improve production planning, scheduling, workflow, capacity management, and shop-floor visibility.
* Partner with Quality to ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet customer, regulatory, and company quality requirements.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Business Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations and manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in a high-technology electronics manufacturing environment supported by precision machining capabilities strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success improving On-Time Delivery, productivity, quality, operational efficiency, and manufacturing performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, production planning, scheduling, supply chain, inventory management, Lean principles, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and manage operational KPIs and drive accountability for measurable results.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a hands-on, fast-paced, technically complex manufacturing environment.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
**Company Overview:**

Adams Communication & Engineering Technology (ACET), Incorporated is a Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) system engineering and information technology firm. Incorporated in 1999, we support mission critical Information Technology (IT) business needs for clients within the intelligence community (IC), Department of Defense (DOD), Veteran Administration (VA) and for select commercial clients. ACET, Inc.’s technical, programmatic, and analytical professionals are experts in commercial technology, customized solutions, and proprietary government systems.

**The Position:**

ACET is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Director of Manufacturing** to lead all production, fabrication, assembly, and shop-floor operations at our **Havelock, NC** facility. Reporting directly to executive leadership, the Director of Manufacturing will oversee day-to-day plant performance, drive operational excellence, ensure strict adherence to DoD quality and safety standards, and partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to deliver defense projects on time and within budget.

**Responsibilities:**

* Direct all daily manufacturing, machining, fabrication, and assembly operations in Havelock to meet customer delivery schedules, cost targets, and quality specifications.
* Partner with Program Managers and Engineering teams to transition designs from rapid prototyping and Engineering Manufacturing Development (EMD) into Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) and full-rate sustainment.
* Enforce compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, and Department of Defense manufacturing standards, ensuring zero-defect delivery and full audit readiness.
* Lead, mentor, and schedule production supervisors, machinists, technicians, and quality personnel; foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high retention.
* Implement Lean, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies to optimize shop-floor workflow, reduce cycle times, minimize scrap, and control overhead rates.
* Collaborate with Procurement and Contracts to manage long-lead materials, vendor bottlenecks, equipment maintenance, and capital expenditure planning.
* Maintain a safe, OSHA-compliant manufacturing environment while upholding all DoD physical security and classified material handling protocols.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related technical field (or equivalent military/industry leadership experience).
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 3–5 years in a Plant Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Director-level role within the aerospace, defense, or government contracting sector.
* Proven expertise in precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, electro-mechanical assembly, ERP/MRP systems, and reading complex engineering drawings/blueprints.
* Hands-on experience operating under ISO 9001 and/or AS9100 quality management systems.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must hold an active DoD Secret security clearance (or have the ability to obtain and maintain one).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience supporting NAVAIR, Fleet Readiness Center East (FRC East), or USMC/DoD aviation sustainment programs.
* Certification in Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt).
* Experience managing manufacturing operations within a small-to-midsize defense contractor environment, including familiarity with FAR/DFARS compliance and government-furnished property (GFP).

**Why Join ACET:**

ACET continues to expand its aerospace and aviation sustainment operations supporting multiple Department of Defense aviation platforms worldwide. This position provides the opportunity to directly shape strategic sustainment growth initiatives while supporting operational readiness and mission success across the global aviation enterprise.

**What We Offer:**

At ACET, we believe that our employees are our most valuable asset. We are committed to providing a comprehensive Total Rewards program that recognizes and supports the diverse needs of our workforce. Our offerings are designed to attract, motivate, and retain top talent while fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and well-being.

Employee benefits include the following:

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* Life insurance, AD&D, and Short- and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) Program
* Wellness programs
* Paid Time Off
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Employee Referral Program
* Employee Assistance Program

*Please note that all compensation, benefits, and policies are subject to change at the company's discretion. While we make every effort to provide advance notice of changes, adjustments may occur based on business needs, economic conditions, and industry standards.*

**\*\*Must be US Citizen to apply\*\***

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position.

**Drug Free Workplace:**

ACET is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria are met as outlined in our policies.

**ACET is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor**.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

records.title: Manufacturing Operations Director
records.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Operations Director***

***Salary:*** *$90,000 - $120,000*

***Shift:*** *Monday to Friday 1st shift*

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Manages and directs all manufacturing and production activities including shift quality and quality of work
* Monitors overall plant performance for production and comply with all quality standards
* Familiarity with AS9100, NADCAP & ISO9001 standards & audits
* Works with multiple cross functional groups (Quality, Scheduling, Assembly, Procurement, Supply Chain, Facilities/Maintenance, etc.)
* Reviews production and operating reports and resolves operational/manufacturing problems to ensure minimum costs and prevent operational delays and to meet future growth.
* Uses problem-solving skills and analytical abilities to develop innovative and expedient solutions
* Applies Lean principles and production metrics to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement processes
* Lead and motivate team members to achieve company/department goals while providing direction, development and leadership to production management team
* Provides training, problem solving, and interpersonal skills to diminish conflict and handle employee issues
* Works overtime and occasional weekend shifts as required to support production needs.
* Ensure ITAR/EAR restriction and regulations are followed

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 5 years management experience in manufacturing environment; or 8+ years related management experience and training in a manufacturing environment 2
* 2+ years’ experience in aerospace industry
* CNC machining experience required
* Knowledge of NDT, paint, and chemical processing required
* Strong business acumen with proven leadership skills
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand,
* to walk and sit for extended periods of time;
* to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds;
* to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds;
* to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects;
* to perceive the attributes of objects by touch;
* to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office.
* Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items.
* Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match

records.title: Director of Operations - Industrial Manufacturing
records.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

**Position Summary:**

 

Reporting to the site General Manager, the Director of Operations will manage the daily production, inventory, and logistics to ensure save, efficient, cost-effective, and timely delivery to our customers. They are responsible for development and implementation of strategy, growth, and profitability targets for the PSG-Grand Rapids facility. They will have direct ownership for established safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and lean objectives. Additional areas of reasonability include but are not limited to the oversight of: Safety, Plant Management, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Capital Equipment, Facilities Planning, Workforce Development, and Operations Strategy Deployment. A successful individual will deploy and maintain strong operational processes, be data driven, drive continuous improvement, and empower his or her team to solve problems.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

 

* Manage business to achieve/exceed agreed-upon growth, revenue, and operating income objectives
* Oversee end-to-end supply chain partnerships, warehousing, inventory management, and transportation
* Ensure products meet operations’ profitability goals
* Establish strategic direction, performance metrics, standards, and measurements for direct reports and the operation as a whole that support safety, quality, and delivery expectations
* Sets operational goals and objectives, and guides teams to meet monthly, quarterly and annual targets
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the P&L and continuously execute to achieve revenue and margin commitments
* Provide support and leadership to the supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, and continuous improvement teams by:
 + Supporting sales & operations planning (S&OP) process, and planning manufacturing capacity accordingly to ensure on time and efficient delivery
 + Identifying and responding to trends in the marketplace, anticipating and applying strategies to be ahead of the cost and quality curve
 + Planning and executing a best in class supply chain to ensure appropriate levels of inventory and turns as well as supplier quality and cost
 + Directing the continuous improvement program and supporting on site initiatives as required to ensure adoption of programs and achievement of desired results
 + Ensuring that products are delivered on-time to customers and that products meet all customer expectations regarding quality and performance
 + Planning and implementing capital improvements for the site and operations
* Work proactively with and effectively engaging functional counterparts to ensure overall organizational success and continuity of leadership
* Partner with union leadership to maintain compliance with the collective bargaining agreement while supporting operational goals
* Foster a positive employee relations environment through building a culture where employees are motivated and actively engaged in driving continuous improvement in the business
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and mentors, provides feedback, and takes action as needed to build a high-performing department
Embody the Company’s ethics and values; maintain the highest corporate governance principles 

**Qualifications** :

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, or a related field is required
* MBA/Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other operational leadership role
* Experience in a build to order/high-mix manufacturing environment required
* Proven background in the application of production/inventory control, procurement procedures and techniques, and logistics

This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

Attention Applicants: If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact accommodations@psgdover.com for assistance with an accommodation. Kindly specify Job Requisition Number / Job Title and Location in response.

records.title: Director, Instrument Manufacturing
records.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The primary purpose of this position is to plan and direct departmental functions (Instrument Manufacturing, Engineering, Instrument Refurbishing) at the St. Louis Operations site to ensure achievement of the corporate goals and objectives of the worldwide bioMerieux organization. This position is responsible for the manufacture and maintenance of instrument production and refurbishment through oversight of multiple teams. In addition, this position: provides technical expertise and quality support through implementation of projects and continuous improvement activities; identifies and justifies projects for capital funding, and deliver the projects on time and budget. Also requires coordinating and overseeing the implementation of engineering projects related to cost improvements and new product introductions, ensuring cooperation within and outside the department at both the local and global levels. And finally, responsible for developing and maintaining an engaged, motivated and skilled production work force.

**Primary Duties**
==================

* Manage Manufacturing – Manage the manufacturing and refurbishment groups to ensure customer satisfaction. Deliver the forecasted product on schedule with no errors or nonconformities. Maintain the complex manufacturing process and minimize loss. Maintain high employee morale, drive cooperation between departments at both local and global levels, and drive employee career development.
* Manage and Maintain Production Equipment – Ensure that the manufacturing areas are maintained so that production can continuously manufacture and refurbish product. End result: Successfully manufacturer product to meet demand and improve efficiency to reduce the COGS.
* Product Transfer – Manage the transfer of new products from Research to Manufacturing. Validate the new processes to meet regulatory requirements and ensure the necessary procedures are in place to order parts / materials to meet market demand. End result: Successful market introduction of new, high quality products that meet all relevant and applicable regulatory requirements.
* CAPA Investigations – Manage and provide technical expertise to projects related to investigating failures in current product production or testing processes.
* Cost Improvement and Risk Management – Manage and provide technical expertise to justify and implement cost improvement projects in Operations.
* Finance – Ensure adherence to Departmental budgets.
* Personnel – hiring, maintenance, organization, engagement, and performance of qualified manufacturing, engineering, and other personnel.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree required– Engineering, Supply Chain Management, R&D, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience leading manufacturing operations, with budget oversight and demonstrated experience in cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* 3+ years experience managing operations in an ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformational change.
* Demonstrated experience in talent management and succession planning.
* Experience with capacity, automation, capital investments preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.
* Comfortable giving clear, direct, and actionable feedback.
* Driving continuous improvement by evaluating processes and implementing necessary changes.
* Inspire and energize individuals to achieve their best performance.
* Drive for Results while successfully removing barriers.
* Communicates instructions clearly and effectively.
* Advanced Microsoft Suite Skills: demonstrates deep knowledge; manages complex tasks and integrates multiple tools independently.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
================================

* Direct supervision of approximately 1–5 employees.
* Indirect supervision of approximately 100+ employees.
* Required to make financial, manufacturing process, organizational changes, product and team development decisions.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Domestic travel required: 10% of time
* International travel required: 5% of time
* Total travel: 15%

The estimated salary range for this role is between $155,000-$198,000. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMérieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.

In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:

* A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options

* Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance

* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.

* Adoption Assistance

* Wellness Programs

* Employee Assistance Program

* Commuter Benefits

* Various voluntary benefit offerings

* Discount programs

* Parental leaves

records.title: Sr. Director of Manufacturing Operations Engines - BE-4
records.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

You will join a skilled team responsible for rocket engine production serving customers. Reporting directly to the Engines VP, you will oversee an Engine Production group. The Sr Director leads Senior Managers, whose teams manage daily rocket engine production at Huntsville. This hands-on, influential role calls for outstanding leadership, strong communication, careful judgment, knowledge of mid-rate production, and solid project management expertise. This job will play a vital role in space exploration history and demands your dedication and meticulous focus on safe, repeatable spaceflight.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited:**

* Coordinate activities related to factory design, equipment identification, equipment procurement, production readiness, production start-up, and transition into low-rate initial production.
* Collaborate with the leadership group at our current (Kent, WA) site to grasp existing production processes and convert these strengths into the new manufacturing facility.
* Collaborate with the Huntsville Site Leader and Engines Program Management for communications and support involving both internal and external customers.
* Champion and lead improvement teams for manufacturing processes, business processes, production planning, and implement lessons learned and other standards/processes as needed.
* Manage the Production capital project portfolio and ensure timely execution of projects to support corporate Annual Operating Plans.
* Participate in the preventive action process and implement plans as required.
* Communicate and enforce mission assurance and safety principles throughout the organization.
* Find opportunities for safety improvements, cost savings, and other means to accelerate progress.
* Coordinate and complete site level initiatives with other members of the Huntsville Senior Leadership Team.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a B.S. degree or equivalent experience in Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering. M.S. is preferred and MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
* 15+ years’ experience in aerospace or a closely related industry, such as launch vehicles, aircraft, helicopters, excavation/heavy hauling, mining, energy, or shipbuilding.
* Experience managing customer relations and expectations.
* Prior experience managing Profit and Loss at a program or project level.
* Proven ability in project coordination, budget oversight, and guiding teams.
* Experience leading and managing small- to medium-sized teams on fast-paced projects.
* Technical expertise in managing medium rate production activities.
* Experience in process definition, development, deployment, and improvement.
* Strong quality outlook with special attention to safety and critically important quality aspects as well as application of root cause analysis tools.
* Strong personnel management and mentoring skills.
* Strong safety approach and experience, including hands-on experience planning and conducting critical operations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Toyota Production System. Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred.
* Experience simultaneously managing activities in multiple departments or sites.
* Experience transitioning products from development to production.
* Knowledge of fabrication processes, integration processes, systems engineering practices, test, quality, and configuration management systems.
* Experience managing facility level capital improvements.
* Experience with new process development.
* Experience in staffing and launching a new production facility.

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

 

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical 

 

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details. 

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

 

**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**U C Coatings Director of Operations**

**Reports to** President

**Location** Based at a U-C Coatings facility; Buffalo, NY or Kenosha, WI preferred

**Travel** Approximately 25-35%, including regular travel to all four sites and 3PL partners

**Scope** Buffalo, Kenosha, Seattle and Portland manufacturing sites; 3PLs; supply chain and sourcing; customer service

**Position summary**

U-C Coatings manufactures specialty coatings, wood protection and repair products for industrial and consumer markets. The **Director of Operations** leads the people, processes and resources that turn customer demand into safe, reliable production and accurate, timely delivery.

Reporting to the President, this leader is accountable for operating performance across four sites and the supporting supply chain, sourcing, logistics and customer service functions. The role requires regular time on the production floor, strong financial judgment, and the ability to develop capable site and functional leaders in a lean organization.

**Manufacturing and site leadership**

* Lead site leaders in Buffalo, NY, Kenosha, WI, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR; establish clear responsibilities, operating standards and performance expectations across the network.
* Translate demand into production, staffing and capacity plans; improve batch scheduling, filling, packaging, labor productivity and equipment utilization.
* Improve yield, reduce scrap and rework, and address recurring downtime through preventive maintenance, root cause analysis and practical process improvements.
* Evaluate production allocation, interplant transfers, capital investments and facility changes to improve service, cost and available capacity.

**Supply chain and sourcing**

* Own procurement and supplier performance for raw materials, packaging, purchased products and operating supplies; negotiate pricing, terms and service commitments.
* Lead monthly demand and supply planning with Sales and Finance; align forecasts, purchasing and production with service goals and working capital requirements.
* Set replenishment and inventory policies by item and site; improve inventory accuracy, reduce excess and obsolete stock, and prevent material shortages.
* Develop qualified alternate sources and continuity plans for critical inputs; coordinate supplier and material changes with Technical and Quality before implementation.

**Logistics and third party warehousing**

* Manage 3PL contracts, service standards and performance reviews, including inventory reconciliation, order accuracy, shipping performance, claims and invoice audits.
* Control inbound, outbound, parcel, LTL and interplant freight costs; improve packaging, carrier selection and routing while meeting customer requirements.

**Customer Service**

* Lead Customer Service from order receipt through fulfillment; improve order entry accuracy, acknowledgments, delivery commitments and response times.
* Connect Customer Service, Sales, planning, plants and 3PLs so customers receive reliable commitments and proactive updates on shortages or delays.
* Resolve escalated service issues, returns and credits with Sales, Finance and Technical; use complaint and shipping error trends to eliminate repeat failures.

**Safety quality and compliance**

* Hold site leaders accountable for safe operations, training, inspections, incident reporting and timely corrective action; maintain clear escalation and stop-work authority.
* Partner with internal specialists and outside advisers to meet applicable workplace safety, environmental, storage, waste and shipping requirements at each site.
* Ensure operating teams follow approved formulations, batch records, quality checks, labeling and lot traceability; support product launches and process changes with Technical and Quality.

**Financial management and people leadership**

* Own operating budgets and explain labor, material, freight and overhead variances with Finance; deliver verified savings and capital projects with clear returns.
* Coach and evaluate site and functional leaders; build staffing, cross-training and succession plans, and address performance issues promptly with HR support.
* Run weekly site and consolidated scorecard reviews covering service, cost, quality, inventory and people; assign owners and deadlines and verify corrective actions.

**Qualifications**

* Ten or more years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including at least five years leading managers or major operating functions.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple manufacturing sites or a comparably complex manufacturing and distribution network; ability to lead dispersed teams.
* Practical experience with procurement, inventory planning, logistics, outsourced warehousing and customer fulfillment; strong cost and financial analysis skills.
* Experience with ERP and MRP systems, Excel, operating scorecards and continuous improvement; ability to turn data into decisions and sustained results.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, supply chain, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Coatings, chemicals, adhesives, sealants or other batch manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.

**Measures of success**

Accountable measures include safety controls; on-time, in-full delivery; labor efficiency; yield and cost of poor quality; inventory accuracy and turns; supplier and 3PL performance; freight costs; order accuracy; and leadership development. Agree on targets with the CEO after validating baselines.

**Initial priorities and working environment**

Within 90 days, assess the sites and key partners, validate scorecards, and agree on an improvement plan with owners, deadlines and financial impact. Work includes office, plant and warehouse activities, required PPE (company-provided), regular travel and occasional support outside business hours. Essential duties may be performed with reasonable accommodation.

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

U-C Coatings is a leading manufacturer and supplier of premium wood protection products. For more than 50 years, our products have been used in a variety of industries, including hardwood and softwood logging and lumber production, wood products, manufacturing, woodworking, and wood decking markets.

Our products are used worldwide to protect, conserve, and enhance forest resources. Our goal is to help our customers achieve more with less waste and provide the highest level of protection for their products.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

This role is an in-person role located within the company’s Kenosha, WI location. There is a moderate noise level within the work environment. Compliance with applicable Company policies including maintaining a drug-free workplace and adhering to all safety policies and procedures is required.

**DISCLAIMERS:**

UC Coatings, LLC reserves the right to revise, change or modify the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time to meet business needs. This job description may not list all duties for this position. This job description is not a contract of employment, and all UC Coatings, LLC employment unless otherwise disclosed is “at will” and either the incumbent or UC Coatings, LLC may terminate employment at any time for any reason.

UC Coatings, LLC is an Equal opportunity, inclusive employer and will consider all applicants for employment with the Company based on merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Operations management: 5 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

records.title: Contract Manufacturing Director
records.description:
**Lassonde Pappas & Co.** is a US Leader in beverage manufacturing dedicated to our team members, customers and consumers satisfaction. We remain committed to our small-town roots and rural values. **Hardworking** and **caring** are qualities that make our teams special. Since 1942, we’ve been producing delicious products for our customers across the country!

To provide the best for our customers, we focus on building the best team by creating and advancing an inclusive environment amongst our diverse workforces. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, reliable, and committed to being and doing better, join us!

**We value each of our employees’ total wellbeing. To support employees in all stages of their wellness journey, we have a robust benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage options, growth and development potential, along with 401-K, Life & Disability Insurance, PTO, Tuition Reimbursement, Health Fairs, Gym Membership Discounts, and so much more!**

*Pay Range for this position is: $165,000-$200,000 plus annual bonus, depending on experience and geographical location.*

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The **Director, Contract Manufacturing** reports to the Vice President, Integrated Planning, U.S. Beverage and is based in Cherry Hill, New Jersey.

The Director is responsible for defining the role of contract manufacturing within the Beverage Division’s broader supply network and translating business plans into clear external capacity, capability, geographic, and partnership requirements across the U.S. and Canada. This role leads the development and optimization of the contract manufacturing network to ensure the right capabilities, capacity, cost, quality, service, and resilience to support business growth.

The Director oversees relationships with contract manufacturing partners from initial capability assessment and commercial selection through operational integration, product launch, ongoing governance, and continuous performance improvement.

The Director aligns internal business and functional leaders around external manufacturing decisions and builds productive relationships with strategic partners. The role ensures that external manufacturing resources are positioned to support the division’s growth plans, innovation agenda, service expectations, cost objectives, and business continuity requirements.

**Up to 25% travel required**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**External Manufacturing Strategy & Network Optimization**

* Define and execute the contract manufacturing strategy for the Beverage Division across the U.S. and Canada, translating business requirements into external manufacturing capacity, capability, geographic, and partnership needs.
* Optimize the existing contract manufacturing network by assessing manufacturing capabilities, capacity, geographic footprint, technology, cost, service, quality, and supply risk.
* Partner with Integrated Planning, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and other key stakeholders on make-versus-buy decisions and long-term capacity strategies.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the external manufacturing landscape to identify new capabilities, technologies, potential partners, and opportunities to strengthen the overall supply network.

**Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Management**

* Translate business requirements into sourcing strategies for externally manufactured products, balancing economics, available capacity, technical capability, speed, flexibility, and supply risk.
* Lead competitive sourcing and partner-selection activities, including market assessment, RFIs/RFPs/RFQs, commercial evaluation, supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, and implementation.
* Structure and negotiate commercial agreements that clearly define pricing, capacity commitments, service expectations, quality requirements, flexibility provisions, liability, and business continuity obligations.
* Develop fact-based sourcing recommendations considering total cost of ownership, capacity, capability, risk, and overall strategic fit.
* Establish pricing mechanisms and commercial frameworks that promote transparency, competitiveness, and sustainable productivity.
* Provide financial stewardship of external manufacturing spend through disciplined budgeting, forecasting, cost analysis, variance management, and productivity delivery.

**Supplier Relationship & Performance Management**

* Establish and lead a structured Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) approach for strategic contract manufacturing partners.
* Establish and maintain a robust performance management framework and supplier scorecards for the contract manufacturing network.
* Establish a disciplined operating rhythm with strategic partners, supported by agreed performance measures, periodic operating and executive business reviews, documented recovery plans, and clear ownership of actions.
* Build strategic relationships with key external manufacturing partners to improve service, strengthen capacity and flexibility, accelerate innovation, and identify productivity opportunities.
* Lead supplier and network risk assessments and ensure appropriate business continuity, contingency, and risk mitigation plans are developed and maintained.

The Director owns the performance framework for the external manufacturing network, ensuring that targets reflect the division’s priorities for customer service, product quality, delivered cost, productivity, available capacity, launch execution, contractual compliance, and supply continuity. The role is responsible for converting performance information into timely decisions, recovery actions, and clear visibility of results and risks for business leadership.

**Commercialization & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead the external manufacturing workstream for new product commercialization, capacity expansions, product transfers, and new contract manufacturer onboarding.
* Partner with R&D, Marketing, Quality, Engineering, Operations, Integrated Planning, and other key functions to ensure new products and external manufacturing capabilities are launched on time, at target cost, and in accordance with quality and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure effective integration of contract manufacturers into the broader planning and supply network, including capacity planning, production planning, inventory management, service, and supply continuity.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and supply issues across internal functions and external manufacturing partners, ensuring clear ownership and escalating material business risks when required.

**Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Contract Manufacturing team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and individual development plans.
* Establish the governance, processes, tools, decision rights, and performance standards required to effectively manage the external manufacturing network.
* Ensure accurate and actionable contract manufacturing information is maintained, including supplier capabilities, capacity, pricing, commercial terms, products/SKUs, performance, and contractual commitments.
* Provide business leadership with regular visibility into external manufacturing cost, capacity, service, performance, supply risk, and opportunities, enabling timely and informed decision-making.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and accountability for initiatives and decisions affecting the external manufacturing network.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in contract manufacturing, external manufacturing, strategic sourcing, procurement, operations, or supply chain, preferably within the CPG, food, or beverage industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing third-party manufacturing relationships and complex commercial agreements.
* Strong experience in strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, contracting, and supplier relationship management.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Planning, Quality, R&D, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate cost, capacity, capability, service, quality, and supply risk and translate analysis into effective business recommendations.
* Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost modeling, and productivity initiatives.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and external business partners within a complex matrix organization.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and change-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the food, beverage, or broader CPG industry.
* Experience managing a multi-site or North American external manufacturing network.
* Experience with new product commercialization, manufacturing transfers, and external partner onboarding.
* APICS/ASCM certification, CPSM, or comparable supply chain/procurement certification.
* MBA or advanced degree.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Directly manages three employees, providing coaching, development, performance management, and clear accountability for results.
* Establishes team priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with the contract manufacturing strategy and broader business goals.
* Builds team capability and expertise while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and results.
* Provides leadership across a broader cross-functional network, influencing internal stakeholders and external manufacturing partners to achieve service, quality, cost, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity objectives.
* Leads through influence across a matrix organization, driving alignment and accountability among internal functions and strategic external partners.

records.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Manufacturing Operations | Color Compounding and Synthetic Turf Yarn Extrusion**

Company

TenCate

 

Location

Dayton, Tennessee

 

Department

Manufacturing / Operations

 

Reports To

VP of Manufacturing

 

Position Type

Full-Time

**About Us**

TenCate brings together specialized businesses in synthetic turf manufacturing, sports surfacing, construction, and related services. Our operations combine manufacturing expertise, product innovation, and customer-focused execution to support high-performing athletic environments.

**Position Summary**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the Dayton manufacturing facility, which includes color compounding and extrusion of synthetic turf yarn. This role has accountability for safe operations, product quality, production performance, cost control, staffing, maintenance coordination, continuous improvement, third-party yarn sales, and sourcing of raw materials.

The Plant Manager will provide strong day-to-day leadership while building the systems, accountability, and capabilities necessary to support future growth. The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader who is comfortable working directly with production teams while also managing plant performance through data and clearly defined operating metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Safety and Compliance**

* Maintain a strong safety culture with clear expectations and accountability at all levels of the plant.

* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements and company standards.

* Drive identification and correction of unsafe conditions and operating practices.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Lead daily operations across color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining safety and quality requirements.

* Optimize machine utilization, throughput, labor, and manufacturing efficiency.

* Identify and eliminate production bottlenecks, excessive downtime, scrap, and waste.

* Ensure effective shift-to-shift communication and production reporting.

* Coordinate production priorities with planning, supply chain, quality, maintenance, and other manufacturing locations.

**Quality**

* Ensure products consistently meet established specifications and customer requirements.

* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for quality issues, scrap, and customer complaints.

* Maintain strong process controls around color consistency, raw materials, extrusion conditions, and finished-yarn performance.

* Partner with Quality and Technical teams on process and product improvements.

**Cost and Productivity**

* Manage plant performance against budget and operating targets.

* Drive improvements in labor efficiency, material yield, waste, energy consumption, downtime, and overall manufacturing cost.

* Monitor plant KPIs and develop corrective actions when performance falls below target.

* Identify and execute continuous-improvement and cost-reduction opportunities.

**Commercial and Raw Material Sourcing**

* Manage third-party yarn sales, including customer coordination, pricing support, order execution, and alignment of external commitments with available plant capacity.

* Develop and maintain productive relationships with third-party yarn customers while ensuring service, quality, and profitability expectations are met.

* Lead sourcing and supplier coordination for key raw materials used in color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Partner with Supply Chain, Technical, Quality, and Finance to evaluate suppliers, material performance, cost, availability, and supply risk.

* Support negotiations, purchasing strategies, inventory planning, and contingency plans that ensure reliable and cost-effective raw material supply.

**People Leadership**

* Provide leadership and direction to supervisors, technical resources, and hourly manufacturing associates.

* Establish clear responsibilities, expectations, and accountability throughout the organization.

* Develop supervisors and future manufacturing leaders.

* Ensure appropriate staffing and training to meet production requirements.

* Create a culture of teamwork, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance and Reliability**

* Partner with maintenance to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

* Establish appropriate preventive and predictive maintenance priorities.

* Support equipment upgrades, capital projects, and manufacturing process improvements.

* Ensure recurring equipment issues receive appropriate root-cause analysis and corrective action.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Use production data and structured problem-solving to drive measurable improvements.

* Establish standardized work and disciplined operating processes.

* Lead improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, output, yield, labor productivity, uptime, and cost.

* Support future capacity planning, equipment additions, and manufacturing expansion as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant manufacturing leadership experience in a plant or production environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading hourly manufacturing teams and front-line supervisors.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, including safety, quality, throughput, downtime, yield/scrap, labor efficiency, and cost.

* Demonstrated ability to drive operational improvement and hold teams accountable for results.

* Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

* Demonstrated commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer requirements, plant capacity, material availability, and profitability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field.

* Experience with plastic extrusion, polymer processing, synthetic fibers, masterbatch/color compounding, or similar continuous manufacturing processes.

* Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement experience.

* Experience managing a multi-shift manufacturing operation.

* Familiarity with capital projects, process automation, and equipment reliability programs.

* Experience with third-party or business-to-business sales in a manufacturing environment.

* Experience sourcing polymers, additives, color concentrates, packaging, or other manufacturing raw materials.

**Key Measures of Success**

* Safety performance

* First-quality / right-first-time production

* Schedule attainment

* Pounds produced / throughput

* Scrap and waste percentage

* Labor efficiency

* Machine uptime / unplanned downtime

* Manufacturing cost per pound

* Customer complaints and internal quality issues

* Energy consumption per pound produced

* Employee training, development, and retention

* Third-party yarn sales revenue and profitability

* Third-party customer service and on-time delivery

* Raw material cost, availability, quality, and supplier performance

* Raw material inventory and supply continuity

**Work Environment**

This position requires regular presence in a manufacturing environment and the ability to work across shifts as business needs require. The Plant Manager must be able to communicate effectively with hourly associates, technical teams, support functions, and senior leadership.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

The company is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

This description summarizes the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities or qualifications. Duties may change based on business needs.

records.description:
Location(s):
Fort Smith, AR, US, 72916

Function: Manufacturing

Audience: Experienced Professional

Work Arrangement: On Site

Requisition ID: 71047

**PURPOSE OF THE JOB**

The Fort Smith **Plant Leader** has overall responsibility for the entire manufacturing facility, and oversees the development and implementation of organizational strategies, standards, and practices to achieve best-in-class performance. In addition, the Plant Leader collaborates closely with other Plant Leaders and leadership across the business to drive success of the enterprise. The Plant Leader is also an active member of the community and represents Owens Corning’s interest in local affairs.

 

Fort Smith is part of Owens Corning’s North America Nonwovens business and manufactures Nonwovens products. Fort Smith’s primary customers are in the building materials market (Wet Formed Mat). This position has 7 salaried direct report and 1 dotted-line report. The Plant has 160 employees.

 

**Reports to:** Global Operations Director, Nonwovens

**Span of control:** Operations Leader (Coating Line), Operations Leader (Wet Formed Mat Line), TPM Leader, Maintenance Leader, Quality/Technical Leader, EHS Leader, Plant Controller, HR Leader (Dotted-Line)

 

**Benefits of Working at Owens Corning:**

* 72 Consecutive years as a Fortune 500® Company

* The Wall Street Journal Best-Managed Companies Top 250

* $10.1 Billion in 2025 Sales Revenue
* Presence in 31 Countries with 25,000 employees

* Health and Wellness Opportunities
* Adoption and Family Assistance- OC is committed to helping employees in their endeavor to build a family, including financial assistance for adoption and surrogacy
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) provides U.S. employees the opportunity to purchase Owens Corning stock at a 15 percent discount every six month
* Parental leave- Four weeks of paid time off for all new parents; this includes both mothers and fathers at the time of birth or the adoption of a child
* A rebate program that allows employees to receive a rebate of up to $2,000 every four years for purchases of OC’s wide range of products for new construction or home improvement

Just what is it that makes Owens Corning unique? Of course, there are the products, the global reach, and the strong commitment to sustainability. Behind all of that though, it is our people and our purpose. That is our difference. We are proud to be recognized for our ongoing product, environmental and social sustainability efforts:

* Placed on the Dow Jones Sustainability World Index (DJSI World) for the 15th consecutive year (2024)
* Ranked in the top 10 of the 100 Best Corporate Citizens List for the 8th consecutive year (2025), No. 3 overall
* Recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2023 World’s Most Ethical Companies - Sixth Consecutive Year

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Responsibilities:**

**Lead safety and security for an injury free work environment**

* Ensures a culture which enables a safe and secure work environment for all employees, contractors, and visitors
* Shows passion and caring for our people, and leads from a place of “safety and” the other objectives of the business with a focus on safe behaviors and choices
* Allocates resources and identifies investments required to achieve zero injuries, including systems, focused programs, and leadership
* Ensures a clear and effective measurement system is followed and used to drive results; rewards and celebrates safe behavior and achievements; ensures accountability
 

**Lead the facility through a Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) operating system targeting**

* Zero injuries
* Zero defects
* Zero losses
 

**Know the business and our customers**

* Continuously build insight into the business’s market, customer base and strategies
* Create an environment where all employees are engaged, empowered, and focused on serving our customers
* Develop relationships with customers and understand what it takes to ensure OC products are perceived by the market as high quality.
* Models this customer first mindset and consistently applies quality systems and standards to drive out quality issues.
 

**Execute business strategy and direct operations that drive towards manufacturing excellence**

* Leads with a clear view of where the organization needs to be in 1-3 years
* Communicates strategic direction to employees and how it fits with the day-to-day actions and results being driven. Ability to achieve results through the team. Effective utilization of 2-way communication tools to share strategy and target objectives.
* Set clear and measurable performance expectations, in line with division and corporate goals; proactively analyzes and manages all relative operations performance metrics
* Oversee the development of a comprehensive annual capital budget and operations plan; initiates timely and appropriate capital requests to maintain or enhance plant performance necessary to meet customer demands
* Operate with zero environmental non-conformities to applicable company, government, and regulatory policies
* Continuously improves the plant operations environmental footprint consistent with company goals and community interests
* Ensures appropriate resources to business strategy and deliverables.
* Demonstrated change agent who can lead strategic transformation.
 

**Develop a positive employee relations environment**

* Ensures a positive, creative, diverse, and collaborative work environment where employees own the success of the business.
* Selects, trains, ensures the proper tools processes and systems are in place, then empowers employees to deliver against clear expectations.
* Monitors labor activities to ensure compliance with company policies and/or governmental regulations
* Establishes OC as an employer of choice in the local market
* Builds a facility worthy of use as a marketing and communications platform, both internal and external
* Maintains effective relationships with key political and community decision makers and represents the Company in appropriate community matters
 

**Lead and develop talent**

* Create an environment where talent is developed, and full potential is realized.
* Effectively build a diverse team with competent people using the appropriate mix of internal promotions and external recruitment to satisfy near-term performance, longer-term succession needs and to ensure the organization has the necessary talent to achieve its near-term and long-term goals.
* Ensures alignment with functional leadership (e.g., finance, safety, human resources) on performance management and talent development
 

**Lead across the network manufacturing facilities and integrated supply chain of the business**

* Leverage partnership with other leaders across the integrated supply chain to maximize performance of the business, lead change, and grow talent
* Share best practices, challenge thinking and provide candid and respectful feedback; set an example for the organization of how teamwork and partnerships should work
* Be seen as a great leader across the business, driving engagement and supporting cross-functional projects and teams.
 

**Job Requirements:**

 

**Education:**

* Master’s Degree preferred, Bachelor’s Degree required with preference on engineering, business or related majors will be considered
 

**Experience:**

* Engineering or technical background preferred
* At least 5 years of experience in a Plant operations leadership role managing salaried employees
* 10+ years of experience in various manufacturing roles
* Exposure to cross-functional team leadership or participation outside of manufacturing
* A history of hiring, growing, and promoting talent within the organization
 

Type of Industry

* TPM formal training, or strong background in Continuous Improvement, and Lean manufacturing, experience
* Experience successfully designing and leading culture change within an organization
* Experience meeting customer demands.
* Paper and pulp, automotive, electronics, bulk industries
 

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Act as an organizational steward
* Collaborates and fosters teamwork
* Develops people
* Competitively drives results
* Follows through on commitments
* Allocates necessary resources
* Actively listens
* Thinks and acts strategically
* Models’ curiosity and growth mindset
* Challenges the status quo
* Generates ideas through diverse thought
* Works from an outside in perspective
* Effective with verbal and written communication
* Business and financial acumen
* Mindset of creating value for the customer
 

**Travel**

* Must be able to travel up to 10%
 

*This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employee(s) will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.*
 
*A review of this position has excluded the marginal functions of the position that are incidental to the performance of fundamental job duties. All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents(s) will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, and abilities.* 
*This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” relationship.*
