records.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.
* Champions Functional Training Document (FTD) program through employee learning and development initiatives; standards of excellence & leader/employee accountability.
* Other Duties as assigned.
* Commitment to the organizations values; High Standards, Bias for Action, Teamwork, Customer

Obsession, Trust, Accountability, Innovation and Growth & Learning. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description.

REQUIRED SKILLS: 

* Addressing operational concerns and issues, monitoring overall customer satisfaction.
* Developing and implementing operational procedures and policies.
* Analyzing training needs/requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities.
* Ability to communicate with others effectively.
* Ability to conduct research for special projects, respond timely inquiries, and present written/ oral briefings.
* Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues.
* Good decision-making skills and response to high-pressure situations.
* Managing processes, developing standard.
* Tracking budget expenses, financial skills.
* Performance management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or Engineering-related discipline or a business-related area or equivalent work experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of eight (8) years manufacturing management experience supervising manufacturing employees.
* Minimum of two (2) years of recent overall project management experience.
* Knowledge of HazMat, ISO, Distribution and safety programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills with the ability to manipulate spreadsheets, create pivot tables and summarize data from multiple sources
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and with the team with strong follow through
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* A Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) can be used in lieu of the educational requirements

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
The physical environment may require the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. This position may be working in the warehouse under various indoor environmental conditions, including supplemental heating in the winter months and without air-conditioning in the summer months. May be requested to work overtime and weekends. The position may occasionally be exposed to ruptured, leaking packages, some of which may contain Hazardous Materials. Where appropriate, proper safety equipment should be utilized and/or appropriate personnel notified. records.title: Houston Plant Manager
records.description:
Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colourful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

We are currently looking for a **Plant Manager** to join us at our facility in **Houston, TX.**

**Position Description:**

The Plant Manager will develop and execute the manufacturing strategy to meet Axalta’s business requirements; drive process excellence in every step of the manufacturing process; implement improvements to reduce the cost of goods sold (COGS); and, direct Plant Management, including Quality, Engineering and EH&S. The Plant Manager will lead actions for all operations at Houston.

The Plant Manager is responsible for analyzing local plant requirements and working cross-functionally within operations (internal manufacturing, external manufacturing, supply chain, procurement) as well with functions outside operations (businesses, HR, Finance, Legal). The successful candidate will leverage knowledge of industry best practices and financial analysis/modeling to recommend solutions to enhance operations performance and profitability. The position will translate Regional and Global operations strategy into local execution while developing and ensuring consistent and efficient flow of product and supply chain from supplier to customer, as well as enabling best-in-class service to internal and external customers.

The qualified candidate will be a high-energy self-starter with a strong work ethic who must excel at both day-to-day tactical execution as well as long-term strategic planning. This individual must be motivated by a competitive industry and be an expert at fulfilling customer requirements and maximizing profitability. Excellent communication and leadership skills, as well as deep, relevant experience across multiple functions/facets of a best-in class manufacturing organization(s), will be critical to success in this role.

**Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for all plant operations and facilities at site.
* Direct line responsibility for nine (9) direct reports and employees and over 100+ indirect reports.
* Full accountability for all aspects of an integrated coatings facility including production, warehousing, maintenance, process engineering, quality control, and safety.
* Full accountability for all local site regulatory matters.
* Inculcate a continuous improvement mindset that drives improvements in quality, cost, delivery, and inventory every day
* Provide strong leadership to Manufacturing, Quality, EH&S and Engineering, and build capabilities around these areas.
* Manage operations budget through continuous productivity improvement and quality control.
* Bring operational excellence and discipline to the site and execute AOE strategy.
* Be data driven yet able to implement solutions at an appropriately urgent pace.
* Must have demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with cross functional stakeholders and various levels of employees.
* Strong financial and analytical skills; must be able to develop and implement a strategy to maximize productivity and profitability.
* Strong chemical batch processing knowledge in a lean environment with high customization amongst products, including experience applying or implementing lean manufacturing, kaizen methodology and productions systems.
* Demonstrated experience in gathering and reporting business data and key performance indicators.
* Able to adeptly operate in a matrixed reporting structure.
* Create and manage operational and capital budgets.

**Qualifications:** 
Incumbent must be able to perform each duty satisfactorily and in a safe and manner. The items listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and experience required.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, chemistry or related discipline required. Advanced degree desired.
* Minimum 10 years manufacturing experience, including years in the chemicals or related industry (coatings experience strongly preferred), as well as at least 10 years leading managers highly desired.
* Knowledge on non union sites.
* Knowledge and experience managing a site Process Safety Management (PSM).
* Must be able to work flexible hours and/or overtime when needed.
* Work requires manual dexterity, accuracy and attention to detail.
* Heavy visual and mental concentration and periods of prolonged sitting are required.
* Occasionally required to conduct production floor and warehouse visits requiring prolonged standing or walking, negotiation of obstacles, and bending or stooping.
* Strong communication and influence skills required; must be able to effectively enact change management and implement and lead new initiatives and programs.

Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.

The expected compensation range for this position is $180,000 - $200,000 USD annually.

**Our Company:**

Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.

Axalta may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**: We take candidate safety seriously. If you believe you’ve encountered a fraudulent job posting claiming to represent our company, please include a link or screenshot and report it to TA-Support-Center@axalta.com.

records.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

records.title: Digital Plant Manager
records.description:
Some people manage teams. Others build environments where elite technical talent thrives, innovation accelerates, and customers become lifelong advocates. We’re looking for a Digital Plant Manager who can do all three.

This isn’t a “keep the trains running” management role. We need a leader who can build and steward high-performing Agile teams, drive operational excellence, own financial outcomes, and help shape the future of Vertech’s Digital Plant organization. You’ll lead self-organizing Scrum teams delivering world class industrial automation and software solutions while guiding strategic investments in internal development tools and accelerators that improve how we work and scale.

If you know how to balance leadership with accountability, coaching with execution, and strategy with action—and you genuinely enjoy helping talented people do the best work of their careers—we should probably talk.

**Who We Are**

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason.

The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun.

If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to industries including data centers, renewable energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, water and wastewater, and more.

**Top Reasons to Work with Us**

* Flexible work schedule with work from home options for many roles
* Weekly communication from management in our internally famous Friday morning meeting
* Competitive compensation including a bonus plan
* No more than a 4 week waiting period on all benefits including the 401k
* A really rad Christmas Party each year
* A manager that is cool…most of the time, because no one is perfect
* A path for growth, a great culture, PTO, AND MORE!

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build, lead, and develop high-performing Professional Scrum teams capable of delivering world class customer outcomes
* Coach, mentor, and support team members through consistent feedback, career development, and leadership
* Ensure teams are staffed with the right people in the right roles while fostering Vertech’s culture and core values
* Own the financial performance and delivery outcomes of projects executed by your teams
* Serve as the primary escalation point for customers beyond the execution team
* Drive operational excellence using Professional Agile Leadership (PAL-E), Scrum principles, and Evidence Based Management (EBM)
* Govern and prioritize Digital Plant’s portfolio of internal software accelerators and development tools
* Partner with leadership to contribute to strategic planning and organizational growth initiatives
* Ensure investment initiatives are properly staffed, organized, funded, and aligned with company objectives
* Promote continuous improvement in delivery execution, technical excellence, and team collaboration
* Work closely with HR and leadership on hiring, onboarding, employee growth, and team performance
* Help create an environment where highly technical people genuinely enjoy coming to work

**What You Need for this Position**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field (or equivalent industry experience)
* Deep expertise in Agile frameworks, Professional Scrum, and Professional Agile Leadership (PAL-E)
* 7+ years of experience in industrial automation and systems integration
* 3+ years of leadership experience with accountability for team success
* Strong understanding of software and industrial systems development methodologies including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and related practices
* Proven ability to lead technical teams while balancing customer satisfaction, delivery quality, and financial performance
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
* Strong business acumen including understanding of project financials, margins, utilization, and operational efficiency

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience leading multiple Scrum teams simultaneously
* Background in software product or platform development
* Experience scaling Agile delivery organizations
* Passion for coaching and developing technical talent
* A desire to build systems and teams that continuously improve over time

**Why This Role Matters**

The Digital Plant Manager plays a critical role in Vertech’s vision to be recognized as a world class provider of industrial automation services—and the employer of choice for top talent. This role directly influences our people, our customers, our delivery capabilities, and the future of how we scale Digital Plant operations.

No pressure. But also…kind of a big deal.

records.title: Plant Manager - Wilson, NC
records.description:
Job Summary:
 
Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and leads production activities for assigned manufacturing facilities and/or value streams with direct accountability for safety, quality, cost, schedule attainment, and on-time delivery. Provides site-level leadership to ensure daily execution aligns with production plans, customer requirements, standard work, and business objectives. Partners cross functionally with Planning, Materials, Engineering, Quality, HR, and Manufacturing leadership to remove constraints, improve process discipline, and drive continuous improvement throughout the operation.

**Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of supervisory or site leadership experience and 5–7 years of manufacturing experience preferred. In lieu of a degree, a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 8 years of supervisory or relevant manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a manufacturing site, department, or value stream with accountability for safety, quality, schedule, cost, labor planning, and daily execution.
* Experience leading production managers or production teams through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong understanding of production scheduling, capacity planning, labor utilization, material readiness, ERP/MRP discipline, and schedule attainment in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated competency with ERP systems used in manufacturing environments; IFS, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, visual management, standard work, root cause problem solving, and Corrective Action/Preventive Action practices; Six Sigma and/or Lean certification preferred or actively pursuing.
* Ability to use operational data, reports, and KPIs to communicate performance versus goals and drive improvement in safety, quality, cost, schedule, productivity, and on-time delivery.
* Knowledge of safe work practices, OSHA requirements, incident prevention, corrective action closure, and operational organization standards.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and documentation, including schematics, assembly drawings, operational manuals, safety rules, Methods of Manufacture, and standardized work instructions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional issue resolution with Engineering, Quality, Materials, Planning, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to minimize delays and improve execution.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and leadership skills with the ability to engage peers, leaders, and employees at all levels of the organization.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office and scheduling software.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and site/value stream performance across safety, site security, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, and on time delivery.
* Maintains a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring standards, procedures, legal regulations, OSHA requirements, local regulations and company safety practices are followed.
* Leads safety culture, 5S, operational organization, corrective actions, and incident prevention activities across assigned production areas.
* Maintains a positive and accountable culture where safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost control, and customer requirements are treated as core operating priorities.
* Leads value stream team through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and disciplined execution of the operating plan.
* Owns daily and weekly production attainment by aligning labor, material readiness, equipment availability, engineering support, and production priorities to meet schedule commitments.
* Drives constraint resolution and escalates issues that impact scope, schedule, quality, cost, or customer delivery commitments.
* Identifies, contains, and follows proper procedures for non-conforming material; supports accurate tracking, timely disposition, corrective action, and closure of NCRs.
* Ensures alignment cross-functionally with Engineering, Quality, Planning, Materials, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to resolve issues, reduce delays, improve process discipline, and support continual product improvement.
* Manages controllable operating costs, labor productivity, overtime, indirect labor utilization, rework, scrap, tools, equipment, and other cost drivers within assigned areas.
* Identifies cost savings opportunities and leads continuous improvement efforts that improve safety, quality, flow, productivity, throughput, and resource utilization.
* Leverages metrics and KPIs to identify performance gaps, establish priorities, communicate progress, and promote a culture of continuous improvement across assigned departments.
* Addresses employee performance, attendance, and standards-of-work issues in partnership with HR and Manufacturing leadership.
* Works with HR and Manufacturing leadership to support personnel development, establish career paths, and maintain a sound performance evaluation process.
* Leads manufacturing-driven projects and cross-functional initiatives based on KPI performance, data review, customer feedback, field quality concerns, or operational needs.

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is on-site 5 days per week.
* Occasional travel may be required for training or meetings.
* Must be able to work flexible hours to accommodate different business needs.

***The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time, based on business needs.***

***PowerSecure is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.***

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Make a SPLASH with Latham, The Pool Company!**
================================================

At Latham, The Pool Company, we don't just make swimming pools; we create opportunities for backyard dreams to come true. As the leading manufacturer in North America, Australia, and New Zealand, we are committed to delivering innovation, quality, and sustainability in everything we do.

We believe in building an environment where everyone can thrive. That is why we offer:

* A culture of integrity, collaboration, and respect.
* Comprehensive benefits for you and your family.
* Opportunities for growth, mentorship, and skill development.

**A little about the position:**

**Job Summary:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and continuous improvement of an Automatic Pool Covers manufacturing facility. This role directs all aspects of plant operations, including production, safety, quality, inventory management, workforce development, maintenance, and cost control. The Plant Manager ensures customer orders are fulfilled on time, within quality standards, and in a cost-effective manner while fostering a culture of safety, teamwork, accountability, engagement, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

***Please note this position is located in Plainfield, Indiana. You would need to be able to commute or willing to relocate to the area.***

 

**Some of What You Will Do:**

* Provide visible leadership that promotes a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, managers, and frontline employees.
* Build organizational capability through succession planning, talent development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with all OSHA, environmental, and company requirements.
* Ensure effective implementation of safety programs, training, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Direct daily operations of custom automatic pool cover manufacturing, assembly, and shipment activities.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while meeting safety, quality, delivery, and cost expectations.
* Optimize labor utilization, production efficiency, and manufacturing throughput.
* Ensure products meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions to improve first-pass yield and reduce warranty claims.
* Maintain appropriate inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
* Partner with Planning, Purchasing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure material availability and inventory accuracy.
* Drive lean and value engineering initiatives with support from corporate team to drive continuous improvement and gross margin improvement.
* Utilize data, KPIs, and visual management tools to drive decision-making.
* Develop and manage annual operating budgets and forecasts.
* Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and service levels.

**What You Bring to the Table: (Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Industrial Technology, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years of plant management or operations leadership experience.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred.
* Strong leadership, teambuilding, people management skills.
* Demonstrated understanding of safety, quality, productivity, inventory management, and employee relations.
* Proven experience developing and implementing processes that drive continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting business reports, metrics, and KPIs.

**Why Join Latham?** **At Latham, we invest in your well-being, growth, and success. Our comprehensive benefits package supports you and your family with:**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 24/7 telehealth and wellness resources
* Personalized benefits advocacy and support
* Expert second opinions and access to leading specialists
* 401(k) with a 50% company match up to 6%, and financial protection benefits
* Flexible PTO and 11 paid holidays
* Mental health, family care, and financial wellness resources

**Join a team that's invested in your well-being, your future, and your success.**

**Some Important Information for you:**

**Position Title:** Plant Manager

**Location:** Plainfield, Indiana

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Status:** Exempt

**Salary Range:** $100,000 - $146,000

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across US geographic markets. Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, knowledge, skills, education, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

**Bonus:**MIB Tier 2 - 17.5%

 

*Latham, The Pool Company is an* ***Equal Opportunity Employer****. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Latham, The Pool Company is a Drug-Free Workplace Employer. All offers of employment are subject to applicable pre-employment requirements.*

records.title: Recycling Plant Manager I (1st Shift)
records.description:
**I. Job Summary** 
Ensures the highest standards of environmental safety and operational excellence by effectively managing the day-to-day operations of the assigned MRF, and maintains cost management within the MRF.

**Hours:** This is a 1st shift Management role. Hours are typically 6:00 AM - 4:00 PM.
 
 
**II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Ensures smooth operation of site, including: gatehouse, sorting, loading.
* Minimizes handling and operational costs.
* Continually works to reduce turnaround time for trucks in and out of site.
* Regularly proposes means of operational improvement.
* Acts as a liaison, where necessary, for community relationships.
* Complies with and ensures adherence to WM’s Mission to Zero standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient operations.
* Submits reasonable budget information and analyzes data versus year-to-date data and prior year budget.
* Assists in creating a positive team-oriented environment through employee development and motivation.
* Ensures the cleanliness and maintenance of the physical property of the MRF through inspections and preventive maintenance programs with supervisors/employees.
* Oversees personnel needs of the MRF including selecting, coaching, and training employees and evaluating employee performance. Provides input into termination, compensation, and promotion decisions.
* Conducts and/or attends and contributes to periodic safety meetings.
* Provides training and presentations as needed in a positive and professional manner.
* Updates and submits required reports in a timely manner.

**III. Qualifications** 
A. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree (accredited) in Industrial Engineering, or similar area of study or in lieu of degree
* High School Diploma or GED (accredited)
* 4 years of relevant work experience.
* 3 years of relevant work experience (in addition to education requirements).

B. Preferred Qualifications

Management experience in a manufacturing type setting. 
 
 
 
**IV. Physical Requirements** 
Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

* Repetitive Motions
* Eye/Hand/Foot Coordination
* Sitting
* Talking
* Hearing

**Office**: This job primarily operates in a professional office environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, copy machines, etc. 
 
**V. Benefits**
 
At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term disability. In addition, we offer a stock purchase plan, company matching on a 401(k), and more. Employees also receive paid vacation, holidays, and personal days. Please note that benefits may vary by site.

If this sounds like the opportunity that you have been looking for, please click Apply.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Select Milk Producers is one of the nation’s largest and most progressive dairy cooperatives, with 32 wholly owned subsidiaries, 8 processing plants, and 8 joint ventures including Continental Dairy Facilities, Continental Dairy Facilities Southwest, Mill Haven Foods, Select Custom Solutions, GreenLink and Select Services. With over 800 employees, the Select Milk family of companies impacts all aspects of the dairy farm business and at the heart of our family of companies, is you.

"We strive to go above and beyond what’s expected in providing for our families, leading our employees, caring for our land and animals, serving our customers, producing quality milk, and serving one another. This commitment is more than our business, it’s in our culture and our character. We believe in being accountable, in doing what’s right, in performing at our best, in setting a higher standard."

Select Milk Producers and its subsidiaries offer an attractive compensation and a best-in-class benefits package that includes but is not limited medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more that can be tailored for you and your family. Other benefits for eligible employees include 401(k) up to 6% company match, life and disability insurance, and paid holidays & vacation. We are proud to promote an equal employment opportunity workplace.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Plant Operations: Review daily inventories and plan daily production. Conduct daily staff meetings to coordinate daily plant activities. Review daily load out schedule and coordinate with staff and milk movement personnel. Review daily production efficiencies and production reports. Review companies KPI’s, plant loss and assist in setting goals. Reports directly to the Director of Operations.
* Plant Quality: Review microbiology test results daily and direct further investigation of high counts. Review list of any out-of-spec. product with Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Manager. Review all product C of A's.
* Plant Audits: Check each department daily. Check employee GMP’s. Review daily report of audits. Assist Quality Assurance with all plant audits.
* Industrial Wastewater: Check wastewater facility daily. Review daily reports as required.
* Sanitation: Review CIP records daily. Review random equipment checks with chemical account representative.
* Plant Employees: Audit sampling techniques and sanitation practices. Monitor production departments throughout shift and assure employee compliance with GMP’s, sanitation and safety. Provide training as needed. Provide annual GMP and HACCP training.
* Purchasing: Review and approve order supplies. Track purchases and prepare appropriate paperwork.
* Equipment: Verify that all plant equipment is in good working condition and all preventative maintenance is being performed on a scheduled basis. Review and approve all work orders. Review all daily maintenance activity reports. Develop capital justifications to update equipment as needed.
* Environmental: Review of Air Quality annual reports. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Form R for EPA/Health Department. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Hazardous Materials Inventory and Business Plan. Perform other duties, as necessary.
* Safety: Review Safety program and training with EHS management. Daily observation during plant audit will include safety. Check each department and observe employee safety procedures. Member of the Food Safety Team and Food Quality Team.
* Leadership: Utilize Code of Conduct and core values to drive development and growth opportunities for all team members.
* Support a company culture of continuous improvement by participating in efficiency and improvement efforts.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* This position has management and employee supervisory responsibilities for the entire facility in the area of discipline, hiring, and firing.
* Review on the job training reviews.
* Coordinate on the job training.
* Oversee adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee scheduling of management, employees, and temporary labor.
* Have the responsibility of reviewing timesheets, overtime and approve payroll.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:**

* An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Must have the ability to trouble shoot problems and be persistent until a solution is found.
* Must work in a safe manner and follow all safety procedures including use of safety equipment.
* Must be willing to ask for assistance when the process is unclear.
* Proficient in verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to communicate with upper management on a daily basis.
* Leadership, team development, coaching, and / or teaching experience.
* Good math and statistical skills.
* Excellent computer skills for data input, report writing, program tracking.
* Excellent organizational and follow through skills.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Dairy or Food Science and four years of experience in a Plant leadership role in a Dairy or Food Manufacturing facility is strongly desired.

records.description:
Our Plant Manager is responsible for the daily production processing of our Laundry facility. Managing the employees in our production, warehouse, and maintenance departments, you will be responsible for monitoring production flow, controlling costs, maintaining quality standards, and regulating product inventory. Managerial duties include all staffing, transfer, promotion, coaching, training, terminating, and employee review responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* We require 1+ years of managerial or supervisory experience, in a production environment
* Qualified candidates should have previous experience controlling budgets, setting schedules, and meeting production deadlines
* Production-line scheduling experience
* Staff scheduling experience
* Lean management experience utilizing computer controls
* Must be growth oriented and career minded
* Good communication skills are required
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required
* Bachelors Degree Preferred.

**Benefits of working at Prudential Overall Supply:**

* Competitive hourly rate. We know your time and hard work is valuable!
* Exceptional Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off for vacation, holidays and sick time
* Full Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Life Insurance
* 401K with company match
* Profit sharing. When we do well as a company, you do well!
* Regular work schedule, Monday – Friday
* Uniform Provided
* Employee Discounts
* Career development and advancement within the company. Let us help you reach your goals!

**Company History:** Since 1932, Prudential Overall Supply continues to provide best-in-class solutions for a business’ uniform and textile needs. Service programs include uniform rental, uniform lease, uniform purchase for industrial uniform programs and related services. We have been deemed essential in the services we provide to our clients and community. Prudential is grateful for the exceptional work produced by our industry-best tenured employees, and to our exceptional customer patronage. It is this connection that enables Prudential to provide our customers with the best possible products and service at a fair price, today and into the future.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Prudential Overall Supply is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or employing any individual on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ancestry, religion, physical or intellectual disability, age veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, or any other factor protected by anti-discriminatory laws

* Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, the Plant Manager is responsible for providing management direction and leadership to ensure that the energy facility is operated in a safe, reliable, and economic manner consistent with site contracts, permits, and rules and regulations.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
 

* Operates the facility in a safe manner and ensures that a safe work environment is provided to minimize the risk of accidents and injuries.
* Compliance with all company policies, procedures, and commercial commitments
* Implement programs and activities that provide a work environment that promotes effective goal accomplishment, productivity, and morale
* Optimize plant performance through appropriate utilization manpower, equipment, supplies and external support.
* Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities for the team to ensure appropriate skill sets are maintained
* Establish procedures and controls to manage all expense activities to conform to established budgets
* Communicate effectively with the site staff, management, customers, vendors, and outside agencies
* Demonstrate effective management skills in meeting or exceeding facility goals and objectives

 
QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

* A four-year degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or commensurate experience is required as well demonstrated track record of successful goal achievement
* A minimum of ten (10) to fifteen (15) year’s relevant experience, with a minimum of ten years in a management position.
* A through, demonstrated knowledge of energy facility operations and maintenance as well as management methods necessary to control and improve facility performance.
* Experience managing and supervising employees operating Gas Turbine, Plant Auxiliary Equipment, and Emergency Generators.
* Experience in tracking and reporting Individuals for this position must have good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 50 pounds), walking, and stooping.
* Ability to manage a schedule in a timely and accurate manner
* Ability to handle other administrative duties as assigned by management
* Moderate to advanced MS Outlook Excel, Powerpoint, and Word

 
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS
 

* GOLD STEAM AND RED REFRIGERATION
* NJ STEAM AND CHILLED WATER LICENSES

 
JOB REQUIREMENTS
 
 
Demonstrated knowledge of all facets of power plant operations. Demonstrated ability to make competent decisions in emergency situations, writing operating procedures and training of other personnel. Demonstrate good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 75 pounds), walking, and stooping.

Salary Range: 140K-175K annually

Location:
Niles, IL, US, 60714

Segment: Operations

Rich’s, also known as Rich Products Corporation, is a family-owned food company dedicated to inspiring possibilities. From cakes and icings to pizza, appetizers and specialty toppings, our products are used in homes, restaurants and bakeries around the world. Beyond great food, our customers also gain insights to help them stay competitive, no matter their size. Our portfolio includes creative solutions geared at helping food industry professionals compete in foodservice, retail, in-store bakery, deli, and prepared foods, among others. With more than 13,500 associates working globally in 100 countries and annual sales of $5.9 billion, Rich’s is a global leader with a focus on everything that family makes possible. Rich’s®—Infinite Possibilities. One Family.

**Purpose Statement**
---------------------

The Plant Manager's responsibility is to provide leadership to all departments for overall vision and direction of the plant by way of guidance, direction, encouragement, training and development. Also developing and coaching managers and supervisors to excel to the peak of their performance levels. In addition to directing all managerial personnel to manage their departments and functional areas to meet the manufacturing plant’s operational and financial objectives while supporting the values, mission, vision, and priorities of Rich Products Corporation.

**Key Accountabilities and Outcomes**
-------------------------------------

* Full responsibility for the complete operation of the manufacturing facility.
* Ensures safe, efficient operation of the plant within the guidelines established by Rich Products and all governmental laws and regulations to include all food safety programs and auditing processes.
* Monitors production, inventory, safety, human resources, quality assurance, maintenance and sanitation programs.
* Plans capital projects, long range strategic planning, and succession planning.
* Promotes Lean Manufacturing concepts and leads the plant with Rich Products vision; is open to, and promotes change to continually improve and enhance the facility and workforce to stay ahead of the competition.
* Ensures ethical behavior in all aspects of managing the facility and its material and human resources.
* Responsibility for manufacturing facility’s Capital and operating budgets.
* Responsible for associate and leadership development, developing team skills, and creating a culture of engagement and continuous improvement.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelors Degree in Business Management, Food Science, Engineering, Science or similar academic disciplines.
* 5-10 Years Experience at the Plant Management Position and 5-10 years in a supervisory and or management position with progressively more responsible positions.
* Knowledge of Food Safety, Associate Safety Programs/Systems HAACP, GMPs etc. Sanitation and Plant Maintenance and Continuous Improvement such as Lean Manufacturing and Total Productive Manufacturinng (TPM) would be definite assets.
* A Master’s in Business Administration is preferred but not required.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and cultural sensitivity required. Foreign Language skills as it relates to the facility’s demographics are a plus.
* Ability to manage a diverse staff of managerial personnel.
* Experience with self-directed teams/skill-based pay.

As a family-owned company, caring for our associates—their whole selves—is a top priority. That’s why we provide benefits and tools to help our people balance the integration of work and life:

* Competitive compensation
* Health & financial benefits
* Paid time off

* Family planning support
* Flexible work policy

* Volunteering & community impact opportunities

It’s all part of how we support our family of associates. ***Because in the company of family, all things are possible.***

records.description:
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc.

**Plant Manager**

Ellisville, MS, United States | req34514

**What you will enjoy doing\***

* Lead the Ellisville manufacturing operation with full accountability for Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC), while ensuring customer commitments and business objectives are consistently achieved
* Build and develop a high-performing leadership team by setting clear expectations, coaching managers and supervisors, strengthening accountability, and developing organizational capability and succession
* You will drive the PGT Lean Operating System through daily management, leader standard work, visual management, structured problem solving, standard work, and continuous improvement
* Be a visible leader on the shop floor, working with teams at the source to identify problems, remove barriers, strengthen process discipline, and ensure corrective actions address root causes and are sustained
* Improve operational performance and reliability by strengthening equipment performance, first-pass yield, flow, WIP, productivity, capacity, and on-time delivery while maintaining uncompromising safety and quality standards
* Develop and execute the site strategy, aligning workforce, training, equipment, materials, capital, and capacity with customer demand, growth priorities, and long-term business requirements
* Own the financial performance of the facility, including budgets, labor efficiency, overtime, productivity, cost improvement, operational spending, and capital priorities
* Also, you will lead cross-functionally and create a strong site culture, partnering with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS, Human Resources, and Finance while fostering respect, transparency, employee engagement, urgency, and continuous improvement

**What makes you great**

* You have a Bachelor’s degree with ten (10) or more years of related manufacturing experience, a Master’s degree with eight (8) or more years, a PhD with five (5) or more years, or sixteen (16) or more years of directly related manufacturing experience
* Further you have significant manufacturing leadership experience with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and operational results
* You have successfully led leaders, including managers and frontline supervisors, and know how to build capability rather than becoming the organization’s primary problem solver
* You have demonstrated experience applying Lean principles, daily management, standard work, and structured problem solving to deliver measurable operational improvement
* And you bring strong financial and business acumen, with experience managing budgets, labor, productivity, operating costs, and capital priorities
* Experience in aerospace, coatings, special processes, precision manufacturing, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment is strongly preferred
* You are comfortable leading change in a complex manufacturing environment and can move effectively between strategy, data, the shop floor, and customer and business priorities
* Most importantly, you lead with humility, accountability, transparency, respect for people, and a bias for action, while developing others and creating sustainable systems for success

**Why you will love working with us**

Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet.
 
 
Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

**What we offer you!**

At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless. 
 
Linde offers competitive compensation and an outstanding benefits package. Enjoy access to health, dental, disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and vacation, 401(k) matching, pension benefits, an employee discount program, and opportunities for educational and professional growth. Additional compensation may vary depending on the position and organizational level. Build your future with us while making an impact every day!

**Have we inspired you? Let´s talk about it**

We are looking forward to receiving your complete application.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law. 
 
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. abides by applicable export control laws including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) in accordance with the company's export control procedures. As such, persons considered for this position must be either a U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder) or otherwise classifiable as a U.S. person under relevant regulations. 
 
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development. 
 

* The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Therefore employees assigned may be required to perform additional job tasks required by the manager.

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
 

**Curious? Apply now!**

Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.

We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov

**Any further questions?**

If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

records.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
records.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

records.title: Senior Manager Quality
records.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
