records.title: Sr. Manager - Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Lead continuous improvement at our Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility, where your work will shape performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. As a key member of the plant leadership team, you will set the CI vision, advise site leaders on strategy and lead a team of continuous improvement professionals.

You will own the plant's management operating system and annual cost-out process while building the capabilities that sustain results. This role combines enterprise-level thinking with daily visibility on the plant floor, giving you the opportunity to turn data, Lean methods and cross-functional partnership into measurable operational gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the plant's continuous improvement strategy, creating the behaviors, systems and culture needed to achieve plant goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the salaried continuous improvement team while building Lean problem-solving capability across functions.
* Own the plant management operating system, annual cost-out process and A3 strategy documents, including daily, weekly and monthly performance tracking.
* Identify, scope and prioritize breakthrough and incremental improvement opportunities using plant data and operational metrics.
* Teach and model root-cause analysis, DMAIC, standard work, waste reduction, recurrence prevention and structured follow-up.
* Facilitate Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield and equipment effectiveness.
* Maintain the plant continuous improvement project docket, track savings and communicate project status and results to operations leadership.
* Partner with operations, engineering and technical teams to implement sustainable solutions and share best practices across PCB facilities.
* Serve as a change leader who constructively challenges non-value-added work and helps teams navigate resistance to change.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* A visible seat on the plant leadership team with direct influence on site strategy and operational performance.
* The opportunity to build CI capability across the organization and leave a clear handprint on how the plant works.
* Broad collaboration with operations, engineering and CI leaders across Post Consumer Brands.
* A role where big company resources meet a practical, hands-on plant environment.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* This role is based at the Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility.

**Education**

* A bachelor's degree in science, engineering, management or a related field is preferred.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 3 or more years of successful leadership experience guiding teams that execute continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma work.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable efficiency, effectiveness and financial benefits through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience operating in a large manufacturing plant environment.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methods, including root-cause analysis, DMAIC, Kaizen and waste reduction.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, use operational data to set priorities and sustain improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in food manufacturing.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.
* Experience in food or automotive manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading Black Belt-level or transformational cost-out initiatives.

**Success in This Role**

* Builds trust and strong working relationships across plant leadership, operations, engineering and frontline teams.
* Influences, coaches and develops others while setting clear expectations and maintaining accountability for results.
* Communicates a compelling improvement vision and translates complex problems into organized, practical action plans.
* Uses sound analytical and business judgment to solve complex problems and prioritize actions quickly.
* Leads change with candor, optimism and respect, including in environments where established ways of working may be challenged.
* Demonstrates a consistent commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to lead transformational improvement, develop strong teams and help a large manufacturing operation perform at its best, bring your experience and big ambitions to Post Consumer Brands.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

 
 

Hyve Solutions is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Manufacturing Engineering Manager to lead engineering operations within our fast-paced, high-volume PCBA manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for driving manufacturing process development, equipment performance, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring the successful transition of new products from introduction (NPI) into stable, scalable mass production. The ideal candidate combines strong SMT/PCBA technical expertise with proven leadership capabilities, a passion for solving complex manufacturing challenges, and a proactive, floor-oriented approach to engineering. We are looking for a leader who takes ownership of manufacturing performance, develops strong engineering teams, and drives practical, sustainable solutions that improve quality, throughput, efficiency, and operational scalability.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and manage the Manufacturing Engineering team, establishing clear priorities, technical accountability, and performance expectations
* Own manufacturing process development, optimization, and technical support across SMT, automated assembly, soldering, inspection, and related PCBA manufacturing operations
* Lead the transition of new products from NPI into high-volume production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process capability, equipment qualification, and sustainable production performance
* Partner with NPI, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify manufacturability risks, resolve technical challenges, and establish robust production processes
* Drive equipment programming, process parameter optimization, machine capability improvements, and automation initiatives to maximize manufacturing efficiency and reliability
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in troubleshooting complex equipment failures, process defects, yield losses, and recurring production issues
* Establish and improve manufacturing process controls, validation methods, and standardized engineering practices to ensure consistent product quality and repeatability
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing-related defects, equipment issues, and process instability
* Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, equipment, tooling, and automation solutions to improve production capability and support business growth
* Support manufacturing capacity expansion, equipment installation, production line integration, and facility transitions while minimizing operational disruptions
* Analyze manufacturing performance metrics, including yield, cycle time, throughput, downtime, and process capability, to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable results
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials teams to establish manufacturing priorities, resolve production constraints, and improve overall operational performance
* Develop and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, process documentation, work instructions, and change control processes to support consistent execution
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on defect reduction, equipment utilization, labor efficiency, cost reduction, and manufacturing scalability
* Develop engineering talent through technical mentorship, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of team capabilities

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience, including 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role, preferred
* Preferred hands-on experience in SMT and PCBA manufacturing processes, including pick and place equipment, solder paste printing, reflow soldering, AOI, AXI, selective soldering, and related manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated success transitioning products from NPI through production qualification, ramp-up, and sustained high-volume manufacturing
* Experience with industrial automation, equipment integration, machine programming, and manufacturing process controls
* Proven ability to lead technical teams, establish accountability, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
* Strong understanding of manufacturing process validation, root cause analysis, defect reduction, yield improvement, and equipment reliability
* Familiarity with IPC standards, DFM/DFT principles, PFMEA, SPC, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Familiarity with ISO9001 and ISO14001

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

Benefit Insurance

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Mental Health Care
* 401K with match
* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Perks at Work
* LEAP Program
* MyFlexPay

***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality & QMS
records.description:
**Job Overview:**

The Senior Manager, Quality & QMS is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for Intech’s medical device manufacturing operations.

This position provides senior-level leadership for all site quality activities, including production quality, nonconformance management, CAPA, internal and external audits, supplier quality, document and record control, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. A primary responsibility of the role will be to lead the organization in developing and implementing an effective QMS and preparing the site for ISO 9001 certification.

This position will serve as the primary quality leader for the site and will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, and other functional leaders to ensure that quality is integrated into the business and manufacturing processes rather than operating as a separate inspection function. This role is a hands-on position and will operate strategically while also working directly with manufacturing personnel to establish practical, sustainable quality processes.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System.
* Lead the organization through its ISO 9001 readiness and certification process.
* Establish and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and other QMS documentation.
* Establish effective document and record control processes.
* Develop quality objectives, metrics, and management-review processes.
* Ensure QMS processes are understood, implemented, and effective across the organization.
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement and develop practical plans to address them.
* Provide leadership for quality throughout the manufacturing process.
* Establish appropriate inspection, testing, sampling, and process-control requirements.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify and eliminate sources of variation and defects.
* Monitor production quality performance and trends.
* Lead efforts to reduce scrap, rework, defects, and recurring quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for nonconforming product(s), product identification, traceability, and inspection status.
* Support process changes, equipment changes, product introductions, and manufacturing improvements from a quality perspective.
* Own and continuously improve the site's CAPA and nonconformance processes.
* Lead investigations into significant quality issues and recurring nonconformances.
* Establish effective root-cause analysis and corrective-action practices.
* Ensure corrective actions address systemic causes and are implemented and verified for effectiveness.
* Monitor CAPA and NCR trends to identify broader process and systemic issues.
* Establish appropriate escalation of significant quality risks to site leadership.
* Develop and manage the internal audit program.
* Conduct or oversee internal QMS and process audits.
* Coordinate customer, certification, surveillance, and other external audits.
* Serve as the primary quality contact during external audits.
* Ensure audit findings are appropriately investigated, corrected, and closed.
* Build an organization that is continuously audit-ready rather than preparing only immediately before an audit.
* Establish and maintain supplier quality processes.
* Develop supplier qualification, evaluation, monitoring, and re-evaluation practices.
* Establish supplier quality expectations in partnership with Supply Chain and Operations.
* Monitor supplier quality performance and trends.
* Lead or support supplier corrective actions.
* Participate in supplier selection and qualification activities as appropriate.
* Address recurring supplier issues through effective root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Establish meaningful quality metrics and dashboards.
* Monitor trends in NCRs, CAPAs, audits, supplier performance, scrap, rework, customer issues, and other relevant indicators.
* Translate quality data into actionable improvement initiatives.
* Provide regular quality performance updates to leadership.
* Use structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve processes and reduce risk.
* Develop strong working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization.
* Partner closely with manufacturing personnel to solve problems at the source.
* Provide quality leadership, coaching, and training.
* Establish clear expectations for quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Promote a culture of prevention, accountability, disciplined problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate quality risks clearly and objectively to leadership.

*Management reserves the right to change job duties and responsibilities at any time. Therefore, this job description is not designed to cover every requirement of the job.*

**Education and Work Experience Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in quality, quality systems, manufacturing quality, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, managing, or significantly improving a Quality Management System.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001.
* Must have demonstrated experience taking an organization through ISO 9001 certification.
* Demonstrated experience with CAPA, nonconformance management, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience with supplier quality and supplier corrective actions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both production personnel and senior leadership.
* Ability to establish structure and processes in an environment where the QMS is still developing.
* Medical device manufacturing experience preferred.
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor training/certification preferred.
* ASQ certification such as CQA, CQE, or CMQ/OE.
* Experience with statistical process control, process capability, risk management, or other quality engineering tools.
* Lean Six Sigma or other continuous-improvement experience a plus.
* Familiarity with applicable medical-device quality and regulatory requirements a plus

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with company policies
* Must occasionally lift, carry and/or move up to 25 lbs.
* Occasionally required to stand, walk, bend, and constantly sit for extended periods
* Must be able to talk, listen and speak clearly on the telephone
* Continually required to read, write, and type
* Occasional exposure to heat or cold (non-weather) environments
* Occasionally required to use hand/arm movements such as grasping, reaching, pulling

records.title: Senior Manager of Production
records.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

records.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
records.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance
records.description:
**Allied Air Enterprises** is a division of Lennox International. We bring together the collective strengths of seven comfort brands – Armstrong Air, AirEase, Concord, Ducane, Allied, Allied Commercial and Magic-Pak to give distributors and dealers the ultimate source for heating and cooling solutions. From compact residential applications to large commercial projects, Allied Aire Enterprises redefines ease-of-business through breadth of product, resources and competencies unparalleled in the market.

**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.

The Plant Quality Assurance Senior Manager is responsible for developing and implementing quality policies and procedures to ensure production meets established standards. This role leads the quality function at the plant level, driving continuous improvement, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the development and execution of quality assurance protocols and testing models.
* Oversee sampling procedures, techniques, and equipment to ensure consistency and accuracy.
* Design and implement methods to maintain quality throughout the production lifecycle.
* Manage ongoing inspection, testing, analysis, and resolution processes to uphold quality standards.
* Identify quality variances and recommend corrective actions to maintain compliance with specifications.
* Ensure timely and cost-effective completion of quality-related projects.
* Lead and develop the Quality team, focusing on talent development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Collaborate with customers to define and resolve product quality issues and develop cost-effective quality programs.
* Review product designs and recommend specification revisions to enhance quality and manufacturability.
* Develop and execute quality management strategies aligned with short-term business goals and long-term objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Six Sigma, SPC, and other statistical methodologies.
* Oversee calibration systems and repair depot operations for gauges, fixtures, instruments, and tooling.
* Maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure quality standards are met across the supply chain.
* Champion a culture of quality and employee engagement across all levels of the organization.

### **Qualifications:**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related industrial field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality management, preferably in assembly processes.
* At least 3 years of direct management experience.
* Extensive knowledge of quality systems, policies, and procedures.
* Proven expertise in statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root cause analysis, and data-driven problem solving.
* Demonstrated ability to present quality initiatives and solutions using ROI and business modeling.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and persuasion skills.
* Excellent organizational and computer skills.
* Effective leadership and people management capabilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to gain employee buy-in and foster collaboration.

**Other Work Requirements**

* This is an on-site role based in Orangeburg, SC (This position is 100% onsite)

records.title: Sr. Director Quality & Regulatory Compliance
records.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**SCOPE OF ROLE:**

The Senior Director of Quality and Regulatory Compliance is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive quality strategy supporting both the Optics and Fluidics business segments across multiple sites. This leader will drive a high-performing quality organization that delivers best-in-class product quality, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

This role provides oversight of the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Document Control, and Inspection functions. The Senior Director will champion a culture of continuous improvement, proactive risk management, and customer-centric quality while aligning quality strategies with broader business goals.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

### **Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the global Idex Health & Science Quality organization, including talent development, performance management, and organizational design (6 international locations)
* Serve as the designated Management Representative, ensuring the effectiveness of the QMS and alignment with business objectives
* Establish and communicate a clear quality vision and strategy across Optics and Fluidics operations

### **Quality Systems & Governance**

* Oversee and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Ensure quality objectives are defined, tracked, and communicated to leadership with clear visibility into performance and risk
* Lead internal and external audit readiness and execution, ensuring timely and effective resolution of findings

### **Performance Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

* Define, implement, and monitor key quality metrics and KPIs to measure internal performance and customer outcomes
* Present quality performance insights to executive leadership and external stakeholders
* Drive a culture of Root Cause Problem Solving (RCPS) and Continuous Improvement (CI) across all functions and product lifecycles
* Lead Cost of Quality (COQ) initiatives to improve operational and financial performance

### **Operational Quality & Engineering Support**

* Partner with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure quality is embedded across production processes
* Provide leadership for Quality Engineering support, addressing non-conformances through the NCMR system and driving escalation when appropriate
* Lead and oversee Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes, ensuring sustainable solutions to systemic issues
* Support Design for Manufacturability, Testability, and Reliability in new product introductions, transfers, and sustaining initiatives

### **Supplier & Customer Quality**

* Oversee supplier qualification and audit programs, ensuring supplier performance meets quality expectations
* Partner with Incoming Quality Assurance (IQA) to resolve non-conforming materials and drive supplier corrective actions
* Support customer-facing quality activities, including RMAs, complaint investigations, and corrective action programs
* Drive a customer-centric quality approach aligned with performance expectations

### **Inspection, MRB, and Compliance**

* Oversee Inspection and Document Control functions to ensure product and process compliance
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process, managing non-conforming materials including incoming, WIP, and finished goods
* Ensure timely disposition, containment, and systemic resolution of quality issues

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Regulatory teams to drive quality across the value stream
* Lead and participate in cross-functional initiatives and special projects as assigned
* Act as a change agent to challenge the status quo and drive cultural transformation toward proactive quality

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline strongly preferred; advanced degree a plus
* Minimum 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience
* At least 5 years leading quality across multiple manufacturing sites (or equivalent complexity) required
* Demonstrated success in regulated manufacturing environments

**Technical Expertise**
-----------------------

* Deep knowledge of Quality Management Systems and regulatory standards (ISO 9001, ISO 13485)
* Strong background in quality assurance within manufacturing/operations environments
* Experience with internal auditing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Proficiency in Six Sigma, Lean, and/or Total Quality Management (preferred)
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities
* Strong ability to influence at all organizational levels and build cross-functional partnerships

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

**Total Rewards**

The compensation range for this position is $158,600.00 - $237,800.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

**Benefits Package**

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our-benefits-and-rewards/

**IDEX is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. IDEX gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other consideration or protected category made unlawful by federal, state or local laws.

**Attention Applicants:** If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact our Talent Acquisition Team at lfcareers@idexcorp.com for assistance with an accommodation. These contact tools may be used only by individuals with a disability for accommodation requests. Do not inquire as to the status of an application.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

‌

Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess or select applicants.

records.title: Director of Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

In this role, you will guide enterprise-wide continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen operational performance, enhance quality, and increase efficiency across multiple manufacturing sites. You will lead efforts that reduce waste, improve process capability, and support teams in optimizing complex aerospace and defense production workflows, helping ensure mission-critical hardware is delivered with consistent excellence.

#### **Duties/Responsibilities**

* Develops and deploys a multi-site continuous improvement roadmap aligned with corporate objectives.
* Leads lean, six sigma, and value stream mapping initiatives to drive operational excellence.
* Identifies and eliminates non value added activities across machining, fabrication, and downstream processing.
* Develops, tracks, and reports enterprise metrics for cost savings, yield improvements, and cycle time reduction.
* Partners with manufacturing engineering, quality, and supply chain to improve process capabilities.
* Facilitates advanced root cause problem solving activities to address systemic production bottlenecks.
* Plans and executes kaizen events focused on setup reduction, 5S workplace organization, and cellular manufacturing.
* Mentors and develops employees in lean and six sigma methodologies.
* Ensures continuous improvement initiatives support and maintain AS9100 and product safety standards.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 8-10 years of operations or continuous improvement leadership in aerospace and defense manufacturing.
* Certified lean six sigma master black belt or black belt.
* Experience with AS9100 quality management systems and defense contract management agency (DCMA) oversight.
* Background in precision machining, structural fabrication, or aerospace assemblies.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning (ERP) and manufacturing execution system (MES) data analysis.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Master of business administration (MBA) or master's degree.

#### **Special Mentions**

* Travel is required across regional manufacturing sites.

#### **Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health savings account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible spending accounts (FSA)
* Company-paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short- and long-term disability coverage

records.title: Director Quality
records.description:
**Job Summary**

Responsible for providing leadership and direction to Quality team(s) to ensure quality and compliance for the applicable products and processes for assigned department(s). Develop strategy, translate into functional plans and guide execution of long-term goals.

**Job Description**

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Direct the development of product specifications for Medline branded products; such as the testing requirements, procedures and methods for testing, inspecting or qualifying new products and suppliers.
* Partner with Supplier Audit department and Division to determine optimal Supplier relationship.
* Develop and implement strategy for the Quality department(s) based upon Quarterly Management Review.
* Prepare and deliver Customer presentations.
* Act as liaison with Senior Leadership of Divisions, Suppliers, Manufacturing, and/or Operations to ensure quality products, on time delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Suppliers, manufacturing partners and product managers in developing and implementing QA programs.
* Oversee QSR for assigned department(s) and ensure compliance as measured by FDA/ISO/internal audits.
* Management responsibilities include:
* Typically, manages through multiple Managers. Provides leadership and management to one or more major departments of an operating unit or to a department that has system-wide accountability.
* Strategic, tactical and operational planning (12 + months) for the function or department;
* Direct budgetary responsibility for one or more departments, functions or major projects/programs;
* Interpret and execute policies for departments/projects and develops;
* Recommend and implement new policies or modifications to existing policies;
Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies. 

 

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or Technical Field.

**Certification / Licensure:**

* None

**Work Experience:**

* At least 7 years of experience related to the design/operation of medical device or drug combination product platforms, design controls, risk management, including working in compliance with QSR/GMP/ISO requirements or other regulated industries (21CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR).
* At least 4 years of management experience.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:**

* Depth of technical knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (21CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR etc.)
* Proficiency in analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to control and coordinate concurrent projects, competing priorities and critical deadlines.
* Advanced level skill in Microsoft Excel (for example: using AVERAGE function, merging and centering cells, printing centered page and/or creating a pivot table).
Position requires travel up to 30% of the time for business purposes (within state, out of state and/or internationally). 

 

**PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

* None

**Certification / Licensure:**

* None

**Work Experience:**

* At least 6 years of managerial experience preferred.
* At least 8 years of related experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Food, Cosmetic, or Personal Products industries preferred.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:**

* None

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

The anticipated salary range for this position:

$154,000.00 - $231,000.00 Annual

The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. This role is bonus and/or incentive eligible. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold.

Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp.

We’re dedicated to creating a Medline where everyone feels they belong and can grow their career. We strive to do this by seeking diversity in all forms, acting inclusively, and ensuring that people have tools and resources to perform at their best. Explore our Belonging page here .

Medline Industries, LP is an equal opportunity employer. Medline evaluates qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, neurodivergence, protected veteran status, marital or family status, caregiver responsibilities, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

records.title: Director of Quality Improvement Strategy
records.description:
**About CCNC:**

From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. Informed by statewide data and predictive analytics, community-based care-managers work with local physicians and diverse teams of health professionals to develop whole-person plans of care that connect people to the right local resources and increase equity and access to high quality care.

**CCNC Mission Statement**

To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community-based healthcare delivery systems.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy is responsible for setting the vision for the organization’s Quality Improvement strategy, in collaboration with the Population Health Division and aligned with CCNC’s mission and strategic goals. The aim of the QI strategy is to ensure the CCPN member practices deliver high - quality health care that drives successful performance of the Clinically Integrated Network (CIN).

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy in coordination with the Clinical Performance and Practice Engagement teams, will direct, plan, implement, monitor, coordinate, and evaluate all aspects of the QI strategy and oversee daily operations to ensure that CCNC’s strategic plan is implemented. implements and informs process improvement to create standardized and streamlined processes, workflows, and education. The Director of QI Strategy provides direct supervision of the QI Specialist and the Value Based Care Program Specialist.

Responsibilities include outreach, education, training, hands-on participative leadership, and development of an increased capacity to successfully execute performance improvement across the organization. Working directly with others across the organization, The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy ensures that the elements of the QI strategy allow for coordination and collaboration of multifaceted initiatives with practices that serve our covered populations with consideration of resources, cost savings and quality. This includes providing strategic input on the development of organizational goals, to include measurement criteria and interventions for achieving the goals.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

**Operationalize QI Strategy**
------------------------------

* Direct the implementation of Quality Improvement efforts to support CCPN practices and CCNC programming in accordance with the strategic plan.
* Establish and implement the process for how PRRs utilize the QI plans to drive performance with CCPN practices.
* Facilitate the development of programs, systems, workflows, and integration efforts in alignment with CCNC and CCPN’s contractual, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Apply QI methodology, change management strategies, team facilitation, and coaching principles to achieve program effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Mentor and train on QI methodology, change management, and coaching principles (e.g. Model for Improvement, PDSA, Lean,).
* Demonstrate subject matter expertise and knowledge of payment models and their associated quality measures.
* Serve as the subject matter expert and lead for key projects and initiatives; including developing detailed work plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring project progress and ensuring spread and sustainability.
* Assist CCPN and CCNC with future program development, creation or delegation of accountability and ownership for program roles and continuous process improvement.
* Develop annual Quality Plans with the Value Based Care Program practices in coordination with key focus areas identified by Clinical Performance.
* Represent and demonstrate our QI strategy in monthly Joint Operating Council meetings with the Value Based Care Program practices.
* Support the Practice Based Care Coordination (PBCC) program through data mining, identification of opportunities for improvement, regular practice monitoring, and ongoing training & support for the QIPS team.
* Engage and maintain collaborative relationships with the health care community, including but not limited to primary care providers, practice managers & practice team members, health departments, FQHCs and other community partners.
* Serve as Liaison on local, regional and state workgroups and collaborative efforts.
* Partner with the QI leaders for payers to establish collaborative and effective working relationships.

* Collaborate with the Clinical Performance team to use data to evaluate the effectiveness of projects across departments
* Advise leadership on project-specific data and information needs in support of staff.
* Identify areas of opportunity for CCPN practices through clinical data analysis, interpretation, & presentation.
* Lead the QI PS team to provide excellent training and support to member practices that facilitate effective use of the organization’s value-based care data platform
* In coordination with the Clinical Performance team, train on data definitions, data interpretation and data analysis

***Staff Management and Supervision***

* Lean / Six Sigma certification a plus.

records.description:
**Job Overview**

Flexim Group is seeking an experienced Global Account Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership for a strategic international account operating across complex sites and manufacturing environments.

Based in Jersey City, you will hold global accountability for operational performance across the account, leading regional and site teams to deliver consistent FM and technical services, safety, compliance and business continuity.

This is a management operations role requiring strong experience, technical credibility and the ability to lead through senior regional and site operations teams. You will set operational standards, challenge performance, manage critical escalations and translate global client priorities into disciplined execution across countries and facilities.

**Duties**

* Lead global operational performance across a complex, multi-country manufacturing account.
* Lead and challenge regional and site Operations Managers, ensuring clear accountability and consistent execution.
* Drive services excellence, with a strong focus on asset reliability, maintenance, utilities and critical infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce global operational standards, while ensuring effective implementation at regional and site level.
* Monitor and challenge operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, CMMS/BMS data, maintenance completion, backlog and asset uptime.
* Lead critical operational escalations.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, service quality and cost performance.
* Lead global account financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control and profitability.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into operational priorities and measurable results.
* Act as the senior operational authority for the account, providing executive-level governance, reporting and decision-making.

**Experience**

* Substantial operational leadership experience in Integrated Facilities Management, ideally across a multi-country portfolio.
* Strong working knowledge of hard FM and building engineering services
* Demonstrated experience controlling SLAs, KPIs, CMMS workflows, asset registers, maintenance backlogs and technical compliance.
* Proven ownership of account P&L, budgeting, forecasting, subcontractor costs and commercial change control.
* Experience leading dispersed operational teams and managing specialist service providers across different regulatory environments.
* Confident client-facing leadership, supported by operational discipline, sound judgement and a willingness to be present on site.
* Significant leadership experience within Integrated Facilities Management.
* Proven success managing complex global or multi-country client accounts.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong understanding of operational excellence, governance and performance management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills.
* A proactive, accountable and client-centric leadership style.

Pay: $135,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jersey City, NJ 07307

records.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the South region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Quincy, as well as Middleton, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

This role plays a critical part in shaping the Tufts Medicine ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery and expansion of exceptional care within the community.

Location: Hybrid and at sites within the designated region (e.g., Quincy & Middleton)

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. Responsibilities typically include: ownership of short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Department, problems faced are often complex and require extensive investigation and analysis, and requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate and influence executive leadership.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

**Pay Range****:**

 
$134,525.66 - $171,524.44

*based on full-time equivalent*

records.title: Operations Director
records.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

* Dental insurance

* Flexible spending account

* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence will focus on delivery excellence, process optimization, resource management, and stakeholder management. The Director will be an operational leader who develops frameworks and effective ways of working on which our organization can build in the coming years. This includes ownership of organizational resource tracking, resource planning, hiring process support, and staff augmentation vendor management, so the organization has the right talent in the right roles at the right time in line with funds planning. The Director and team will ensure that the organization develops and fully integrates a continuous improvement culture, with the ultimate goal of ensuring team efficiency, and financial effectiveness.

 

* Leads priorities focused on service delivery and capability alignment, resource management, budget/financial management, vendor and technology management, communications, and training
* Partners with the Leadership Team in short- and long-term planning activities that align with the organization’s strategy, vision, operational plan, and goals
* Establishes and maintains organization-wide resource tracking, providing visibility into headcount, allocation, capacity, utilization, and cost across colleagues and contingent workers
* Leads resource planning in partnership with the Leadership Team and Finance, forecasting demand, identifying capability and capacity gaps, and recommending the right mix of full-time and augmented staff
* Supports hiring processes in partnership with Talent Acquisition and PX, including position requests and approvals, job description development, requisition tracking, interview coordination, and onboarding readiness
* Manages processes related to staff augmentation vendors, including vendor selection, rate and contract negotiation, performance management, and spend oversight
* Drives innovative thinking and planning, leveraging new technologies as needed, to address the needs of the organization and its individual capabilities
* Challenges the status quo and drives continuous improvement by establishing a solid foundation and implementing standard ways of working, systems, processes, and frameworks.
* Works closely with cross-functional peers and team members to consolidate efforts for org processes improvements, but also applies independent decision making to ensure best possible approach is being implemented.
* Promotes a continuous improvement mindset and process improvement initiatives through communication, training, and best practices, ensuring accountability through governance.
* Has critical impact on significant reduction of administrative and redundant tasks across Engineering & Technology organization through applying most efficient and suitable AI tools and bringing in innovative ways of working.
* Builds, develops, and grows relationships with internal and external stakeholders and vendors at every level
* Serves as strategic program/project manager for key organizational projects. Has direct accountability for budget assigned to these projects and management of related vendors, supports oversight processes for organizational budget.
* Coaches, mentors, and supports the professional growth of direct reports. Responsible for efficient resource and funds allocation within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelors degree and 8+ years relevant work experience

Strong written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills

Proven analytical and critical thinking skills, and strong background in process improvement

Practical experience with operational, process improvement, gaining efficiencies and project management methodologies and ability to lead project teams

Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines

Strong ability for independent decision making while working closely with cross-functional peers

Demonstrated ability to manage/lead complex projects, including resource and budget management for assigned projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

Masters degree in related field

Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industry experience

Practical experience with organization setup processes that include job descriptions creation, managing hiring processes with human resources, sourcing contracted resources.

Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB)

Knowledge of or expertise in Digital product development and/or Design Thinking

Experience driving change in a global, matrixed organization

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

National and International travel may be necessary

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Last Date to Apply for Job: 11/30/2026

 
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. 
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

**Sunshine Act**

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.
