Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. postedPay.title: Director of Supplier Quality - Operations & Compliance

records.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Director, Supplier Quality – Operations & Compliance reports to the AVP, Supplier Quality and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the Supplier Quality Assurance program across Agilent businesses and sites. This role is focused on improving product quality, process quality, supplier performance, and delivery throughout the supply base.

The Director will have direct responsibility for supplier quality processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), tools, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and the Approved Supplier List (ASL).

A key priority for this role is developing and implementing a Supplier Quality Operations strategy that centralizes and standardizes processes while ensuring consistent compliance of all processes used in the Supplier Quality organization, including Agilent sites, SQ business leads, SQ category leads, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive, self-directed leader who can build strong partnerships across Agilent and the external supply base while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Own, improve, and standardize supplier quality processes, including supplier Audits, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), Supplier Change Management, Supplier Review Boards (SRBs), and Approved Supplier List (ASL) processes.
* Partner closely with Procurement, business and site leadership, Category teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure effective and consistent execution of supplier quality processes.
* Develop, improve, and continuously monitor a standardized KPI and metrics program, including executive-level dashboards that provide meaningful, actionable visibility into supplier performance and overall supply chain health.
* Present and support Supplier Quality metrics and performance discussions during Quality Management Review (QMR) and Supplier Review Board (SRB) meetings.
* Manage the quality aspects of the Approved Supplier List in partnership with Procurement.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across the Supplier Quality function, establish project ownership, monitor progress, and ensure measurable results at project completion.
* Develop and manage the Supplier Quality outsourcing strategy, including evaluating outsourcing opportunities for audits, root cause analysis (RCA), and other Supplier Quality activities.
* Strengthen the culture of quality and compliance by identifying and implementing continuous improvement opportunities across Supplier Quality processes.
* Partner with Procurement to establish a consistent **"One-Voice Agilent"** approach when communicating with the supply base.
* Evaluate and implement a supplier portal in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Engage key supplier management teams through structured business reviews to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, address risks, and implement programs that deliver measurable performance improvements.
* Lead, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing and diverse team of Supplier Quality professionals.
* Own and manage the budget for the Supplier Quality Operations function.
* Strengthen supplier and organizational quality culture through coaching, technical engagement, and collaborative problem-solving.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related discipline preferred.

**Experience**
--------------

 

* 5+ years of direct or related experience in Supplier Quality.
* 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams.
* Experience owning or managing a Quality Management System (QMS), particularly Supplier Quality processes associated with **ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485**.
* Significant experience with sourcing, supplier management, and quality execution within highly regulated or demanding industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace and defense, or similarly complex markets.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively within a matrixed organization.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

 

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across organizational levels, functions, cultures, and external organizations.
* Proactive, self-directed leadership style with the ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and drive implementation.
* Strong commitment to quality, compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective systems and establish trust with suppliers, internal customers, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Proven ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members while fostering collaboration and teamwork.
* Ability to navigate and de-escalate challenging or high-pressure situations calmly and effectively.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate supplier and quality data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Ability to travel occasionally.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. records.title: Strategic Operations Director
records.description:
**Location:** New York, NY 
**Compensation:** $170,000 - $190,000 base salary + annual bonus 
**Travel:** 25%

In 2017, Shields established the Strategic Operations team to partner directly with the Executive Leadership Team in executing the company's highest-priority initiatives. These efforts span corporate strategy, operational transformation, performance improvement, growth execution, business development, and new business innovation. Team members gain exposure to all aspects of the organization, combining executive-level engagement with hands-on responsibility for translating strategy into measurable results. The team has served as a pathway to leadership, with alumni advancing into senior roles across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership. This role offers the opportunity to build on that legacy while helping shape Shields' next phase of growth and innovation.

The **Director of Strategic Operations** serves as a senior leader responsible for driving strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and growth across Shields' portfolio of health system specialty pharmacy partnerships. This role is ideal for individuals with experience as a **Healthcare Consulting Engagement Manager, Healthcare Strategy Leader, Strategic Operations Leader, Transformation Leader, Management Consultant, or operations executive within a private equity-backed healthcare services organization** seeking an opportunity to influence enterprise-level decision-making and organizational performance.

Leading a team of high-performing professionals, the Director will oversee complex cross-functional initiatives, deliver executive-level analyses and recommendations, and partner directly with senior leaders to drive exceptional clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. Functioning as an internal strategy and operations leader, this individual will identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and translate strategic priorities into measurable results across the organization.

This role is particularly well suited for professionals coming from **healthcare consulting, management consulting, healthcare strategy, portfolio operations, business transformation, performance improvement, or private equity-backed healthcare organizations** who are looking for the opportunity to move beyond recommendations and directly own execution. Success requires strong strategic thinking, structured problem solving, financial and operational acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a fast-paced, high-growth healthcare environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and resourceful leader who thrives in entrepreneurial settings, excels at managing ambiguity, and has a demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives that drive growth, value creation, operational excellence, and performance improvement.

**Job Duties**

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

* Serve as a key leader within the Strategic Operations team, driving growth, strategic execution, and organizational performance through both direct leadership and individual contributions.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of high-performing professionals responsible for supporting critical business initiatives across the organization.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and monitoring of strategic and operational initiatives aligned with Shields' highest-priority objectives.
* Synthesize complex operational, financial, and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

### **Strategy, Operations & Performance Improvement**

* Partner directly with Senior Vice Presidents and Regional Vice Presidents of Operations to drive strong financial, operational, and clinical outcomes across Shields' health system partnerships.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to identify, prioritize, and execute strategic objectives while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead day-to-day strategy and operational execution for a portfolio of health system partnerships.
* Develop business cases, financial models, forecasts, and performance analyses to support executive decision-making.
* Drive high-impact initiatives focused on operational excellence, growth strategy, performance improvement, transformation, and value creation.
* Conduct analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, process improvement, and partnership expansion.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior operational leaders, providing strategic guidance and analytical support.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Finance, Business Development, Clinical, Technology, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams.

### **Partnership & Stakeholder Management**

* Own and cultivate relationships with senior health system executives and key external stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic liaison between Shields leadership and health system partners to ensure alignment on priorities and objectives.
* Support executive presentations, partnership reviews, business planning sessions, and strategic steering committees.
* Translate complex analyses into compelling executive-level presentations and recommendations.

### **Growth & Innovation**

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities, ancillary services, operational enhancements, and growth initiatives that increase partnership value.
* Support strategic planning, business development, market expansion, and innovation efforts across the organization.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging healthcare opportunities to inform strategic decision-making.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, MPH, or other advanced degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record of strategic and operational leadership within healthcare.
* Experience in one or more of the following environments strongly preferred:
 + **Healthcare Consulting Firms** (Engagement Manager, Manager, Project Leader, Senior Manager, Principal, or equivalent roles)
 + **Private Equity-Backed Healthcare Services Organizations**
 + **Corporate Strategy, Strategic Operations, Transformation, Portfolio Operations, or Performance Improvement Functions**
 + **Health Systems, Specialty Pharmacy, Provider Services, Population Health, Revenue Cycle, or Healthcare Services Organizations**
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy development through implementation and performance measurement.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence, business transformation, growth strategy, and performance improvement initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
* Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations, performance updates, and business insights to executive leadership teams and Board-level audiences.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, business case development, forecasting, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading through influence in highly matrixed organizations.
* Proven self-starter with the ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and workstreams simultaneously.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.
* Willingness to travel approximately 25% to engage with health system executives, operational leaders, pharmacists, clinicians, and partnership stakeholders.

 
**Why Join Shields?**

* Partner directly with Executive Leadership on the company's most important strategic priorities.
* Lead high-impact initiatives that drive growth, operational excellence, and transformative outcomes across a national network of health system partnerships.
* Gain broad exposure to corporate strategy, healthcare operations, business development, and executive decision-making.
* Join a proven leadership pipeline that has developed future leaders across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.
* Help shape the future of healthcare through innovative specialty pharmacy solutions that improve patient outcomes and strengthen health system partnerships.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.

records.title: Regional Director of Operations
records.description:
**Job Title:** Regional Director of Operations 
**Reports To:** Director of Operations 
**FLSA Status:** Exempt 
**Job Type:** Full-Time with regular travel to assigned practice locations

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Regional Director of Operations (RDO) provides high-level operational leadership and strategic oversight for a portfolio of at least 15 dental practices, representing significant aggregate EBITDA volume and diverse market conditions. The RDO directly manages Regional Managers and Office Managers, driving operational consistency, financial performance, and alignment with company objectives. This role is both strategic and hands-on, requiring advanced financial acumen, strong people leadership, and the ability to implement enterprise initiatives effectively across a large, complex region. The RDO acts as a primary field partner to the Director of Operations, contributing to strategic planning, operational innovation, and cross-functional collaboration to achieve growth and profitability targets. Must be located in South Florida, Texas or Missouri,

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operational Leadership**

* Oversee day-to-day operations across a portfolio of at least 15 practices, ensuring adherence to IDS standards, policies, and performance expectations.
* Lead, coach, and develop Regional Managers and Office Managers to build strong, capable leadership teams within each location.
* Ensure consistent execution of operational workflows, patient experience standards, and compliance requirements.

### **Financial Performance**

* Monitor and drive key financial metrics, including revenue growth, EBITDA performance, expense management, and AR improvement.
* Partner with Finance to develop accurate forecasting and budgeting for assigned markets.
* Identify and act on opportunities to optimize profitability and operational efficiency across the portfolio.

### **People Leadership & Development**

* Provide regular performance coaching and career development for Regional Managers and Office Managers.
* Foster a positive and accountable culture, emphasizing continuous improvement and leadership excellence.
* Support succession planning and leadership readiness for key operational roles.

### **Strategic & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with corporate departments (HR, Finance, RCM, Procurement, Clinical, Marketing, M&A) to implement enterprise initiatives at the regional level.
* Serve as a key point of escalation for complex operational, compliance, or personnel issues within the portfolio.
* Contribute to enterprise-level operational planning and strategic decision-making in partnership with the Director of Operations.

**Integration & Growth**

* Lead the integration of newly acquired practices within the assigned region, ensuring cultural alignment and operational readiness.
* Support market expansion efforts through operational due diligence, onboarding, and performance ramp-up.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of multi-site operational leadership experience, preferably in a dental service organization (DSO) or multi-unit healthcare environment.
* Proven track record of managing at least 15 locations or equivalent in aggregate business volume.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management.
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and team development skills.
* Strong problem-solving ability with a track record of improving operational performance.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
* Willingness to travel regularly within assigned markets, up to 75%.

**Competencies**
----------------

* **Strategic Leadership** – Ability to translate enterprise goals into regional execution plans.
* **Financial Expertise** – Skilled at interpreting financial reports and driving results through informed decision-making.
* **Operational Excellence** – Commitment to process optimization and continuous improvement.
* **People Development** – Proven ability to grow and develop leaders at multiple management levels.
* **Collaboration & Influence** – Ability to work effectively across corporate departments and field leadership teams.
* **Change Management** – Adept at leading teams through transitions, integrations, and organizational change.

### **Work Environment & Travel**

* Full-time remote with travel up to 75%.
* Must be located in South Florida, Texas or Missouri, and able to work across time zones and communicate with remote teams.
* Able to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer.

records.title: Senior Director - Operations
records.description:
As a Senior Director - Operations you will be responsible for the performance of all operational functions of a large, complex location, or multiple remote locations. You will provide strategic leadership to meet and optimize established levels of business performance objectives, service, productivity, and quality. You will partner with leaders across supply chain, operations, and the business units to drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Set strategic goals for operational efficiency and increased productivity.
* Lead team to ensure objectives are met, including driving customer service excellence plans, setting and managing performance targets, and employee performance management.
* Partner with Lean Leadership, ensuring LEAN methodologies are utilized and action plans are developed to correct problem areas and optimize established levels of business performance objectives, service, productivity, and quality
* Ensures consistent compliance with standard operating procedures, policies, internal audit controls, Sarbanes-Oxley controls, and business management quality system requirements
* Analyze current operational processes and performance, recommending solutions for improvement when necessary.
* Identifies market potential through competitor analysis and strategic planning.
* Develops annual business plans, identifies key activities, and priorities.
* Implements and communicates operational strategies and solutions consistent with business plans.
* Provides guidance to operations management in hiring and developing talent.
* Ensures operational excellence goals and audit requirements are met.
* Partners with inventory leaders to ensure region inventory needs and goals are met.
* Provides guidance to ensure business continuity and recovery plans are met.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree preferred
* LEAN yellow belt certification
* 10+ years of operations leadership experience
* Experience running large, complex location or multiple remote locations
* Business and management principles, including strategic planning and resource allocation.
* Strategic thinking skills and ability to work with senior management and regional teams.

records.title: Director of Operations / Multi-Unit General Manager

postedPay.title: Director of Operations / Multi-Unit General Manager

records.description:
Multi-Unit General Manager

**District Kitchen & Bar + PUBLIC eat+drink** 
Berkshire County, Massachusetts

Compensation

**$130,000–$160,000 total compensation** (base salary + performance bonus)

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

records.description:
**Ask yourself:**

* On a scale of 1 to 10, is your work ethic a 10+?
* Do you have true GRIT, tenacity, and live in the realm where anything is possible?
* Do you solve problems creatively and yet with regard to high quality and details?
* Do you relate to people well and think on your feet?
* Do you agree with the following statement: "If it is to be, it's up to me" - if you don't agree with this quote, we are not a match.

**The above is who we are looking for! We need a LEADER who GETS THINGS DONE WITH EXCELLENCE and has a strong desire to help make a successful small business better.**

The Director of Operations (DOO) is a key Protector for the growing expansion of the business. This manager is the master of systems, consistently seeking new, innovative, and efficient business processes that save time and money. As a key leader in this company, the Director of Operations (DOO) increases the ability of the Hub to process transactions, freeing the Sales Team to focus more on generating transactions than closing them.

This person relishes the opportunity to build, implement, and manage multiple systems, and is seen throughout the organization as the expert on efficiency and systems. This person exhibits a drive to use systems as a strategic tool for creating an advantage for the organization. This individual will have some ability to show patience in finding a solution, though accomplishing the objective is more important for this person than using one specific process. This person excels at bringing a vision or an idea to life as an integrator and implementer.

The Director of Operations (DOO) is deeply committed to supporting the growth of the agents and in achieving greater and greater levels of success, and to growing his/her own skills and developing into a supportive leader/manager within the organization. As the success of the business grows, this individual will be responsible for hiring, training, and leading additional department members to ensure all administrative tasks of the lead agent’s business continue to be completed to high standards with maximum efficiency. They will also be responsible for leading the sales department from a systems/accountability position.

**Compensation:**

* Base salary $65,000 - $75,000
* Earning potential up to $90,000 - $100,000
* Bonus potential
* Growth opportunity

 **Compensation:**

$65,000 - $75,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:**

* Lead the development and implementation of efficient business systems to enhance operational productivity.
* Collaborate with the sales team to streamline processes, allowing them to focus on generating transactions.
* Oversee the hiring, training, and leadership of new team members to maintain high standards of administrative excellence.
* Act as the primary point of contact for system-related inquiries, ensuring swift and effective resolutions.
* Continuously evaluate and refine operational strategies to align with the company's growth objectives.
* Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging team members to propose and implement process improvements.
* Monitor key performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of operational strategies and make data-driven decisions.

 
**Qualifications:**

* Experience in managing and optimizing business operations, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness in all processes.
* Proven track record of developing and implementing systems that enhance productivity and streamline workflows.
* Ability to lead and mentor teams, fostering a collaborative and accountable work environment.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial reporting, and ROI tracking.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of maintaining clear and effective internal and client communications.
* Experience in overseeing marketing processes and procedures, ensuring alignment with company goals.
* Ability to create and maintain comprehensive operations manuals, documenting systems and standards in writing and video formats.

 
**About Company**

**We have built our business on sitting down with people who have an interest in owning a home, listening to their goals, and creating a specific plan to make that plan come to life.**

We love helping buyers find their dream home! That's why we work with each client individually, taking the time to understand their unique lifestyles, needs, and wishes. You'll find that we'll be a committed ally to negotiate on your behalf and with the backing of a trusted company.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**What You Will Do**:

We are in search of a **17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief** who will be managing, reviewing, and approving Engineering Change Industrialization. The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be key team member within our 17/24K EC Industrial Team of the 17/24K Production Chief Office.

 

Reporting to the Deputy Production Chief, 17/24K EC Industrialization Associate Director, the role will be focusing on program management, industrialization of engineering changes, business process development, and detailed analysis to support program needs.

The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be instrumental in the achievement of Program milestones through alignment of Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain organizational plans and initiatives to Program and Customer priorities and commitments.

 

* Deliver executive presentations and program reporting on deliveries, risks, and industrial initiatives.
* Support communications, cross-functional alignment, industrial risk identification, and risk mitigation efforts for 17/24K programs.
* Participate in GTF PIPTs on behalf of the 17/24K programs.
* Collaborate with Mod Center, GSC, and cross-functional leaders on planning and execution of critical industrial actions to rate readiness for our programs.
* Leading continuous improvement activities to improve key processes; coordinate, organize, and lead critical industrial initiatives for engineering changes to minimize disruption to OEM and MRO operations
* Support MIPT and IPMT meetings for key engineering changes; present and align industrial content for critical customers
* Track and realign block changes for 24k program
* Champion MRL progression and productivity tasks
* Serve as the primary liaison for the Production Chiefs, ensuring effective communication and smooth execution across the PCIR process
* Partner closely with CAT 1 supplier to maintain alignment and drive successful incorporation planning
* Role involves travel up to 10%

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment OR a Master's degree and minimum 5 years experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Experience working in a fluctuating environment with constantly shifting priorities
* Demonstrated ability to critically assess industrial production schedules, qualification requirements and develop risk mitigations to drive successful program execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience using SAP
* Knowledge of the PCIR process
Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles (e.g. lean manufacturing, CORE, QCPC) 

 

**Learn More & Apply Now:**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

**Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Director of Quality – Aerospace Manufacturing**
**Oklahoma City, OK**
**Extremely Competitive Pay**
-
*Dependent on Experience*
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product integrity, maintaining customer and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement throughout the company. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, and executive leadership, the Director of Quality will lead quality initiatives, develop high-performing teams, strengthen organizational processes, and promote a culture of accountability and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with proven leadership skills and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Implement and maintain the company quality system in coordination with the Management Representative.
* Report on the performance of the quality system for review and as a basis for improvement of the quality system.
* Have knowledge and understanding of the standards and customer requirements against which the quality system is developed, maintained, and implemented.
* Provide leadership to subordinates, establishing goals and development plans to meet the strategic direction of the organization.
* Determine and enforce -- through functional groups - quality requirements in accordance with real company needs, based on current regulations and state-of-the art product development.
* Develop audit plans, select, and evaluate auditors, document non-conformance(s) and report non-conformances to management.
* Manage subordinate personnel and ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Establishes and maintains an effective system of communications throughout the organization.
* Represents the organization with major customers, shareholders, the financial community, and the public.
* Monitor and evaluate subordinate personnel updating the Management Representative and Human Resources to have the Employee Skills Matrix reflect accurately the training and skills of subordinates.
* Administer the company quality program in accordance with customer and company requirements.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are issued, responded, and completed.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives for scrap reduction, reducing variation and waste, increasing profit and to improve product quality.
* Organize and promote companywide quality improvement efforts.
* Liaison with external parties on matters relating to the quality management system.
* Maintain the system for calibration of inspection, tools, and equipment for conformance to product specifications.
* Research and analyze data such as customer design proposals, specifications, quality requirements, and manuals to determine feasibility or processes or application and company’s ability to inspect product at the required stages of manufacture.
* Plan and direct quality activities and establishes QA priorities for keeping effective production operations and cost factors.
* Assist engineering in organizing and planning Quality Planning Meetings.
* Read and understand technical and non-technical documents that relate to contracts, purchasing, product design, manufacturing, and test. This includes the ability to interface with both technical and non-technical personnel.
* Evaluate, study, standardize and improve procedures for the assurance of quality, reliability, safety, and efficiency.
* Assess techniques for examining, questioning, evaluating, and reporting.
* Analyze inspection data to determine product conformance and process capability.
* Prepare composite reports from individual reports of subordinates.
* Maintain training records, coordinate with upper management to determine training requirements.
* Issue written and oral instructions.
* Assign duties and examine work for exactness, neatness, and conformance product specifications, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and plan meetings with departments to develop documentation to support compliance to the applicable standards.
* Ensure nonconforming product is controlled in accordance with the company's quality requirements.
* Monitor metrics associated with the Cost of Quality.
* Initiate NMR’s and DMR's for product found to be nonconforming.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Ensure employees observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment (PPE).
* Assist employees in using the proper tools and equipment to monitor conformance to specifications and ensure equipment is calibrated and maintained.
* Ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Support the Quality Management System to assure compliance to quality, industrial and government standards and regulations and customer requirements.
* Adhere to all Quality Management System procedures and instructions.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and orderly work environment.
* Observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment.

**Additional Benefits We Offer**

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company Sponsored Life-Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

**Qualifications**
**Job Qualifications**
**Physical Requirements**
While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands/fingers to handle/feel; reach with hands and arms; climb; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch; crawl; reach; pull; balance; carry; handle. The employee may occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus.
  
  
**Education And/or Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4-10 years of related experience in manufacturing.
* Previous experience working with Lockheed Martin is required

This position is subject to

(U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee)

records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
As the
**Director of Quality**
, you will lead the quality strategy and continuous improvement efforts across all Bison manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products meet or exceed customer expectations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements while driving overall quality performance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain effective quality systems, drive process improvements, and ensure compliance with industry certifications.
  
  
This position can be based at either our
**Whitsett, NC**
or
**Reynosa, MX**
facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).
+ Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management systems and propose enhancements to improve overall performance.

* Process & Product Quality

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.
+ Support root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for internal and external quality issues.
+ Oversee first article inspections, process capability studies, and validation/qualification activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, enhancing efficiency, and improving overall quality.
+ Implement data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., SPC, FMEA, Control Plans) to monitor and improve process capabilities.
+ Facilitate cross-functional value stream mapping sessions and quality workshops to drive process improvements.

* Customer & Supplier Relations

+ Serve as the main point of contact for customer quality issues, audits, and feedback, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
+ Oversee supplier quality management, including audits, performance monitoring, and supplier development initiatives.

* Metrics & Reporting

+ Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality performance, including scrap/rework, defect rates, customer complaints, and audit findings.
+ Regularly report quality performance metrics to senior leadership, highlighting trends and recommending corrective actions.

* Regulatory Compliance & Audits

+ Lead internal and external audits, ensuring the sites comply with relevant standards and certifications.
+ Ensure the manufacturing facilities are audit-ready at all times and coordinate responses to audit findings.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience with quality management systems (ISO 9001, AS9100, FDA, or equivalent) and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
* Proven track record of driving quality improvements across multi-site operations.
* Ability to travel as needed to the BU manufacturing sites (up to 30%)
* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, 8D, and Root Cause Analysis.

**Compensation**
Employee Type: Salaried
  
  
Currency: USD
  
  
Salary Minimum: 135,000
  
  
Salary Maximum: 185,000
  
  
Incentive: Yes
  
  
Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.
  
  
For more information on AMETEK's competitive benefits, please click here.
  
  
AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7.5 billion.
  
  
AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility. records.description:
**Summary**
Provides strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, ensuring that quality systems, processes, and practices support business objectives, customer requirements, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. Establishes quality strategy, policies, objectives, and performance expectations and provides leadership across functions to drive continuous improvement, strengthen quality performance, mitigate risk, and support business growth.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with business and operational goals.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System and associated quality policies, procedures, and controls.
* Serve as the site's senior quality leader and management representative for applicable ISO 9001, AS9100, and ISO 13485 quality management systems.
* Ensure continued compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, industry, and certification requirements, including applicable FDA, ITAR, ISO, and IPC requirements and standards.
* Provide leadership for quality planning related to processes, products, customers, and business requirements, with consideration for broader corporate quality objectives.
* Establish and monitor quality metrics and performance indicators. Identify trends, risks, and systemic issues and lead actions to improve quality performance.
* Provide quality performance, risk, and improvement recommendations to site and organizational leadership.
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process and provide oversight for the disposition and control of nonconforming material and product.
* Provide leadership and oversight for corrective and preventive actions, root cause analysis, and systemic problem resolution in partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Lead quality improvement initiatives focused on reducing defects, improving process capability, increasing throughput, and strengthening overall operational performance.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Provide oversight of internal and external audit activities, certification requirements, customer audits, and resulting corrective actions.
* Partner with Supply Chain and suppliers to evaluate supplier quality performance, address quality risks, and ensure supplier quality systems meet business and customer requirements.
* Oversee the calibration system and applicable preventive maintenance controls to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate training and organizational capability related to workmanship standards, acceptance criteria, quality systems, and regulatory/customer requirements.
* Support environmental management requirements, including applicable ISO 14001 responsibilities and site environmental management activities.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to identify and mitigate quality and operational risks and improve customer outcomes.
* Provide quality leadership and expertise in support of new products, customers, programs, processes, and business opportunities.
* Promote awareness and understanding of regulatory, customer, and quality requirements throughout the organization.
* Lead, develop, and mentor Quality leaders and team members, building organizational capability and ensuring appropriate talent development and succession planning.
* Support corporate and site Lean/6S objectives and integrate quality principles into continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support and follow all applicable Quality Management System requirements related to quality, environmental, health, safety, and security.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Job Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Advanced knowledge of quality management systems and quality principles within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and other applicable regulatory and customer quality requirements.
* Working knowledge of FDA, ITAR, IPC, and applicable electronics manufacturing standards and requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into quality strategies, priorities, metrics, and improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of corrective action, root cause analysis, risk management, process improvement, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to analyze quality and operational data, identify trends and systemic risks, and develop effective corrective and preventive strategies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, customer, operational, financial, and business considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive results across functions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Strong leadership and organizational capability, including experience building, developing, and leading professional and technical teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, regulatory bodies, auditors, suppliers, and senior leadership.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and applicable electronic manufacturing and quality systems.

**Qualifications**
**Experience/Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible quality, engineering, or manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality organization within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent technical, quality, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving organization-wide quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience interacting with customers, auditors, regulatory organizations, and senior business leadership.
* Demonstrated balance of strategic thinking, strong analytical capability, and effective execution.
* Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills.

**Due to ITAR and / or CUI compliance, this position requires candidates to be a U.S. Citizen.**
Benefits Offered: Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage; company-paid basic life/AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance; voluntary supplemental insurances, flexible spending accounts and employee assistance program (EAP). Sick Leave, Vacation Time, and company-paid Holidays are also provided as paid time off. NEOTech also provides a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan option with a company match.
  
  
NEOTech is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
  
  
NEOTech has a long-standing commitment to maintaining a safe, quality-oriented and productive work environment. We also want all employees to perform their duties safely and efficiently, in a manner that protects their interests and those of their co-workers. We recognize that alcohol and drug abuse pose a threat to the health and safety of NEOTech employees and to the security of the Company’s equipment and facilities. For these reasons, NEOTech is committed to the elimination of drug and alcohol use and abuse in the workplace. Candidates being considered for hire must pass a pre-employment background check and drug test which include screening for illegal drugs and marijuana.

records.description:
**Job Description**
**Director, Production Operations in Springfield, MO**
Build your future at Curia, where our work has the power to save lives
  
  
Curia is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with over 30 years of experience partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to provide life-saving treatments to patients. At Curia, we are on a mission to advance our customers’ therapies from curiosity to cure and ultimately to improve patients’ lives.
  
  
We proudly offer
  
  

* Generous benefit options (eligible first day of employment)
* Paid training, vacation and holidays (vacation accrual begins on first day of employment)
* Career advancement opportunities
* Education reimbursement
* 401K program with matching contributions
* Learning platform
* And more!

At Curia, manufacturing excellence is at the heart of everything we do. The Director, Production Operations is a key member of the Springfield leadership team, responsible for managing, planning, directing, and coordinating manufacturing processes across our large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations. This leader ensures our operations are safe, compliant, cost-effective, and positioned for growth.
  
  
This is a role for a proven leader who brings both strategic vision and operational discipline. The Director contributes to the development of business and functional strategies, communicates them clearly across the site, and translates them into action. Working cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, and other departments, this leader drives high performance in cGMP compliance, schedule adherence, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As much as this role is about operational outcomes, it is also about people. The Director identifies and develops the next generation of leaders within the organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration that reflects the Curia Way.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and implement short and long range goals and objectives that align with business growth and profitability targets.
* Set strategic leadership goals for key section heads within the large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations.
* Review operational plans to assess manufacturing capacity requirements and make recommendations to improve capacity utilization and support business development planning.
* Develop, implement, and maintain Key Performance Indicators and monitoring systems to drive high levels of performance within the department and across the organization.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Oversee manufacturing operations to ensure safety, quality, productivity, and efficiency, working collaboratively with the management team to prevent and resolve operational, quality, financial, and facility issues.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory departments to drive high performance in cGMP compliance and ensure operations meet organizational requirements for quality management, health and safety, legal, and environmental standards.
* Ensure proper planning and effective execution of production activities to minimize downtime and maximize output per the production schedule, working closely with supporting departments to maintain schedule adherence.
* Proactively lead local efforts to prepare for and execute productive customer visits.
* Analyze activities, costs, operations, and forecast data to assess progress toward goals and initiate corrective action as needed to meet business and financial objectives.
* Perform other related duties as may be reasonably assigned in the course of business.

**Good Manufacturing & Documentation Practices**
Quality is something we take pride in together. You’ll perform your work in alignment with cGMP requirements and Curia’s standards to ensure our facilities support the safe and reliable manufacture of products for our customers.
  
  

* Perform all documentation in compliance with ALCOA++ principles and site SOPs.
* Adhere to applicable cGMP documents including SOPs, batch records, protocols, change controls, and controlled forms.
* Keep all required cGMP training current and escalate quality concerns along with proposed solutions to the Quality department.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 5–10 years of mid to senior management experience in a manufacturing or process environment
* Demonstrated understanding of the responsibilities and functions of key departments within a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing facility
* Strong knowledge of cGMP compliance, technical operations, and quality systems within a manufacturing environment
* Proven ability to identify, develop, and inspire leaders at multiple levels of the organization
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present strategy and performance clearly to site and functional leadership

**Preferred**

* Experience with API development and manufacturing processes
* Certification in Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma

**Physical Requirements**
The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.
  
  

* Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear.
* Frequently required to use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* May occasionally lift and/or move up to 55 pounds.
* Visual requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
The work environment characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this role.
  
  

* Regular work in a standard office environment, with frequent entry into the production area of a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility.
* Production environment may include moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, extreme heat, wet or humid conditions, low levels of toxic or caustic chemicals, and outdoor weather conditions.
* Noise level in the work environment is typically moderate.

records.title: Director, Starlink Production (Assembly)
records.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
**DIRECTOR, STARLINK PRODUCTION (ASSEMBLY)**
We are seeking a highly motivated and achievement-oriented leader to own Starlink Product Assembly Production in Bastrop, TX—scaling high-volume manufacturing to fuel global connectivity for millions. This includes oversight and responsibility for Assembly, Test, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation, and Maintenance across high-rate automated mechanical/pick & place, SMT/PCBA, and large electromechanical build production lines. This position plays a critical role in achieving rapid user expansion required for the success of the organization. Ideal candidates have a successful track record of scaling complex operations, leading 200+ person teams, and building cross-functional partnerships.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Oversee the strategic & tactical execution of Starlink Product Production
* Lead 250+ staff (multiple direct reports) across engineering and operations.
* Lead and mentor high-performing teams of manufacturing, process, and automation engineers to operationalize and continuously improve production.
* Implement a development program to enhance the capability of all team members while improving quality and reducing lead time & cost.
* Partner with Responsible Engineering teams to embed manufacturability into the design of new products and production lines.
* Ensure a strong focus is placed on safety and maintain an excellent safety record.
* Champion continuous improvement projects using appropriate metrics & data.
* Use quality metrics to continually improve the quality output of the operation.
* Manage resource levels to ensure optimum performance of the team.
* Monitor and communicate area status/readiness and risks to leadership.
* Monitor and maintain compliance with internal quality and customer contractual requirements.
* Foster a spirit of cooperation and collaboration within and between departments.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations, AD&S
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a Director of Manufacturing Operations to oversee all production within our Air Dominance & Strike division, from rapidly maturing prototypes through full-rate production at scale.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for managing a team of highly talented managers, line supervisors, and technicians who manufacture both our current key autonomous products, Fury, Barracuda, and Roadrunner, and our emerging capabilities. This is a highly dynamic role that requires both technical and frontline people management skills. This role is at the forefront of delivering exceptional customer experiences, fostering team development, and overseeing operations at Arsenal-01 and HQ.
  
  
As a Director in the Air Dominance & Strike Production organization, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that both manufacturing sites and operations align with the division's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, in addition to balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's manufacturing operational success.
  
  
Success in this role demands consistent achievement across hardware production, team management, manufacturing operations, and financial goals. The ideal candidate combines technical acumen with effective communication, strong time-management skills, and a passion for leading transformative change. The ideal candidate should be energetic, highly organized, and deeply committed to scaling innovative products. While individual contributions are valued, teamwork is crucial for achieving the highest level of success while maintaining our Anduril culture above all.
  
  
*Please note: This role will be based at Arsenal-01 in Columbus, OH. A successful candidate will be expected to work out of Columbus, OH. Based on eligibility, relocation assistance may be available. There will likely be 25% - 50% travel required for the role.*
**What You'll Do**

* First and foremost, deliver outcomes for the Air Dominance & Strike Production organization
* Create a clear vision for Manufacturing Operations

+ You are a key leader in supporting and strengthening the vision of AD&S Production
+ Manage the portfolio of projects necessary to achieve your vision for Manufacturing Operations

* Collaborate successfully with leaders across our production organization

+ Leaders include Manufacturing Engineering, Design Engineering, Planning, Quality, and Supply Chain

* Deliver quality products, on-time and at cost

+ Own attainment for both current and emerging programs

* Own the culture on the floor

+ Be a stakeholder in all programs, policies, etc. that affect life on the floor
+ Maximize for what’s right both for Anduril’s future and maintaining a strong team culture
+ Coach, mentor and support Manufacturing Operations Managers and Production Supervisors
+ Create and maintain a high bar for excellence

* Clearly communicate up and out

+ Provide consistent and high-quality briefs both up, to Anduril Senior Leadership, and out, to AD&S Customers

* In summary, show up every day with a high level of urgency, ownership, and enthusiasm to get the job done

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years experience managing manufacturing and production operations
* 3+ years in a supervisor or production operations management role at the Director level or above
* 3+ years of experience as a manager of managers
* Experience managing operator / technician workforce of 100+ within direct organization
* Experience working directly and communicating with designers and engineers
* A full understanding of the product life cycle (NPI to scaled production), LEAN manufacturing principles, and change management
* Extremely reliable, organized, and detail-oriented with excellent verbal & written communication skills
* You have a passion for employee development and enjoy the process of training and developing both new hires and veteran production staff
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, business, or applied science)
* Working knowledge of AS9100 standards and OSHA laws

US Salary Range
  
  
$190,000—$252,000 USD
  
  
**Benefits**
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:
  
  
At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.
*For more information, Explore Our Benefits.*
**Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**
Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
  
  
To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind
  
  

* No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* Please always verify communications:

+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

* Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

**Data Privacy**
To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.
  
  
By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

**Job Summary**
The Manufacturing Plant Operations Director oversees all production activities and provides hands-on leadership on the shop floor. This role ensures products are manufactured safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with company, customer, and regulatory requirements. Applicants must have proven, direct experience leading a production line or manufacturing operation.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Tasks**

* Lead daily production operations with direct oversight of line performance, personnel, quality, and throughput.
