records.description:
**About the Opportunity**

A well-established manufacturing organization in the aviation and aerospace industry is seeking an experienced
**Director of Production**
to oversee and improve its manufacturing operations.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone with direct aerospace or aviation manufacturing experience who can manage production activities, lead teams, improve operational efficiency, and ensure consistent product quality and on-time delivery.

The ideal candidate is a practical, floor-oriented leader who understands production planning, manufacturing processes, equipment maintenance, and resource management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily manufacturing and production activities to ensure operational efficiency, product quality, and timely delivery.
* Manage production schedules, workflow, resource allocation, and manufacturing capacity.
* Lead and coordinate production planning and maintenance teams to maintain equipment reliability and operational continuity.
* Monitor production costs, operating expenses, and departmental budgets while identifying cost-saving opportunities.
* Establish and track KPIs related to productivity, production volume, quality, scrap rates, lead times, and on-time delivery.
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and increase production capacity.
* Ensure compliance with aviation manufacturing standards, safety regulations, environmental requirements, and customer specifications.
* Work closely with department managers and supervisors to establish performance goals and maintain accountability.
* Coach, develop, and mentor production leaders and supervisors.
* Support facility improvements, equipment upgrades, capital projects, and the implementation of new manufacturing technologies.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, safety, and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent experience will also be considered.
* Approximately 8–10 years of progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Direct experience in
  **aviation or aerospace manufacturing operations is required**
  .
* Previous experience managing production teams, manufacturing schedules, and operational resources.
* Strong understanding of production planning, manufacturing processes, maintenance coordination, and quality control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to improve productivity, control costs, and meet production targets.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* **Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) is required.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with ERP systems; Quantum experience is a plus.
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher.
* Lean Manufacturing or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience managing manufacturing budgets and operational performance metrics.

**Ideal Candidate**

The successful candidate will be a hands-on production leader who is comfortable working directly with manufacturing teams and supervisors. This position is best suited for someone with a strong background in aerospace manufacturing who can balance people leadership with daily production execution and continuous improvement.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
**Company Overview:**

  
  

Adams Communication & Engineering Technology (ACET), Incorporated is a Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) system engineering and information technology firm. Incorporated in 1999, we support mission critical Information Technology (IT) business needs for clients within the intelligence community (IC), Department of Defense (DOD), Veteran Administration (VA) and for select commercial clients. ACET, Inc.’s technical, programmatic, and analytical professionals are experts in commercial technology, customized solutions, and proprietary government systems.

  
  

**The Position:**

  
  

ACET is seeking an experienced, results-driven
**Director of Manufacturing**
to lead all production, fabrication, assembly, and shop-floor operations at our
**Havelock, NC**
facility. Reporting directly to executive leadership, the Director of Manufacturing will oversee day-to-day plant performance, drive operational excellence, ensure strict adherence to DoD quality and safety standards, and partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to deliver defense projects on time and within budget.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  
  

  
* Direct all daily manufacturing, machining, fabrication, and assembly operations in Havelock to meet customer delivery schedules, cost targets, and quality specifications.
  
* Partner with Program Managers and Engineering teams to transition designs from rapid prototyping and Engineering Manufacturing Development (EMD) into Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) and full-rate sustainment.
  
* Enforce compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, and Department of Defense manufacturing standards, ensuring zero-defect delivery and full audit readiness.
  
* Lead, mentor, and schedule production supervisors, machinists, technicians, and quality personnel; foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high retention.
  
* Implement Lean, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies to optimize shop-floor workflow, reduce cycle times, minimize scrap, and control overhead rates.
  
* Collaborate with Procurement and Contracts to manage long-lead materials, vendor bottlenecks, equipment maintenance, and capital expenditure planning.
  
* Maintain a safe, OSHA-compliant manufacturing environment while upholding all DoD physical security and classified material handling protocols.
  

  
  

**Qualifications:**

  
  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related technical field (or equivalent military/industry leadership experience).
  
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 3–5 years in a Plant Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Director-level role within the aerospace, defense, or government contracting sector.
  
* Proven expertise in precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, electro-mechanical assembly, ERP/MRP systems, and reading complex engineering drawings/blueprints.
  
* Hands-on experience operating under ISO 9001 and/or AS9100 quality management systems.
  
* U.S. Citizenship required; must hold an active DoD Secret security clearance (or have the ability to obtain and maintain one).
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
  

  
* Prior experience supporting NAVAIR, Fleet Readiness Center East (FRC East), or USMC/DoD aviation sustainment programs.
  
* Certification in Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt).
  
* Experience managing manufacturing operations within a small-to-midsize defense contractor environment, including familiarity with FAR/DFARS compliance and government-furnished property (GFP).
  

  
  

**Why Join ACET:**

  
  

ACET continues to expand its aerospace and aviation sustainment operations supporting multiple Department of Defense aviation platforms worldwide. This position provides the opportunity to directly shape strategic sustainment growth initiatives while supporting operational readiness and mission success across the global aviation enterprise.

  
  

**What We Offer:**

  
  

At ACET, we believe that our employees are our most valuable asset. We are committed to providing a comprehensive Total Rewards program that recognizes and supports the diverse needs of our workforce. Our offerings are designed to attract, motivate, and retain top talent while fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and well-being.

  
  

Employee benefits include the following:

  
  

  
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  
* Life insurance, AD&D, and Short- and Long-Term Disability
  
* 401(k) Program
  
* Wellness programs
  
* Paid Time Off
  
* 11 Paid Holidays
  
* Employee Referral Program
  
* Employee Assistance Program
  

  
  

Please note that all compensation, benefits, and policies are subject to change at the company's discretion. While we make every effort to provide advance notice of changes, adjustments may occur based on business needs, economic conditions, and industry standards.

  
  

**\*\*Must be US Citizen to apply\*\***

  
  

 The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position.

  

**Drug Free Workplace:**

  

ACET is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria are met as outlined in our policies.

  
  

**ACET is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor**
.

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Company Information**
*At Richelieu Foods, we are dedicated to a culture of belonging for everyone. Driven by our values of ownership, respect, and growth, we put people, safety, and quality above all else -- delicious pizza, outstanding service, and solid customer relationships are what happens as a result.*
*Richelieu Foods, Inc. is a leading national private label and contract packing food manufacturer focused on frozen pizza. We have two manufacturing facilities located in IL and WI. We provide products to many national retailers, wholesalers, distributors, club and mass stores, as well as industrial accounts including other food manufacturers.*
**Job Summary**
At Richelieu Foods we are making Great Food from Great People. We are looking for an experienced Director of Plant Operations who is comfortable driving transformation while reinforcing a culture of support and development. The Director of Plant Operations will report directly to the Senior Director of Operations with significant exposure to the Richelieu Senior Leadership Team. The Director of Plant Operations will lead the manufacturing operations for the facility, producing quality products in a people and food-safe manner, at or below budgeted cost. The position will be responsible for ensuring plant operations follow all regulatory, quality and safety standards. This role will be responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives, striving to deliver zero loss and 100% employee engagement in support of Richelieu’s integrated manufacturing strategy.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Create a high-performance operations team by recruiting and developing teams with an appropriate mix of experience, capabilities, and skills to consistently meet company goals and departmental initiatives in the most cost-effective manner. Ensure effective succession planning for all pivotal positions.
* Create and efficiently manage four key divisions of operations: 1) Manufacturing 2) Maintenance 3) Materials and 4) Operational excellence. Understand the financial impacts of various sourcing, labor, materials and overhead strategies on the business and act accordingly to maximize returns.
* Support new projects for the business, engaging suppliers to help the team understand any costs and design implication. Ability to engage and collaborate cross-functionally to facilitate commercialization of new products and partnering closely with the leadership team to support the broader activities and initiatives.
* Manage KPI's to include (but not limited to): Safety, Quality, People, Service, and Cost

records.description:
Director of Manufacturing

  
POSITION SUMMARY
  

Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the
**Malden, Missouri**
operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

  

This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

  
HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?Manufacturing & Operational Leadership
  

  
* Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
  
* Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.
  
* Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.
  
* Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.
  
* Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.
  
* Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.
  

  
Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance
  

  
* Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.
  
* Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.
  
* Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.
  
* Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.
  
* Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.
  

  
Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital
  

  
* Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.
  
* Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.
  
* Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.
  
* Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.
  
* Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.
  
* Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.
  

  
Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership
  

  
* Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.
  
* Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.
  
* Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.
  
* Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.
  
* Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
  

  
People Leadership & Talent Development
  

  
* Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
  
* Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.
  
* Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.
  
* Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.
  
* Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.
  

  
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?
  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
  
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.
  
* Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.
  
* Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
  
* Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.
  
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  
* Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.
  

  
Preferred Qualifications
  

  
* Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.
  
* Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.
  
* Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.
  
* Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.
  

  
WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?
  

This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

  
WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?
  

  
* Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.
  
* Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.
  
* Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.
  
* Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.
  
* A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.
  
* Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.
  
* Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.
  

  
HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?
  

  
* Competitive compensation.
  
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
  
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
  
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
  
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.
  

  
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
  

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

  
  

The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.

records.description:
**Spartronics, LLC**

**Career Opportunity: Site Director of Operations**

**Location:**
North Logan, Utah

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | Salaried | Exempt

**Work Arrangement:**
On-Site

**Schedule:**
Full-Time, Monday–Friday

**Reports To:**
Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader

**Who We Are**

At
**Spartronics**
, we build more than electronics. We build the technology that powers critical applications across aerospace and defense, medical devices, life sciences, and industrial markets.

As a leading provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS), Spartronics specializes in complex, high-reliability products, including printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), electromechanical assemblies, integrated systems, and complete product manufacturing solutions.

**Career Opportunity: Director of Operations**

Spartronics is seeking an experienced
**Director of Operations**
to lead manufacturing operations and drive operational excellence at our North Logan, Utah facility.

This senior leadership position is responsible for the overall performance, execution, and continuous improvement of the site's operational functions, including Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning, while providing indirect operational oversight and cross-functional partnership with Program Management.

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader, the Director of Operations will establish operational priorities, develop high-performing teams, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure the organization consistently achieves its safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability objectives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong business acumen, experience managing multiple operational disciplines, and a proven ability to drive results in complex, highly regulated manufacturing environments.

**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for the facility, translating organizational objectives into actionable plans, performance expectations, and measurable results.
* Direct Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning functions, ensuring effective coordination, accountability, and alignment with site and corporate objectives.
* Provide indirect operational oversight and strategic partnership to Program Management, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, program execution, operational capacity and business objectives.
* Direct manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, and resource allocation, balancing changing customer demand, product complexity, and manufacturing constraints to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Establish operational priorities, evaluate performance against key metrics, and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps and emerging risks.
* Provide leadership and oversight of engineering activities, including process optimization, technical problem resolution, manufacturing readiness, new product introduction, and product transfers.
* Ensure the effectiveness of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, and corrective and preventive action processes while preserving Quality's independent authority over product acceptance and compliance decisions.
* Oversee supply chain and materials planning activities, including procurement, supplier performance, inventory management, material availability, and production support.
* Partner with Program Management and other customer-facing functions to address delivery commitments, operational concerns, customer escalations, and changing business requirements.
* Develop operational budgets, resource plans, capital expenditure priorities, and cost improvement initiatives in collaboration with Finance, supporting achievement of site financial objectives and profitability targets..
* Evaluate operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability, reduce waste, control costs, and optimize resource utilization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure manufacturing processes, product traceability, configuration and change control, and supporting documentation comply with applicable customer, industry, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure operational compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Establish and maintain structured operational performance management systems, including KPI reviews, cross-functional accountability, issue escalation, and corrective action follow-through to support timely, data-driven decision-making.
* Build, coach, and develop operational leadership teams, establishing clear performance expectations, succession plans, and workforce competency and development priorities.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing requirements, employee performance, organizational development, and retention strategies.
* Coordinate with Facilities, Security, and other support functions to address infrastructure needs, operational continuity, physical security requirements, and business risks.
* Evaluate manufacturing capacity, technology, equipment, and infrastructure needs to support business growth, operational scalability, and capital investment decisions.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with production disruptions, supplier constraints, quality concerns, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Represent site operations in corporate leadership discussions, customer interactions, audits, and strategic planning activities, communicating performance, priorities, and resource requirements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity overseeing multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations with accountability for production, engineering, quality, supply chain, and cross-functional business objectives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, materials management, and operational performance improvement.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing engineering principles, process controls, technical problem resolution, and new product introduction activities.
* Working knowledge of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, corrective action processes, and applicable manufacturing standards.
* Proven ability to develop and execute operational strategies, establish performance objectives, and achieve measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience utilizing financial metrics, cost management practices, capital planning processes, and profitability analysis to drive operational decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable cross-functional management teams while promoting collaboration and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience applying Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methodologies to complex operational challenges.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate competing priorities, manage operational risks, and resolve complex business issues.
* Advanced proficiency with business and manufacturing information systems, including ERP/MRP platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and data analysis and reporting tools. Demonstrated ability to interpret operational and financial data, evaluate performance trends, and leverage technology to support strategic planning and informed decision-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, senior leadership, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage sensitive business information, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality in accordance with company and applicable security requirements.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and comprehend English sufficiently to interpret technical documentation, communicate operational requirements, and perform essential job responsibilities.
* Ability to work full-time on-site at the assigned company facility in Logan, UT.

**Security Clearance Requirement**

Candidates must possess current, verifiable eligibility for a U.S. Government Secret-level security clearance or be willing and able to complete the necessary documentation to initiate the company-sponsored clearance process within 60 days of hire. The ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearance eligibility is a continuing condition of employment. Employment may continue while an appropriately initiated clearance application is pending, subject to company authorization and applicable security restrictions. A final determination of ineligibility, denial, or loss of required clearance eligibility will result in disqualification from the position and may result in termination of employment, subject to applicable law and company policy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Leadership experience within electronics manufacturing services (EMS), printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), or high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environments.
* Experience with surface mount technology (SMT), through-hole assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing test, and related electronics manufacturing processes.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable IPC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Knowledge of ITAR, controlled technical information, and security requirements applicable to defense-related manufacturing.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or other recognized continuous improvement credentials.
* APICS/ASCM certification, such as CPIM or CSCP, or equivalent supply chain management credentials.
* Experience leading operational transformations, facility expansions, production transfers, or significant manufacturing improvement initiatives.
* Experience utilizing business intelligence platforms, advanced reporting tools, and integrated manufacturing systems to monitor operational performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships, operational escalations, and cross-functional business challenges.

**Key Metrics and Focus Areas**

* Workplace safety performance and regulatory compliance.
* On-time delivery performance and production schedule attainment.
* Manufacturing efficiency, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Product quality, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Inventory accuracy, material availability, and inventory turns.
* Supplier delivery, quality, and overall performance.
* Operating cost performance, budget adherence, and profitability.
* Engineering responsiveness, manufacturing readiness, and successful new product introductions.
* Program execution support and fulfillment of customer commitments.
* Continuous improvement results, waste reduction, and operational efficiency.
* Quality management system effectiveness, audit performance, and corrective action closure.
* Workforce productivity, employee development, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Operational risk management, business continuity, and capacity readiness.

**Why This Role Matters**

As
**Director of Operations,**
you will play a critical role in shaping the performance, operational capabilities, and continued growth of our North Logan manufacturing facility. Your leadership will directly influence how effectively we deliver complex, high-reliability electronic products to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding industries. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams, strengthen operational performance, implement meaningful improvements, and contribute to the long-term success of a growing manufacturing organization.

**Benefits – Why Join Spartronics?**

At Spartronics, we recognize that our employees are essential to our success. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and professional development of our team members.

Benefits may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off and company-paid holidays.
* Company-paid life insurance and disability benefits.
* Employee assistance and wellness resources.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative products supporting mission-critical industries.

*Specific benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan documents and company policies.*

**Physical Requirements and Work Location**

* Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments, including regular movement throughout production, warehouse, and operational areas.
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, with occasional bending and reaching.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to operate computers and standard office equipment.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when entering designated manufacturing areas.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Work Authorization & ITAR Requirements**

Due to the nature of certain products, technologies, and customer requirements, this position may involve access to export-controlled technical data or defense-related information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and other applicable export control laws. Candidates must meet applicable U.S. export control authorization requirements and be eligible to access controlled technical information as required by the position. For this position, additional U.S. Government security clearance eligibility requirements apply, as described above.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Spartronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled 41 CFR 60-1.4. We comply with federal Affirmative Action guidelines in all employment opportunities for qualified employees and applicants.Employment at Spartronics is considered at-will, meaning that either the employee or Spartronics may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without prior notification.*

Director of Manufacturing
  

Baton Rouge, LA | Full-Time | On-Site

  

**About Us**

  

Safe Air Technology is a rapidly growing manufacturer of mission-critical and explosion-proof HVAC systems. We take pride in building high-quality, precision-engineered equipment and are looking for skilled individuals who take pride in their workmanship.

  
  

**Position Summary**

  

Safe Air Technology is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Manufacturing to lead and oversee all aspects of our manufacturing operations. This is a senior leadership position responsible for driving production performance, operational efficiency, quality, safety, and workforce accountability across our manufacturing facilities.

  

The ideal candidate is a strong, hands-on manufacturing leader with extensive experience managing complex production environments, developing high-performing teams, and implementing processes that support rapid growth and increased production capacity.

  

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Manufacturing, this individual will provide strategic and operational leadership to ensure manufacturing objectives are achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

Manufacturing Operations & Production Leadership

  

  
* Direct and oversee daily manufacturing operations across all production departments, ensuring alignment with company goals and production schedules.
  
* Lead production managers, supervisors, and department leaders to achieve manufacturing targets and operational objectives.
  
* Establish clear performance expectations, accountability measures, and production standards throughout the organization.
  
* Ensure effective coordination between manufacturing departments to maintain consistent workflow and eliminate production bottlenecks.
  
* Monitor production schedules, capacity, labor utilization, and output to ensure on-time delivery of customer orders.
  
* Partner with the VP of Manufacturing to develop and execute operational strategies supporting business growth and increased production demand.
  
* Oversee the successful implementation and management of multiple shifts as production requirements evolve.
  

  

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  

  
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, efficiency, quality, cost reduction, and operational performance.
  
* Identify manufacturing inefficiencies, process gaps, and workflow constraints, implementing sustainable corrective actions.
  
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including production output, labor efficiency, schedule attainment, rework, and on-time delivery.
  
* Implement standardized processes, procedures, and performance expectations across manufacturing departments.
  
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies to optimize production operations.
  
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes that support increased production volume without compromising quality or safety.
  

  

Leadership & Workforce Development

  

  
* Provide leadership, coaching, and development to production managers, supervisors, and manufacturing personnel.
  
* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  
* Partner with Human Resources to identify staffing needs, workforce development opportunities, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, and supervisory coverage to ensure appropriate resources are in place.
  
* Establish clear expectations for employee performance, attendance, productivity, and adherence to company policies.
  
* Develop strong frontline leadership capable of independently managing daily production activities.
  

  

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  

  
* Promote a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with company safety policies, OSHA regulations, and applicable manufacturing standards.
  
* Partner with Quality and Safety leadership to reduce defects, rework, incidents, and operational risks.
  
* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet engineering specifications, quality requirements, and customer expectations.
  
* Drive accountability for workmanship, quality standards, and adherence to established procedures.
  
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action initiatives to prevent recurring quality or production issues.
  

  

Financial & Resource Management

  

  
* Manage manufacturing performance with a strong focus on labor costs, overtime, productivity, and operational efficiency.
  
* Monitor resource utilization and recommend improvements to optimize manufacturing costs.
  
* Partner with Finance and executive leadership to support manufacturing budgets, labor planning, capital expenditures, and cost-control initiatives.
  
* Evaluate equipment, facility, staffing, and technology needs to support operational growth.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing profitability through better resource allocation, process improvements, and increased productivity.
  

  

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Execution

  

  
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Project Management, Human Resources, and Finance to ensure alignment of manufacturing priorities.
  
* Partner with Supply Chain to address material availability, inventory constraints, and production readiness.
  
* Work with Engineering to resolve technical challenges, improve manufacturability, and minimize production disruptions.
  
* Provide regular manufacturing performance updates, operational risks, and improvement recommendations to the VP of Manufacturing and executive leadership.
  
* Support facility expansions, production transitions, new product introductions, and other strategic manufacturing initiatives.
  
* Translate company objectives into actionable manufacturing plans with measurable results.
  

  
Required Qualifications
  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior management or director-level role.
  
* Demonstrated experience overseeing large-scale manufacturing operations with multiple departments, production teams, and supervisory personnel.
  
* Proven success improving production output, operational efficiency, labor productivity, and manufacturing performance.
  
* Strong understanding of production planning, capacity management, manufacturing cost controls, and operational KPIs.
  
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement initiatives, and standardized production processes.
  
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environment with changing priorities and demanding production schedules.
  
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing reporting tools.
  

  
Preferred Qualifications
  

  
* Experience in HVAC manufacturing, industrial equipment, electrical integration, engineered-to-order products, or complex industrial manufacturing.
  
* Experience managing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
  
* Background in manufacturing environments involving mechanical assembly, electrical systems, refrigeration, fabrication, and equipment testing.
  
* Demonstrated success scaling manufacturing operations during periods of significant business growth.
  
* Experience supporting facility expansions, operational restructuring, and manufacturing process improvements.
  
* Lean Six Sigma certification or related continuous improvement training.
  

  
Key Performance Expectations
  

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  

  
* Production Performance: Consistently achieve established manufacturing output and delivery targets.
  
* Operational Efficiency: Improve labor productivity, throughput, and manufacturing capacity.
  
* Quality: Reduce rework, defects, and production-related quality issues.
  
* Safety: Maintain a safe working environment and strengthen safety accountability.
  
* Leadership: Develop effective production managers and supervisors who consistently deliver results.
  
* Cost Management: Control labor expenses, overtime, and manufacturing costs while supporting production demand.
  
* Continuous Improvement: Implement measurable process improvements that support long-term operational growth.
  

  
Leadership Expectations
  

The Director of Manufacturing must be a visible, engaged leader who takes ownership of shop performance. This individual should be comfortable spending time on the manufacturing floor, addressing challenges directly, making timely decisions, and holding leaders accountable for results.

  

We are looking for someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, build strong teams, and bring the structure, discipline, and leadership necessary to support Safe Air Technology's continued growth.

  
  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

  

Safe Air Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law

**About Veeco**
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.
  
  
We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.
  
  
We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers .
  
  
**Overview**
Veeco is hiring a Director, Manufacturing Operations, who is excellent in execution, accountability, and leadership development. In this role, you’ll lead a manufacturing organization responsible for delivering Veeco's laser annealing and lithography products. The Director of Manufacturing Operations reports directly to the VP of Global Operations and serves as a key member of the San Jose Operations leadership team. This onsite position requires an operations executive with extensive experience leading manufacturing operations with expertise in manufacturing, international supply chain, operations and strategic planning.
  
  
This is a demanding and highly visible role that requires foresight, superb execution in a fast-paced, challenging, high-tech environment, with exceptional organizational development and leadership skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Direct the Sub-assembly, Assembly, and Test teams to meet corporate strategies and business objectives in Veeco’s San Jose factory.
* Foster a world-class safety culture with strong focus on proactive safety.
* Achieve world-class quality metrics for in-box and out-of-box quality.
* Take direct accountability for on-time-shipments and meeting customer commitments.
* Establish budget and resource plan for site manufacturing operations.
* Ensure continuing compliance to all quality and safety standards including ISO certifications.
* Develop a world-class organization – training, mentoring, coaching and leading. Critically assess department staff abilities and take action to ensure long-term health, productivity, and a high-performance culture.
* Establish a roadmap for productivity improvements and run continuous improvement/ lean programs.
* Lead Production related quality investigations/improvement plans via structured problem solving/ 8D analysis, and Shift-Left activities.
* Execute product transition plans for both existing and new products including insourcing/outsourcing efforts at both factory and supplier worldwide locations.
* Be a progressive thinker and role model: enable efficiency enhancing tools such as Lean Manufacturing and cycle time reduction through automated test methods to easily detect/correct manufacturing issues.
* Implement and improve Modular Final Test strategy to enable parallel work and cycle time reduction.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in engineering or operations management and a minimum of 12 years of experience with increasing responsibility in an operations leadership role managing a large organization (>30 people) is required. Experience with Quality Management techniques like Lean, Value Stream Mapping, Six Sigma, 8D with proficiency using data analytics and statistical process control is also required.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Experience with complex capital equipment manufacturing—particularly within semiconductor or related high‑tech industries—is strongly preferred
* Demonstrate situational leadership and understand when to lead or delegate
* Strong financial background coupled with solid business acumen
* Practical mindset relative to manufacturability operations and business processes
* Leverage process discipline and data‑driven insights to ensure high product quality, whether manufacturing is performed internally or through contract manufacturing and supplier partnerships
* Act as a dynamic leader who brings a strong sense of ownership, integrity, and collaboration, with the drive and creativity to deliver results in a fast‑paced environment
* Capable of inspiring others by creating, articulating and implementing a vision for manufacturing
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high‑performing teams through thoughtful assessment, recruiting, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing talent development
* Design for Manufacturability (DfM) training/experience a plus
* Experience with SAP and world-class MES systems is a plus
* This position may have occasional domestic and international travel

**Salary And Benefits**
The expected salary range for this position is $182,000-$230,000, plus a bonus opportunity. We will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors when determining your pay.
**If your salary requirements exceed the advertised range and you remain interested in Veeco, we encourage you to apply or email your resume to**
**recruiting@veeco.com .**
**Other Benefits Include**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Time
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Commuter Benefits
* Life and Accident Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Identity Theft Remediation
* Emergency Travel Assistance

Veeco is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected characteristics. Veeco is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**Notice To Applicants**
All communication about open positions and hiring will come from someone with a @veeco.com email address. You will always have multiple interviews and meet several team members (in-person or virtually) before we present an offer. We may also check references or conduct a background investigation as part of the offer process. We will never ask you for money for any reason, especially to send equipment or for pre-employment training. If you have any questions or concerns, or if someone has reached out to you and you think it might be a scam, please get in touch with us at recruiting@veeco.com .

Our client is a privately held manufacturer of commercial and industrial HVAC equipment with employees. Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations will own the performance of the company’s manufacturing and operational functions and turn strategy into execution. Because the company builds semi-custom equipment, this role balances production efficiency with the flexibility to deliver customer-specific configurations. It suits a hands-on leader who can work across the business, from the production floor to the executive team.

* Oversee daily manufacturing and operations, including production planning, scheduling, and throughput
* Set, track, and improve KPIs for quality, on-time delivery, cost, and customer satisfaction

* Partner with sales, engineering, and finance on capacity planning, lead times, and new product launches

* A record of measurably improving productivity, quality, or margins in a manufacturing environment

records.description:
**POSITION PURPOSE**

This position is responsible for leading, planning, organizing, and managing the safe and efficient operation and maintenance of the Bison Generation Station (BGS) facility to economically produce electricity to satisfy member needs.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Provide technical input for the decision-making process in power plant operation and maintenance. Keep plant staff informed of all aspects of the operation and maintenance of the facility and implement necessary corrective actions.
* Manage plant operational equipment; develop and maintain plant personnel and equipment safety standards; and develop preventative maintenance procedures and operational procedure manuals.
* Support the safety program by rigorously assuring standards are enforced and safety is at the forefront of all actions.
* Work in collaboration with other departments to build and adhere to all project budgets; responsible for developing and adhering to the BGS Long-Range Engineering Plan and the Capital Budget.
* Supervise the selection, training, development, and supervision of BGS employees.
* Evaluate the performance of plant section heads reporting to the position, review performance evaluations for all employees, and recommend salary adjustments for plant employees.
* Direct the development and submission of required reports to assure documentation and communication of plant operations, maintenance, and environmental activities.
* Authorize all plant purchase request orders and staff timesheets. In addition, review all proposed changes or modifications to plant systems or equipment and proposed tests or research programs.
* Responsible for staff development to ensure that each section functions safely and efficiently and that they all work together to meet the goals and objectives of Basin Electric, the plant operations division, and the station.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Energy Management, Business, or an Engineering Accreditation Commission/ Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (EAC/ABET) accredited engineering program; and 10 years of related power generation or petrochemical plant operations, maintenance, or engineering experience; or
* An associate’s degree in Power/Process Plan Technology or related field; and 12 years’ experience in power generation or petrochemical plant operations, maintenance or engineering; or
* A high school diploma or equivalent (GED or HSED); and 14 years’ in power generation or petrochemical plant operations, maintenance or engineering.
* Prior supervisory experience.
* A valid driver’s license.

**PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS**

This position requires constant sitting; and occasional lifting/carrying up to 50 pounds, pushing/pulling up to 20 pounds, standing, walking, bending, crawling, reaching, and climbing. This position uses office equipment and field tools. This position also requires finger dexterity, good vision/hearing, hand coordination, and the ability to perform close work, analyze data/reports, conduct research, and implement recommendations. This position occasionally works in areas of dirt/dust, fumes, chemicals, extreme heat/cold, vibration, noise, and poor ventilation. This position must be respirator qualified.

**KEY SKILLS**

* Effective administrative and human relation skills.
* Excellent organizational, written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficient with personal computers and Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Able to provide work direction, develop plans/procedures/goals, and present information to others.

**A ROLE THAT SUPPORTS YOUR CAREER AND YOUR FUTURE**

* Competitive salary aligned with experience.
* Relocation package to support your transition.
* Up to 15% 401(k) match.
* More benefits to support you.

records.description:
The Signal Hill power plant is strategically located in Wichita County, Texas, near the rapidly expanding Dallas/Fort Worth metropolitan area. This 77 MW electric power generation facility utilizes GE gas combustion turbines, along with associated heat recovery steam generators and an ABB steam generator. Signal Hill plays a critical role in supplying power to the ERCOT market during periods of peak demand and supply volatility. The facility was honored with the 2014 Certificate of Recognition by the City of Wichita Falls, Texas, for its outstanding achievements in environmental excellence, including pollution prevention, waste minimization, and water conservation.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Plant Manager to oversee the operations of the Signal Hill power plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power plant management and a commitment to operational excellence, safety, and environmental stewardship. As Plant Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of the facility, while maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and oversee all aspects of plant operations, including safety, maintenance, production, and personnel management.
* Ensure compliance with all environmental, health, and safety regulations, and promote a culture of safety and environmental responsibility.
* Monitor plant performance and implement strategies to optimize efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.
* Coordinate with ERCOT and other stakeholders to ensure the plant meets market demands during peak periods and supply volatility.
* Develop and manage the plant's budget, including forecasting and controlling operational costs.
* Lead and mentor a team of Plant Technicians, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in plant operations, maintenance practices, and environmental performance.
* Maintain strong relationships with local authorities, regulatory agencies, and the community.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant power industry experience, such as experience as a Power Plant Manager or in a comparable power generation leadership role, in lieu of a degree.
* Proven experience in power plant management, with a strong understanding of gas turbine and steam generator operations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of ERCOT market operations and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to manage and motivate a diverse team.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Commitment to safety, environmental stewardship, and operational excellence.

records.description:
Select Milk Producers is one of the nation’s largest and most progressive dairy cooperatives, with 32 wholly owned subsidiaries, 8 processing plants, and 8 joint ventures including Continental Dairy Facilities, Continental Dairy Facilities Southwest, Mill Haven Foods, Select Custom Solutions, GreenLink and Select Services. With over 800 employees, the Select Milk family of companies impacts all aspects of the dairy farm business and at the heart of our family of companies, is you.
  
  
"We strive to go above and beyond what’s expected in providing for our families, leading our employees, caring for our land and animals, serving our customers, producing quality milk, and serving one another. This commitment is more than our business, it’s in our culture and our character. We believe in being accountable, in doing what’s right, in performing at our best, in setting a higher standard."
  
  
Select Milk Producers and its subsidiaries offer an attractive compensation and a best-in-class benefits package that includes but is not limited medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more that can be tailored for you and your family. Other benefits for eligible employees include 401(k) up to 6% company match, life and disability insurance, and paid holidays & vacation. We are proud to promote an equal employment opportunity workplace.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Plant Operations: Review daily inventories and plan daily production. Conduct daily staff meetings to coordinate daily plant activities. Review daily load out schedule and coordinate with staff and milk movement personnel. Review daily production efficiencies and production reports. Review companies KPI’s, plant loss and assist in setting goals. Reports directly to the Director of Operations.
* Plant Quality: Review microbiology test results daily and direct further investigation of high counts. Review list of any out-of-spec. product with Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Manager. Review all product C of A's.
* Plant Audits: Check each department daily. Check employee GMP’s. Review daily report of audits. Assist Quality Assurance with all plant audits.
* Industrial Wastewater: Check wastewater facility daily. Review daily reports as required.
* Sanitation: Review CIP records daily. Review random equipment checks with chemical account representative.
* Plant Employees: Audit sampling techniques and sanitation practices. Monitor production departments throughout shift and assure employee compliance with GMP’s, sanitation and safety. Provide training as needed. Provide annual GMP and HACCP training.
* Purchasing: Review and approve order supplies. Track purchases and prepare appropriate paperwork.
* Equipment: Verify that all plant equipment is in good working condition and all preventative maintenance is being performed on a scheduled basis. Review and approve all work orders. Review all daily maintenance activity reports. Develop capital justifications to update equipment as needed.
* Environmental: Review of Air Quality annual reports. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Form R for EPA/Health Department. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Hazardous Materials Inventory and Business Plan. Perform other duties, as necessary.
* Safety: Review Safety program and training with EHS management. Daily observation during plant audit will include safety. Check each department and observe employee safety procedures. Member of the Food Safety Team and Food Quality Team.
* Leadership: Utilize Code of Conduct and core values to drive development and growth opportunities for all team members.
* Support a company culture of continuous improvement by participating in efficiency and improvement efforts.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* This position has management and employee supervisory responsibilities for the entire facility in the area of discipline, hiring, and firing.
* Review on the job training reviews.
* Coordinate on the job training.
* Oversee adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee scheduling of management, employees, and temporary labor.
* Have the responsibility of reviewing timesheets, overtime and approve payroll.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**

* An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Must have the ability to trouble shoot problems and be persistent until a solution is found.
* Must work in a safe manner and follow all safety procedures including use of safety equipment.
* Must be willing to ask for assistance when the process is unclear.
* Proficient in verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to communicate with upper management on a daily basis.
* Leadership, team development, coaching, and / or teaching experience.
* Good math and statistical skills.
* Excellent computer skills for data input, report writing, program tracking.
* Excellent organizational and follow through skills.

**Education And/Or Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Dairy or Food Science and four years of experience in a Plant leadership role in a Dairy or Food Manufacturing facility is strongly desired.

New Factory Launch and Steel Products Production

New factory launch

Steel products and roll forming

Position Summary
  
  
At FrameworX, we are accelerating the world’s transition to renewable energy through breakthrough engineering. The Plant Manager will lead the launch and ongoing operation of a new steel products factory in Texas, with an emphasis on roll forming. This leader will build the plant team, establish safe and reliable production, and ramp capacity to meet customer requirements. Lean Manufacturing principles will drive daily decisions, employee engagement, and continuous improvement across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
New Factory Launch
  
  

* Own the integrated factory launch plan, including milestones, staffing, capital spending, operational readiness, and risk mitigation.
* Coordinate facility readiness, equipment installation, commissioning, and production trials with engineering, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Establish plant layouts, material flow, production controls, work instructions, and training before production begins.
* Lead readiness reviews and capacity validation; resolve launch issues and transition the factory from startup to stable production.

Steel Production and Roll Forming
  
  

* Direct daily steel products production, with responsibility for roll forming throughput, quality, schedule attainment, and conversion cost.
* Work with engineering and quality to control coil specifications, tooling alignment, line setup, dimensional tolerances, cut length, and surface condition.
* Improve material yield, reduce scrap and changeover time, and eliminate recurring defects and equipment losses.
* Align production schedules, steel coil inventory, maintenance, and shipping with customer demand; establish preventive maintenance and critical spare parts plans.

Lean Manufacturing and Daily Management
  
  

* Make Lean Manufacturing the daily operating system through tiered accountability meetings, visual performance boards, gemba walks, and leader standard work.
* Review safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people metrics each day; assign countermeasures, owners, and due dates and verify sustained results.
* Apply 5S, standard work, value stream mapping, flow and pull systems, mistake proofing, and quick changeover methods where appropriate.
* Coach employees in structured root cause problem solving and kaizen; build a culture in which teams identify waste and improve their own processes.

Safety People and Business Leadership
  
  

* Set clear safety expectations and ensure effective training, machine guarding, hazardous energy control, and safe coil handling practices.
* Lead production, maintenance, quality, materials, and supporting teams; recruit and develop supervisors and establish clear performance expectations.
* Own plant budgets, labor planning, operating expenses, and capital priorities; use operating data to improve productivity and cost performance.
* Partner with HR, finance, engineering, supply chain, and suppliers to remove constraints and maintain effective communication throughout launch and ongoing operations.

* Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience with accountability for plant or major production operations, people, budgets, and performance.
* Experience launching a new factory or leading a major manufacturing startup, including commissioning, workforce readiness, and production ramp-up.
* Strong steel products manufacturing experience, including practical knowledge of roll forming equipment, tooling, process controls, and troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to apply Lean Manufacturing principles through daily management and deliver sustained improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, interpret production and financial data, and communicate clearly with employees and business leaders.
* Minimum 10 years in Plant Leadership role with P&L responsibility
* Posses or ability to get Chinese VISA

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Chinese speaking ability is preferred to support communication with Chinese-speaking equipment suppliers and technical partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; Lean or Six Sigma training.

Work Location
  
  
This position is based onsite at the factory in Texas and requires active leadership on the production floor during launch and ongoing operations.

records.description:
**Job Description**
Nokia Network Infrastructure is seeking a Director of Scalable Manufacturing & Automation to help define and execute the R&D technology roadmap for scalable, high-precision optical manufacturing. This leader will partner with internal engineering and operations teams and with third-party equipment manufacturers to specify, develop, qualify, and deploy next-generation automation that enables safe, repeatable, zero-defect volume production.
  
  
The successful candidate combines deep manufacturing-domain expertise with systems thinking, supplier leadership, and disciplined industrialization. The role spans mechanization, automation development, precision optical assembly and test.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop a scalable manufacturing strategy: Build a multi-year automation and equipment roadmap aligned with product roadmaps, capacity plans, cost, yield, quality, and time-to-volume objectives.
* Scale production technology: Translate product and process requirements into robust manufacturing concepts, line architectures, equipment specifications, acceptance criteria, and deployment plans.
* Lead equipment partnerships: Work directly with third-party equipment manufacturers and integrators to develop new capabilities where commercial solutions do not yet meet Nokia’s precision, throughput, traceability, or reliability needs.
* Advance optical assembly: Industrialize automated pick-and-place, adhesive dispense and cure, precision lens placement, active and passive alignment, optical coupling, inspection, and functional test.
* Embed zero-defect principles: Design quality at the source through automated detection, stop-and-alert logic, interlocks, error proofing, closed-loop process control, defect containment, and rapid root-cause correction.
* Integrate the digital factory: Ensure equipment supports data collection, recipe governance, material and unit traceability, analytics, equipment health monitoring, and connectivity with manufacturing execution and quality systems.
* Manage execution and investment: Develop business cases, capital plans, resource models, schedules, technical risk assessments, and executive-level progress reviews.

**Required Qualifications**
**KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, industrial, controls, materials, optical engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
* Substantial progressive experience in advanced manufacturing, automation, equipment engineering, or process industrialization, including leadership at a senior manager, director, or equivalent level.
* Demonstrated success specifying, co-developing, qualifying, and deploying custom or highly configured production equipment with external equipment manufacturers and system integrators.
* Knowledge of zero-defect manufacturing, quality at the source, error proofing, automated inspection, process capability, statistical process control, design of experiments, measurement system analysis, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Experience industrializing optical assembly processes such as high-accuracy pick-and-place, lens placement, active or passive alignment, bonding, optical test, and automated inspection.
* Working knowledge of precision motion systems, machine vision, robotics, controls, fixtures, metrology, software and equipment interfaces, and manufacturing data systems.
* Strong commercial judgment in technical negotiation, capital justification, contract deliverables, and supplier performance management.
* Ability to work across R&D, product engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, IT/OT, facilities, and external partners in a global matrix organization.
* Clear executive communication, structured problem-solving, and change-leadership skills.
* Ability to travel to Nokia sites, supplier facilities, and equipment acceptance events as business needs require.

**Preferred Experience**

* Manufacturing of photonic integrated circuits, optoelectronic modules, coherent optical components, lasers, detectors, or high-density optical assemblies.
* Cleanroom manufacturing and materials or contamination controls relevant to photonics and semiconductor assembly.
* Factory automation architectures, machine connectivity, manufacturing execution systems, equipment data acquisition, advanced analytics, digital twins, or predictive maintenance.
* Global equipment transfer, replication across factories, contract manufacturing, or development of standardized manufacturing platforms.
* Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or equivalent operational-excellence certification.

**Measures of Success**

* Scalable manufacturing roadmap approved and translated into funded, executable programs.
* New equipment and processes achieve defined safety, quality, capability, throughput, availability, and cost targets at production release.
* Yield improves and defect escapes, manual interventions, rework, and unplanned downtime decline.
* Critical processes include effective built-in quality, traceability, automated detection, and relevant responses.
* Equipment suppliers meet technical, schedule, documentation, service, and lifecycle-support commitments.
* New products and processes transition smoothly from development to repeatable scale production.

**Job Description**
**Please note that this position is not available for visa sponsorship, and we are unable to take over existing employment visa sponsorships.**
TransMedics is transforming organ transplant therapy with the Organ Care System (OCS)—the first portable warm-perfusion platform that keeps donor organs functioning outside the body. It's technology built to give more patients a chance at a transplant, and more transplant teams the confidence to say yes to an organ they'd otherwise have to turn away.
  
  
The
**Sr. Director of Manufacturing Engineering**
is a pivotal leadership role within TransMedics Supply Chain organization, leading Advanced Operations (New Product & Technology Introduction), Sustaining Engineering, Manufacturing (Process) Engineering, and Technical Field Service. Building on TransMedics strong foundation of engineering excellence, this leader will drive the step-change required to enable the company's next phase of growth—ensuring our engineering practices, systems, and infrastructure deliver world-class results, from product quality and reliability to manufacturing performance, efficiency, and scalability.
  
  
This is a build role, not a maintain role. TransMedics growth trajectory demands a leader who can set multi-year transformation strategy and organizational design—while staying close enough to the floor to walk a line, dig into a process deviation, or unblock a launch when it matters. We're looking for someone equally comfortable owning a transformation roadmap and rolling up their sleeves alongside the team. This leader will also play a key role in building the team's reputation as a strong destination for engineering talent—attracting good people and giving them room to grow into bigger roles as the company scales.

* Advance manufacturing innovation — implement transformational processes using best-in-class development, advanced technologies, automation, and robotic-assisted manufacturing.
* Embed Design for Excellence (DfX) — make DfX, including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), a core enabler of product quality, cost efficiency, and scalability, with a strong focus on simplification and part-count reduction.
* Develop and inspire talent — build and scale a high-performing engineering team while fostering growth, development, and a culture of excellence.

* MBA
