records.title: General Manager, Data Operations
records.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

records.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.
 
 
This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation’s space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.
 
 
As Director of Quality Assurance, you will lead the Quality organization across our Corona and South El Monte sites, ensuring a robust Quality Management System (QMS) and driving measurable improvements in product and process quality. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer expectations into clear quality strategies, resolve systemic issues, and build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and quality ownership.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Leads the Quality Assurance organization across both sites, managing staffing, development, performance, and accountability.
* Provides clear direction and establishes priorities, metrics, and expectations for quality performance.
* Develops and executes Quality Improvement Plans informed by customer feedback, audit findings, nonconformances, and performance trends.
* Serves as the primary Voice of the Customer (VOC) focal point for quality matters and converts customer concerns into internal improvement actions.
* Leads root cause and corrective action (CAPA/RCCA) activities, ensuring effective containment, corrective action, verification, and timely closure.
* Facilitates Corrective Action Board (CAB) meetings, driving cross-functional ownership of actions and tracking progress to closure.
* Identifies and leads continuous improvement projects to improve product quality, process capability, first-pass yield, and reduce defects and rework.
* Partners with Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to address systemic defects and strengthen process controls.
* Oversees supplier approval, auditing, monitoring, and corrective actions to maintain supplier quality performance.
* Manages document change control, MRB (material review board) activities, and internal audits to ensure compliance with the QMS and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in work experience, American Society for Quality (ASQ) training, or certification.
* Minimum five years of experience in quality control or quality assurance within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum five years of experience implementing or managing ISO Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Demonstrated experience leading root cause analysis, corrective action, and preventive action (CAPA/RCCA) processes.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving corrective actions to closure.
* Experience facilitating corrective action reviews, quality boards, or similar cross-functional forums.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D.
* Experience with customer and supplier audits.
* Familiarity with aerospace and defense manufacturing processes, customer specifications, and quality requirements.
* Ability to conduct formal training on quality and customer requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to use data to identify trends and drive improvement.
* Ability to lead and develop a Quality organization and build strong cross-functional relationships.
* Knowledge of QMS reporting, record keeping, and quality management processes.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Salary Range
 
 
$125,000 - $175,000 USD
 
 
Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
View our Privacy Policy

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Join Our Relentless Pursuit of Excellence**

At
**Singer Vehicle Design**
, we believe
*Everything is Important.*
That’s why every nut, bolt, stitch, and finish matters when we restore and reimagine Porsche 911s into some of the most beautiful and respected cars in the world.

We’re looking for a
**Director of Quality**
to bring their leadership, precision, and problem-solving skills to our team in
**Torrance, CA**
. If you share our passion for beautiful cars, thrive on details, and want to be part of something extraordinary, this is your chance.

**Why You’ll Love This Role:**

* You will lead the US Quality team and work to further develop and implement the Quality strategy in conjunction with our UK Quality team for Singer vehicle production in manner that demonstrates, “Everything is Important”
* You will oversee all aspects of the Singer Quality Department including design and production quality engineering, continuous improvement, and incoming and final inspection functions in an Automotive manufacturing environment

**What You’ll Do:**

* Manage a team of Quality Engineers and Quality Inspectors
* Develop Key Performance Indicators and implement strategies to achieve company and department’s objectives
* Create and implement quality management system and company’s overall culture of continuous improvement aligned with strategic business development, growth plans, and UK Operations
* Work with Procurement, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Customer Experience, and Warranty personnel in US and UK to support the resolution of internal and external quality issues
* Work with manufacturing departments to improve quality performance and compliance to Singer’s requirements
* Create, implement, and manage the Production MRB process
* Manage resolution of systemic issues in a timely/professional manner and ensure root cause and corrective actions are completed to drive effective process improvements
* Develop and analyze data and product/process performance to recommend and implement improvements in targeted areas of the organization
* Establish and implement metrics for monitoring system effectiveness and to enable other functional managers and Quality team members to make sound quality decisions regarding product, customer, regulatory, and systems quality
* Champion continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies across the business
* Manage production and quality Record Retention and Management process

**Who We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or relevant degree
* Ten (10) plus years of experience in Quality Functions in an automotive or similar manufacturing environment
* Five (5) plus years in supervisory/managerial role
* Five (5) plus years in Quality Engineering role
* Experience with Pareto Analysis
* Strong analytical and problem-solving competency (Root Cause, Corrective Action and Continuous Improvement, and 8D).
* Experience implementing Quality Management Systems
* AS9100/ISO Audit experience
* Bonus points for ASQ Certificate in Quality Leadership, Quality Audit, Quality Engineering or Six Sigma
* Bonus points for experience with implementing ERP/MRP systems
* Bonus points for prior experience in a rapid growth environment

**Location & Schedule:**

This position is onsite in Torrance, CA. The hours are Monday – Friday 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM

**What We Offer - Benefits Driven by You:**

The starting pay range for this position is between $169,037.00 - $225,386.00 per year plus bonus. Actual compensation will be determined by skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Our mantra
*Everything is Important*
guides us every day, so naturally we also believe
*Everyone is Important*
. Our benefits and perks are thoughtfully curated to invest in the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team both inside and outside the shop.

Health & Wellness

* 80% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and family with choices for HMO & PPO plans
* Tax-free savings options via HSA and FSA, including employer HSA contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage

Time Off & Flexibility

* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 13 paid holidays annually, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s

Financial Benefits

* Annual bonus plan
* 401(k) with company match
* Annual merit increases following performance reviews (when eligible)
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement

Perks & Extras

* Free snacks! (monthly snack stipend at our mini-mart)
* “Working Advantage” employee discount program for travel, entertainment, amusement parks, and more
* Tools provided for technicians
* Team events and company gatherings throughout the year
* Discounted pet insurance through MetLife
* Employee-led clubs based on interest: books, movies and (of course) cars!
* Access to exclusive Singer-branded merch!

Growth & Development

* Annual performance reviews to provide feedback and aid employee development
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Access to Singer's learning platform (Singer Learn) containing over 115,000 courses on a wide variety of topics - coming soon!
* Transparent leadership communication through quarterly town halls

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to building a team that includes individuals from different cultural backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, ages, sexual orientation, and physical abilities, reflecting the diversity of the communities where we work and live.

**Do you want to Reimagine your career? Apply now and join us!**

records.title: OEM Manufacturing Director
records.description:
**Job Description**
As the Fort Wayne OEM Director of Manufacturing, you will be a key leadership contributor to the success of the Fort Wayne Manufacturing Hub. Reporting to the Hub Director of Manufacturing, you will provide inspirational leadership in a rapidly growing business and have responsibility for all original equipment manufacturing at the site. This role demands a strategic, results-oriented leader with a proven track record of building and scaling rapidly growing organizations. Because of the need for consistent, in-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed full-time on site. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time.
 
 
 
 
**Key Responsibilities Include**
**Strategic Product Stream Leadership**

* Own the strategic direction, execution, and performance of the Circuit Card Assembly and Unit Integration factories
* Serve as the primary point of contact between production and program management

**Program Execution**

* Oversee execution of manufacturing in alignment with program schedules
* Ensure all contractual obligations (cost, schedule, performance) are met or exceeded

**Performance Improvement**

* Drive continuous improvement using Lean, Six Sigma Principles
* Implement metrics to monitor production performance
* Initiate corrective actions to resolve production variances, quality escapes, and manufacturing cost variances

**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Operations Management, or related field; equivalent experience considered OR 20 years manufacturing experience with no degree
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in production/manufacturing
* Minimum 6 years’ experience leading production/manufacturing teams including managing people leaders
* Proficiency with manufacturing management concepts
* Proficiency applying Lean Manufacturing principles and visual management tools

**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**

* Proficiency with Oracle ERP
* Formal Lean or Six Sigma training/certification
* Minimum 10 years’ experience leading people leaders of production/manufacturing teams

**Pay Information**
Full-Time Salary Range: $153377 - $260743
 
 
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
 
 
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.
 
 
 
 
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
 
 
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
 
 
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing (Site Leader)
records.description:
**Job Description**
Executive Manufacturing Leadership Opportunity
 
 
BASX is seeking a transformational manufacturing executive to lead one of its key operations as Site Leader (Director of Manufacturing).
 
 
This role is far more than manufacturing oversight. It is an opportunity to shape the future of a growing operation, influence enterprise strategy, drive large-scale operational transformation, and build the manufacturing capabilities required to support long-term business growth.
 
 
As the senior manufacturing leader for the site, you will serve as a trusted business partner to executive leadership and will be responsible for aligning manufacturing strategy, operational performance, capital investment, workforce development, and technology advancement with the organization's strategic objectives.
 
 
The successful candidate will bring a balance of strategic vision and operational discipline while building a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable growth.
 
 
**This Is a Unique Opportunity To**




+ Lead manufacturing operations that directly support the growth strategy of a rapidly expanding organization.
+ Shape the future-state manufacturing vision through automation, digital transformation, and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
+ Influence major capital investment decisions, facility expansion plans, and manufacturing technology roadmaps.
+ Build leadership capability and strengthen organizational effectiveness across the operation.
+ Partner directly with executive leadership to establish long-term operational strategies.
+ Drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, safety, delivery performance, and profitability.
+ Leave a lasting legacy by creating a scalable manufacturing organization positioned for future growth.

**What You'll Accomplish**
**Enterprise Impact**




+ Establish and execute a multi-year manufacturing strategy aligned with company growth initiatives.
+ Lead initiatives that enhance operational scalability, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
+ Drive business performance through operational excellence, capacity optimization, and strategic planning.

**Manufacturing Transformation**




+ Lead cultural and operational transformation initiatives across the facility.
+ Advance Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement principles throughout the organization.
+ Champion automation, smart factory technologies, and digital manufacturing capabilities.
+ Identify and implement breakthrough improvements that create sustainable competitive advantages.

**Executive Partnership**




+ Serve as a key member of the site leadership team.
+ Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic business decisions.
+ Influence organizational direction through data-driven decision-making and operational expertise.
+ Provide strategic recommendations regarding investments, growth opportunities, risk mitigation, and resource allocation.

**Leadership Development**




+ Build and mentor a high-performing leadership team.
+ Create succession plans and strengthen organizational capability.
+ Foster a culture focused on accountability, engagement, innovation, and results.
+ Attract and retain top manufacturing talent.

**Scope & Organizational Impact**
Serves as the senior manufacturing leader for BASX's Redmond operation, directing a workforce of more than 500 employees across a manufacturing footprint exceeding 300,000 square feet. Responsible for shaping manufacturing strategy, leading operational transformation, guiding capital investments, and building the organizational capabilities required to support continued growth and market leadership.
 
 
**The Executive Profile**
We are seeking a respected manufacturing leader with a demonstrated history of transforming operations, developing talent, and delivering measurable business results.
 
 
**The Ideal Candidate Must Have**




+ Proven experience leading large-scale manufacturing organizations.
+ Demonstrated success driving operational and cultural transformation.
+ Experience leading automation, digital manufacturing, or Industry 4.0 initiatives.
+ Strong financial acumen with experience managing capital investments and operating budgets.
+ A track record of improving productivity, quality, throughput, and operational efficiency.
+ Exceptional leadership presence and executive communication skills.
+ The ability to balance strategic vision with executional excellence.
+ Experience building high-performing leadership teams and scalable organizational structures.

**Preferred Leadership Competencies**
**Strategic Leadership**




+ Manufacturing Transformation
+ Business Transformation
+ Enterprise Leadership
+ Strategic Planning
+ Organizational Development

**Operational Excellence**




+ Lean Manufacturing
+ Six Sigma
+ Continuous Improvement
+ Operational Excellence
+ Value Stream Optimization

**Innovation & Growth**




+ Industry 4.0
+ Smart Factory Strategy
+ Digital Manufacturing
+ Manufacturing Innovation
+ Automation Strategy

**Financial & Capital Management**




+ Capital Projects
+ Capacity Planning
+ Facility Expansion
+ Cost Optimization
+ Investment Planning

**Education And Experience Requirements**
Requires a four-year ABET-accredited degree in engineering with significant experience in manufacturing technology; 10+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, including leadership of large-scale initiatives; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background. Advanced degrees and certifications in quality control or advanced manufacturing are preferred.
 
 
**Why BASX?**
BASX continues to invest in advanced manufacturing capabilities, growth initiatives, and operational excellence. This position offers the opportunity to lead meaningful change within an organization committed to innovation, customer success, and long-term growth.
 
 
For leaders who enjoy building organizations, developing talent, optimizing operations, and shaping strategy, this role offers both the challenge and visibility necessary to make a significant impact.
 
 
**Why Redmond, Oregon?**
Located in the heart of Central Oregon, Redmond offers an exceptional quality of life and access to world-class outdoor recreation.
 
 
**Lifestyle Advantages**




+ Hiking, skiing, fishing, mountain biking, golf, and year-round outdoor activities
+ Family-friendly communities and excellent schools
+ One of the fastest-growing regions in the Pacific Northwest
+ No Oregon state sales tax
+ Easy access to Bend, the Cascade Mountains, and major regional airports

**Additional Benefits**




+ Executive-level compensation package
+ Annual incentive opportunity
+ Comprehensive benefits program
+ Relocation assistance available
+ Sponsorship not available

**Build Something That Lasts**
If you are a forward-thinking manufacturing executive who thrives on creating organizational capability, driving transformation, and delivering business results, this is an opportunity to lead at a strategic level while shaping the future of a growing operation.
 
 
**Mental And Physical Functions**
This role requires strategic thinking, technical leadership, and the ability to manage complex initiatives across departments and locations. The Director must be capable of balancing high-level planning with hands-on engagement in manufacturing operations.
 
 

* Communicates effectively in written and spoken form
* Possesses excellent interpersonal and leadership skills
* Demonstrates strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Works effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
* Sit or stand for up to 95% of work hours
* Regular visits to manufacturing facilities with exposure to seasonal hot and cold temperatures, dust, and chemical fumes

**Work Environment**
The Director, Manufacturing operates in both office and production environments, with frequent interaction across departments and facilities.
 
 

* Work is performed in a combination of office and factory settings
* Exposure to loud noise, dust, temperature fluctuations, and industrial equipment
* Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) is required when on the production floor
* Frequent collaboration with engineering, operations, quality, and executive leadership teams
* This position is designated as a safety-sensitive role and is subject to drug and alcohol testing, including random testing
* Compliance with all company safety and operational policies is mandatory

**Disclaimer**
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at a time with or without notice. This job description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee may be required to perform, and the employee may be required to perform additional functions. The company reserves the right to revise this job description at any time. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. If requested, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job, absent undue hardship.
 
 
#BASX
 
 
**Benefits And Compensation Summary**
We take care of our people. We offer competitive compensation and robust benefits to all full-time team members, including:
 
 

* Tuition reimbursement
* Paid time-off
* Paid holidays
* Healthcare insurance & Health Savings Accounts
* Profit sharing or Annual Incentive Plan Bonus
* Premium 401(k) plan

records.title: Manufacturing Director
records.description:
If you are a GPI employee, please click the Employee Login before applying.
 
 
**At Graphic Packaging International, we produce the paper cup that held your coffee this morning, the basket that transported those bottles of craft beer you enjoyed last weekend, and the microwave tray that heated your gourmet meal last night. We’re one of the largest manufacturers of paperboard and paper-based packaging for some of the world’s most recognized brands of food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care and pet products. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, we are collaborative, diverse, innovative individuals who create inspired packaging while giving back to our communities.**
**With over 25,000 employees working in more than 130 locations worldwide, we strive to be environmentally responsible in our industry and in the communities where we operate. We are committed to workplace diversity and offer compensation and benefits programs that are among the industry’s best to reward the talented people who make our company successful.**
**If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, we’d love to hear from you.**
**A World of Difference. Made Possible.**
**Job Summary**
Manufacturing Production manages or assists with managing various production activities (e.g., assembly, material forming/shaping, processing, treating, or packaging, etc.) including:
 
 

* Planning, directing, and monitoring production to meet established specifications, schedules, volume/cost/wastage targets, and quality standards
* Liaising with Manufacturing Engineering, Supply & Logistics, Sales, etc. as input to developing production schedules and allocating labor/capital resources
* Planning, prioritizing, and managing production line maintenance/downtime to minimize disruptions

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Individuals in these roles primarily focus on directing, leveraging, and guiding the work of others, and mobilizing resources.
* Leaders typically manage two or more direct reports.
* Responsible for the monitoring and achievement of operational and/or financial results for their area of responsibility.
* Responsible for people management actions such as hiring, terminating, rewarding, training, and developing employees.
* Progression within the levels reflects increase in scope and responsibilities as well as growth in business and industry experience, process and people leadership capabilities, and broad technical expertise.
* Provides leadership and direction through subordinate management levels.
* Responsible for managing a function that includes multiple related departments or disciplines.
* Contributes to long-term strategy development and develops annual business plans to ensure alignment.
* Directs the resolution of complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth knowledge of the company and the application of critical thinking.
* Requires broad and comprehensive understanding of different systems, theories, and practices.
* Participates in corporate development of methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and people.
* Applies broad industry knowledge and commercial awareness to drive financial and operational performance across area of responsibility.
* Establishes policies appropriate for the function.
* Interprets and recommends modifications to company-wide policies and procedures.
* Ensures budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* Objectives are defined in collaboration with senior leadership; results are assessed from a relatively long-term perspective.
* Decisions have a serious impact on the overall success or failure on area of accountability.
* Errors in judgment or failure to achieve results may cause critical delays or modifications to company projects or operations and substantial expenditure of resources.
* Interacts with and influences senior leadership and others concerning matters of significance to the company.
* Conducts business and technical briefings for senior and executive leadership and for external representatives.

**Education & Experience**
BA degree or related work experience required in lieu of degree.
 
 
Disclaimer
 
 
The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily, with or without a reasonable accommodation. Graphic Packaging retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.
 
 
Career Level
 
 
Competencies
 
 
Business Acumen
 
 
Curiosity
 
 
Interpersonal Skills
 
 
Influence Skills
 
 
Self-Starter
 
 
Negotiation Skills
 
 
Organization Skills
 
 
Results Oriented
 
 
Pay Range
 
 
$171,400.00 - $228,600.00
 
 
**Graphic Packaging is an equal opportunity employer and abides by all applicable federal, state provincial and local laws with respect to the recruitment and hiring process. We are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and hiring process free from discrimination or harassment based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Should you require an accommodation for a disability, please contact your Human Resources representative or email accommodations@graphicpkg.com.**
**Recruitment Agency Partnership Notice**
We value partnerships and maintain a strict process for engaging external agencies. Due to compliance requirements, we do not accept unsolicited resumes. Agencies must be fully onboarded and have an active, executed agreement in place with Graphic Packaging to submit candidates for open positions. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Graphic Packaging, and no recruitment fees will be owed.
 
 
Requisition: 16252

records.title: Plant Manager I
records.description:
This position leads all plant operations for a70+ employee, 2 shift, manufacturing site. This leader ensures day-to-day operations are delivered with the aligned objectives of safety-first mindset, customer satisfaction along with growing and developing the leaders within the facility. This position also plays a critical role in developing and executing capital project plans for the facility to enable continuous improvement and growth in market share.

This full-time position reports directly to region General Manager and is located at Liberty Packaging’s manufacturing plant in Houston, Texas

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Directly lead and supervise a team of direct reports to deliver major site functions across manufacturing, shipping, maintenance, and scheduling.
* Own end-to-end performance for the facility to meet KPIs in the areas of Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery. Establish, measure, and monitor performance across facility and root cause performance issues. Develop and deploy plans to drive improvements in manufacturing processes to ensure superior product quality, reduced cycle times, lead times, and minimize overall manufacturing costs.
* Provide day-to-day leadership for manufacturing team decision-making in the areas of production, labor, material costs, design, and production scheduling.
* In partnership with Continuous Improvement function, guide leaders and front-line staff through the identification and deployment of continuous improvement initiatives with an impact on key performance indicators.
* Ensure the right talent and capabilities are in place to meet strategic objectives; accountable for establishing goals, managing performance, and developing teams to ensure short- and long-range objectives are achieved
* Establish a two-way communication & engagement culture to ensure all plant employees are clear on plant performance and connection to business performance, including KPIs.
* Lead key change initiatives across the plant in partnership with regional and functional support systems (e.g., continuous improvement, engineering, human resources, sales, etc.)
* Lead the successful identification, business case design, and execution of capital projects in partnership with functional teams and executive leadership. Ensure multi-year capital plans support market growth and customer delivery
* Ensure employee relations stay connected with open and continuous dialogue
* Develop and grow community engagement presence by representing plant locally in key activities and through execution of frequent employee and community engagement activities
* Own direct P&L responsibility for plant site
* Provide leadership by connecting and being visible to all three shifts daily
* Other duties, as assigned

**Required Education, Experience And Skills**

* Bachelors’ degree and 7+ years manufacturing experience OR 10+ years manufacturing industry experience in lieu of education
* 5+ years people leadership experience
* Experience analyzing downtime, production, and financial variance trends, and identifying actions to deliver expected performance
* Previous experience developing and managing a budget, forecasting, and monitoring results
* Experience with identifying and executing capital projects to drive improvement against KPIs
* Demonstrated experience with organizational effectiveness, operations management, and a proven track record of achieving results
* Experience developing and presenting information to multiple levels of the organization from front-line to executive leadership
* Superior time management, attention to detail, verbal and written communication skills, decision-making, and organization skills
* Excellent computer skills required, including Microsoft Word and Excel skills.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit

**Preferred Education, Experience And Skills**

* Previous experience with Amtech / CTI or Kiwi
* Previous experience with ERP systems
* Previous experience in corrugated or paper manufacturing
* Lean and / or Continuous Improvement certifications
* Bilingual English / Spanish

**Compensation & Benefits**

The starting base salary range for this position is $110,078 - $137,598 per year plus eligibility in annual bonus program. The compensation posted is the anticipated pay for the position at the time of the posting. We may pay above or below posted amount based on several factors, including, but not limited to education and/or certifications, skills, experience, or work location. Some positions may qualify for additional compensation in the form of bonuses or deferred compensation options.

At LDI, we are pleased to provide employees with a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision insurance options; paid time off; 10 paid holidays; 401(k) plus company matching and annual discretionary profit sharing; flexible spending and health savings account options; life and disability insurance; tuition assistance; wellness and mental health resources, and financial advising services. Eligibility in benefit programs is based on hours worked per week.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Regular sitting, standing, and walking throughout the day to accomplish tasks
* Manual and finger dexterity used regularly with some repetitive finger motions
* Ability to work in front of a computer screen for long periods of time
* Specific vision abilities include close and distance vision; able to identify colors, small letters, and numbers; hand/eye coordination, depth perception and able to adjust focus
* Hearing and speaking
* Other conditions may include frequent reaching, stretching, pushing, pulling, pinching, grasping, and gripping.

**About Our Company**

Comprised of multiple companies with headquarters in New Hope, Minnesota, Liberty Diversified International (LDI) is a privately held company employing more than 1,900 individuals across our manufacturing facilities, production facilities and core business operations in Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, Illinois, Mississippi, Texas, Arizona, Virginia, California, and Mexico. With deep roots in the corrugated box manufacturing industry, we operate in the core markets of paper, packaging, workplace products, corrugated plastics and building products.

Since 1918, our values – Caring, Innovation, Trust and Excellence – have guided our day-to-day activities. We believe that when our employees are aligned with these values, we create superior service and solutions for our customers. The LDI family of companies includes Liberty Packaging, Liberty Paper, Liberty Plastics (Custom Solutions and Quarrix Building Products) and Safco.

Liberty Diversified International is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.description:
Job ID: 529086
 
 
Ash Grove family of companies is one of North America's leading cement manufacturers, with a legacy of innovation and excellence dating back to 1882. The company operates 12 world-class cement plants and a vast network of 41 terminals across the United States and Canada. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, Ash Grove combines technical expertise, robust safety standards, and empowered talent to deliver high performance and better serve our customers. At Ash Grove, we stand together to reinvent the way our world is built.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*At Ash Grove Cement, people are our first priority. We offer a complete benefits package to include:\*\*
 
 

* \*\*Health Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Dental Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Vision Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Retirement Plan\*\*
* \*\*Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays\*\*
* \*\*Tuition Reimbursement\*\*
* \*\*Employee Assistance Program\*\*
* \*\*Disability Pay\*\*
* \*\*Life Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Growth Opportunities and more!\*\*

**Summary**
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
**What You'll Be Contributing**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.
* Additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

**To Succeed In This Position, You Will Need**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy
* What's next for you?\*\*

We provide stability and advancement opportunities across North America. Use our tuition reimbursement program to help you meet your career goals.
 
 
\_The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. The physical demands, working environment, and other conditions of employment listed in this document are representative of but are not intended to provide an exhaustive list of the requirements for positions in this classification. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.\_
 
 
\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

records.description:
With over 100 years of experience, Sika is a worldwide innovation and sustainability leader in the development and production of systems and products for commercial and residential construction, as well as the marine, automotive, and renewable energy manufacturing industries.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the consruction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. Approximately 33,000 employees generated CHF 11.20 billion in sales in 2025.

**Job Description**

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the safe, efficient, compliant, and environmentally responsible operation and continued development of the Versailles facility. This role provides overall site leadership for manufacturing performance, including safety, quality, service, productivity, cost, people development, and continuous improvement. The incumbent will create a culture of accountability, trust, employee engagement, and operational excellence while representing the Corporation’s vision and values at the plant level.

***Specific Responsibilities:***

* Lead the plant safety culture by actively advancing Sika SAFE principles, ensuring compliance with safety rules and procedures, and driving progress toward annual safety objectives.
* Deliver annual quality, service, and productivity goals by ensuring strong manufacturing execution, disciplined problem solving, process control, and effective response to customer and business requirements.
* Build and sustain high-performing teams across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, logistics, and support functions.
* Partner with engineering, maintenance, EHS, quality, supply chain, R&D, and commercial teams to support reliable operations, new product introductions, capital planning, preventive maintenance, and long-term site development.
* Drive continuous improvement using lean manufacturing, statistical process control, error-proofing, root cause analysis, standard work, and other structured problem-solving methods.
* Develop a flexible and capable organization that can respond effectively to changing customer demand, business priorities, product mix, and capacity requirements.
* Manage annual operating expense targets and execute approved capital projects to deliver committed safety, quality, capacity, cost, and productivity benefits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, local, corporate, environmental, safety, and quality requirements.
* Select, coach, train, and develop salaried and hourly associates to strengthen capability, succession depth, accountability, and employee engagement.
* Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization and promote a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field preferred; MBA or advanced technical degree desirable.

•Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including experience leading production teams and managing plant-level performance.

•Proven ability to lead safe, efficient, customer-focused manufacturing operations while improving quality, productivity, delivery, and cost performance.

•Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process control, preventive maintenance, and capital project execution.

•Demonstrated leadership capability with the ability to build trust, develop talent, set clear expectations, and hold teams accountable in a fair and consistent manner.

•Excellent communication skills, characterized by clarity, sincerity, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across hourly, salaried, functional, and senior leadership groups.

•Strong interpersonal skills with a leadership style grounded in respect, humility, collaboration, accountability, and employee engagement.

•Goal-oriented, well organized, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with changing priorities.

•Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and the ability to use data, reports, and operating metrics to manage performance and drive improvement.

**Additional Information**

**Perks & Benefits**

* 401k with Generous Company Match
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* Paid Parental Leave

* Life Insurance

* Disability Insurance

* Paid time off, Paid holidays

* Floating holidays + Paid Volunteer Time

* Wellness/Fitness Reimbursements

* Education Assistance

* Professional Development Opportunities

* Employee Referral Program & More!

Sika fosters a culture of entrepreneurship, empowering each individual to make decisions, learn from experiences, and shape their own career path. The safety and well-being of employees are top priorities at Sika, with a strong commitment to open communication and maintaining a safe workplace. In addition, Sika actively contributes to the community and promotes sustainability by giving back, minimizing environmental impact, and embracing social responsibility.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilites of each role. Compensation is determined based on skills relevant to the position, education, and or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Sika Corporation is committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals that apply. As an equal opportunity employer Sika will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, or other protected characteristics.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Job ID: 529948
 
 
Exempt
 
 
Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies.
 
 
Oldcastle Infrastructure - Built For Life from Oldcastle Infrastructure on Vimeo.
 
 
\*\*Job Summary\*\*
 
 
The Plant Manager is responsible for providing leadership and direction for the facility, supporting the vision and values of the corporation. Ensures staff and employees are equipped to meet production and delivery schedules, budgeted cost/efficiency expectations through sound resource planning and provision. Holds self and staff accountable for implementing and adherence to standards, policies & regulations for the safe, environmentally compliant production of a quality polymer concrete product. Ensures staff is held accountable for the development and execution of all continuous improvement initiatives. Leads and directs local site employee/staff training and development initiatives to ensure robust succession planning.
 
 
\*\*Job Location\*\*
 
 
This role will work onsite out of our Kennedale, TX plant.
 
 
\*\*Job Responsibilities\*\*
 
 

* Create and sustain a safe working environment for the facility
* Ensure systems and processes exist in the facility to manufacture quality products efficiently
* Successfully hire, supervise, orient and train staff in disciplines that will improve performance; provide employees with information, leadership and development, succession planning, and training opportunities
* Drive continuous safety, environmental and quality improvements and culture based on current "Best Practices"
* Ensure compliance to production and delivery schedules
* Assist in the development, communication and execution of strategic plans; assists in developing a process to implement plans
* Lead performance management effort that includes the identification & communication of critical successful factors with staff and subordinates
* Drive performance improvements in all areas including capital deployment
* Establish and monitor performance plans for staff and subordinates; track key performance metrics and hold reports accountable for results
* Provide leadership in process redesign, productivity, quality and customer service
* Manage budget and cost reduction initiatives
* Develop, implement and communicate strategic plans to staff and facility personnel
* Develop employees for advancement and contribution to success of the business
* Establish, communicate and monitor environmental and safety achievement and compliance in plants
* Other duties as assigned

\*\*Job Requirements\*\*
 
 

* Minimum high school diploma / equivalent with 5+ years leadership experience in an industrial environment leading multiple departments (or) Associates' Degree in Business, Manufacturing, Engineering Technology, Production or related field - Bachelors' Degree preferred
* Demonstrated ability to effectively plan and allocate resources
* Written and oral communication skills
* Proven track record of developing, implementing and utilizing process and procedures
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate resources to meet internal business objectives and customer expectations
* Thorough knowledge of effective and efficient production and manufacturing methods
* Interpersonal, organizational, and project management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage and supervise direct staff
* Demonstrated skills or knowledge of budgeting and financial analysis skills
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and dealing with ambiguity
* Computer skills including MS Office
* Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to effectively implement change
* Ability to facilitate meetings and manage conflict
* Ability to read and interpret shop drawings

\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Oldcastle Infrastructure, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

records.description:
**About The Position**
****Plant Manager at FRC, a Clarience Technologies Company****
****Location: Nesconset, NY****
****﻿****
****﻿New York Annual Salary Range: $145,000 - $175,000 USD****
****﻿****
Position Summary
 
 
****FRC****
, a Clarience Technologies company, is a leading manufacturer and innovator of firefighting and emergency response technologies serving fire apparatus OEMs, dealers, and fire departments throughout North America. FRC develops industry-leading solutions including fire apparatus controls, pressure governors, instrumentation, LED scene lighting, electronic control systems, and FoamPro® foam injection and proportioning systems.
 
 
The
****Plant Manager****
leads a manufacturing operation of approximately 80 employees across 2 shifts and is responsible for Production, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Facilities. This role is accountable for driving a world-class safety culture, delivering revenue and profitability objectives, achieving quality and operational performance targets, and leading continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
 
 
As a key member of the leadership team, the Plant Manager will develop and execute operational strategies that support growth, innovation, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Safety Leadership
* Champion and drive a proactive safety culture.
* Ensure achievement of targeted safety metrics.
* Lead safety initiatives, investigations and corrective actions.
* Operational Leadership
* Lead Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities and Quality functions.
* Provide weekly revenue forecasts and operational updates.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen and continuous improvement efforts.
* Support new product introductions and manufacturing readiness.
* Financial Management
* Manage labor, variable overhead and fixed overhead costs.
* Achieve gross margin objectives and operational budgets.
* Lead cost reduction and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Quality Management
* Develop and implement the Quality Management System.
* Drive quality metrics, corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Ensure customer quality requirements are achieved.
* Leadership and Talent Development
* Lead supervisors and functional managers.
* Develop organizational capability and succession plans.
* Partner with HR on employee development and workforce planning.

**Managerial Responsibilities**

* Directly manages departmental supervisors and functional leaders within Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, and Quality. Procurement and Scheduling report directly to the President and are not part of this role’s reporting structure.

****Competencies****

* Leadership and team development
* Financial and business acumen
* Operational excellence mindset
* Strong communication and influence skills
* Data-driven decision making
* Problem solving and continuous improvement
* Integrity, accountability and results orientation

*****﻿*****
**\*We do not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability, ancestry veteran status or any other status protected by law.**
**Requirements**
****Education and Experience****

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business or related field preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience managing revenue, labor, overhead and gross margin performance.
* Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement experience required.

**Computer Skills**

* ERP/MRP systems
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Manufacturing reporting tools
* Workforce/timekeeping systems

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Atlas Molded Products**
- a Division of
**Atlas Roofing Corporation**
- specializes in the development and manufacture of innovative, high-quality, HFC- and HCGC- free Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) insulation for construction, packaging, and original equipment management (OEM) products. Atlas EPS insulation is suitable for interior and exterior construction applications, various packaging uses and as part of manufactured systems, such as recreational vehicles, garage and pedestrian doors and sunroom panels.
 
 
**Atlas Roofing Corporation,**
a privately owned company established in 1982, is an international and multi-divisional manufacturer of roofing, sheathing, facer, and insulation product solutions.
 
 
**Atlas Molded Products is seeking a Plant Manager for the Murray, Utah Facility.**
**Plant Manager Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for all safety, product quality, company culture/values, operational performance, environmental health and safety compliance and all local, state, and federal standards.
* Coordinate all aspects of plant operations through plant leadership to ensure the site meets or exceeds the key performance indicators for safety, quality, and service while minimizing cost, inventory, and waste.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries in line with corporate guidance.
* Serve as plant champion for safety and quality programs and initiatives. Ensure a safe work environment through strict adherence to Atlas’ safety policies and procedures with focus on developing a zero-injury culture.
* Achieve manufacturing profit objectives to meet quality and delivery requirements (Customer Service) at the lowest overall cost.
* Support Engineering with product improvements, new product development, and testing.
* Manage capital equipment selection, acquisition, and implementation, manufacturing budget and long-range planning, preparation, and facility maintenance and enhancements.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the workplace.
* Responsible for selection of development of direct reports and creating an atmosphere of career development within the facility.
* Establish and maintain clear and measurable expectations for each employee to build ownership within the team.
* Complete all administrative requirements (monthly reports, manufacturing reports and analysis, etc.)

**Plant Manager Experience**

* Ten years of progressive experience in manufacturing management experience required.
* 5+ years direct supervisory experience, including staff development and planning responsibility.
* 5+ years’ experience engaging employees and developing a strong safety culture.
* Experience with business financial statements, budgetary processes, and cost control.
* Proven track record of developing, leading, and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience in capital investment planning and program management.
* Experience with Environmental, Health and Safety regulatory compliance.

**Plant Manager Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* An ability to balance and achieve positive results in the areas of safety, quality, productivity, cost, and employee relations.
* A demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others.
* Analytic skills to effectively evaluate business proposals and analyze process data.
* Ability to multi-task effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient with MS Office and experienced with manufacturing ERP systems.
* Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours if needed per business needs.

**Plant Manager Education, Licenses & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Plant Manager Additional Information**

* Must be able to tolerate industrial/manufacturing environment to include variations in temperature from extreme cold to extreme heat; wet and/or humid conditions; dust/fumes/chemical exposure; and noise intensity. Personal protective equipment required.

**Total Compensation**

* Atlas Molded Products offers a competitive compensation and vacation/holiday package as well as a comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D/LTD insurance, 401k and Medical & Dependent Care Spending Accounts.

**Atlas Roofing Corporation**
is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer
 
 
***No calls or agencies please.***

records.description:
Plant Manager – Manufacturing Operations
 
 
**Atlas Roofing Corporation | Ardmore, Oklahoma**
**Division:**
Roof Shingles & Underlayments
 
 
Position Overview
 
 
Atlas Roofing Corporation is seeking an experienced, results-driven
**Plant Manager**
to lead our manufacturing operations in Ardmore, Oklahoma.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with proven experience in
**plant turnarounds, continuous manufacturing operations, operational excellence, and financial management**
. This individual will be responsible for driving plant performance, developing high-performing teams, improving profitability, and maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational efficiency.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Plant Operations: Oversee all aspects of manufacturing operations, including production, maintenance, quality, inventory, and workforce performance.
* Operational Improvement: Lead plant turnaround initiatives, continuous improvement (CI) programs, and strategies to reduce downtime, increase productivity, and improve equipment reliability.
* Financial Management: Maintain plant-level P&L accountability, manage operating budgets and capital expenditures, and implement cost-reduction strategies.
* Safety & Compliance: Champion environmental, health, and safety (EHS) initiatives while ensuring compliance with OSHA, EPA, EEO, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Leadership & Labor Relations: Lead and develop plant management teams, oversee salaried and hourly employees, and manage labor relations within a unionized manufacturing environment.
* Quality & Performance: Drive improvements in product quality, inventory accuracy, production efficiency, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Strategic Planning: Support long-term plant planning, capital investments, equipment upgrades, and operational growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including plant-level management responsibilities.
* Proven success leading plant turnarounds, operational recovery, or significant performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing continuous manufacturing or continuous-process operations.
* Demonstrated P&L accountability, budgeting, financial analysis, capital planning, and cost-reduction experience.
* Experience managing production, quality, inventory, maintenance, and equipment downtime.
* Strong background in EHS accountability, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience managing labor relations and employee performance within a unionized manufacturing facility.
* Proven ability to develop leaders, improve operational KPIs, and drive measurable business results.
* Strong communication, decision-making, and analytical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in roofing, building materials, asphalt-based products, or other capital-intensive manufacturing environments.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Experience leading equipment modernization, plant expansion, and major capital improvement projects.

Why Atlas Roofing Corporation?
 
 
At Atlas Roofing Corporation, you'll have the opportunity to lead a manufacturing facility, develop talented teams, and make a measurable impact on operational performance and business success.
 
 
We offer a competitive total compensation package, including paid vacation and holidays, 401(k), health and dental insurance, basic life insurance, and AD&D coverage.
 
 
**Travel:**
Frequent, based on business needs.
 
 
Join Our Team
 
 
If you're a proven manufacturing leader who thrives on improving operations, developing people, and delivering results, we encourage you to apply.
 
 
*Atlas Roofing Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.*
*No calls or agencies, please.*

records.description:
Resource Label Group is seeking a
**Plant Manager**
for our Brooklyn Center, MN Operations team who will be responsible for leading and directing a variety of activities to ensure a successful achievement of day-to-day and growth goals. The ideal candidate will influence a positive work environment that drives a proactive culture of safety and employee engagement, while providing leadership to the overall operations of the Cypress Multigraphics facility.
 
 
**The Ideal Candidate Will**

* Manage the location’s budget by maintaining service levels to our customers while striving to improve safety, quality, efficiency, and productivity standards to drive a “Best in Class” culture.
* Forward thinker and action-oriented Manager, with the motivation to lead a team with a “Have Fun, Get It Done” attitude.
* Collaboratively engage with local leadership to analyze safety, quality, production, and maintenance metrics; determine causes of nonconformity to improve operational excellence and inspire change.

**Responsibilities**

* Work with your team to manage day-to-day operations to execute business plans that align with company goals and overall strategic vision.
* Oversee and drive improvements in production to meet short-term and long-term objectives to achieve optimum efficiency.
* Build a high performing team by establishing strong performance standards and continuously work to grow and develop team members.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives tied to the strategic business direction; execute thoughtful change management.
* Build partnerships and effectively collaborate with commercial/sales business partners to identify facility growth opportunities and maintain relationships with key accounts.
* Work collaboratively with other cross-functional leaders to best serve the customer’s needs.
* Proactively build and maintain Continuous Improvement deck and Capital Expenditure plans.
* Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, execute necessary solutions.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive operations management experience in manufacturing setting with direct responsibility for safety, quality, reliability, production, and financial results; Label, Printing, or Packaging industry experience strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related fields. Master’s Degree preferred.
* Strong knowledge of business and management principles (budgeting, strategic planning, resource allocation and human resources).
* Proven experience in budget and financial management.
* Demonstrated track record of strong goal setting and ability to build, develop, lead, and motivate diverse teams through transformative change.
* Ability to respond quickly to changing demands, processes, and evolving information.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to adjust communication style based on audience

**Posted Pay Range:**
130,000 - 180,000 annually
